def test_ict_project_dynamic_annual_deliverables_and_backward_compatibility():
    """
    Verifies that IctProject supports dynamic annual_deliverables JSON mapping
    across arbitrary multi-year horizons (e.g., a 5-year plan) and that
    backward-compatible properties year_1_deliverables, year_2_deliverables,
    year_3_deliverables and the helper get_deliverable_for_year work seamlessly.
    """
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    proj = IctProject(
        issp_period="2026-2030",
        project_title="Cloud Migration & Digital Twin 5-Year Horizon",
        project_category=ProjectCategory.INTERNAL_ICT_PROJECT,
        description="Comprehensive 5-year digital transformation.",
        objectives="Modernize institutional IT across five full fiscal cycles.",
        duration_start_year=2026,
        duration_end_year=2030,
        annual_deliverables={
            "2026": "Architecture baseline & PIA audit",
            "2027": "Core microservices and API staging",
            "2028": "Pilot rollout across operations sites",
            "2029": "Full cloud production migration",
            "2030": "Post-implementation audit & SPAR evaluation"
        },
        implementing_unit="Information and Communications Technology Division",
        funding_source=FundSource.GAA,
        aligns_others=True,
        aligns_others_specify="Presidential Directive on Digital Governance"
    )
    db.add(proj)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(proj)

    assert proj.get_deliverable_for_year(1, 2026) == "Architecture baseline & PIA audit"
    assert proj.get_deliverable_for_year(4, 2029) == "Full cloud production migration"
    assert proj.get_deliverable_for_year(5, 2030) == "Post-implementation audit & SPAR evaluation"

    assert "Architecture baseline" in proj.year_1_deliverables
    assert "Core microservices" in proj.year_2_deliverables

    db.delete(proj)
    db.commit()
    db.close()

def test_budget_ceiling_natural_split_no_forced_70_30():
    """
    Verifies that BudgetCeiling does not arbitrarily enforce a 70% CapEx / 30% MOOE split.
    Allows custom allocations (e.g. 60/40 or 50/50) where sub_ceiling reflects
    the exact sum of allocated_capex and allocated_mooe without forced overwrite.
    """
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    
    ceiling = db.query(BudgetCeiling).filter(BudgetCeiling.department_id == 2).first()
    if not ceiling:
        ceiling = BudgetCeiling(
            department_id=2,
            issp_period="2026-2028",
            allocated_capex=Decimal("6000000.00"),
            allocated_mooe=Decimal("4000000.00")
        )
        db.add(ceiling)
    else:
        ceiling.allocated_capex = Decimal("6000000.00")
        ceiling.allocated_mooe = Decimal("4000000.00")
    
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(ceiling)

    assert ceiling.allocated_capex == Decimal("6000000.00")
    assert ceiling.allocated_mooe == Decimal("4000000.00")
    assert ceiling.sub_ceiling == Decimal("10000000.00")
    
    ceiling.allocated_capex = Decimal("7500000.00")
    ceiling.allocated_mooe = Decimal("2500000.00")
    assert ceiling.sub_ceiling == Decimal("10000000.00")

    db.close()

def test_cybersecurity_controls_seeder_29_controls_and_splits():
    """
    Verifies POST /api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/seed-defaults:
    - Seeds all 29 official DICT Cybersecurity Controls.
    - Verifies both Part II.B.2 Existing (is_proposed=False) and Part III.A.2 Proposed (is_proposed=True) sets.
    - Ensures exactly 20 Mandatory controls and 9 Optional controls per phase.
    - Ensures all 7 official Security Domains are present with accurate per-domain splits.
    - Asserts idempotency (re-running the seeder does not create duplicates).
    """
    # 1. Clean slate for test period
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    db.query(CybersecurityControl).filter(CybersecurityControl.issp_period == "2026-2028").delete()
    db.commit()
    db.close()

    # 2. Call the seeder endpoint
    seed_res = client.post("/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/seed-defaults?issp_period=2026-2028")
    assert seed_res.status_code == 200
    seed_data = seed_res.json()
    assert seed_data["status"] == "success"

    # 3. Query Part II.B.2 Existing Controls (is_proposed=false)
    existing_res = client.get("/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls?issp_period=2026-2028&is_proposed=false")
    assert existing_res.status_code == 200
    existing_controls = existing_res.json()
    assert len(existing_controls) == 29

    mand_existing = [c for c in existing_controls if c["is_mandatory"]]
    opt_existing = [c for c in existing_controls if not c["is_mandatory"]]
    assert len(mand_existing) == 20
    assert len(opt_existing) == 9

    # 4. Query Part III.A.2 Proposed Controls (is_proposed=true)
    proposed_res = client.get("/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls?issp_period=2026-2028&is_proposed=true")
    assert proposed_res.status_code == 200
    proposed_controls = proposed_res.json()
    assert len(proposed_controls) == 29

    mand_proposed = [c for c in proposed_controls if c["is_mandatory"]]
    opt_proposed = [c for c in proposed_controls if not c["is_mandatory"]]
    assert len(mand_proposed) == 20
    assert len(opt_proposed) == 9

    # 5. Check domain coverage across all 7 Security Domains
    expected_domains = {
        "Physical Security",
        "Perimeter Security",
        "Network Security",
        "Endpoint Security",
        "Data Security",
        "Application Security",
        "Other Measures"
    }
    existing_domains = {c["control_domain"] for c in existing_controls}
    proposed_domains = {c["control_domain"] for c in proposed_controls}
    assert existing_domains == expected_domains
    assert proposed_domains == expected_domains

    # Verify per-domain splits match the official DICT specification:
    expected_splits = {
        "Physical Security": (3, 1),
        "Perimeter Security": (3, 1),
        "Network Security": (1, 1),
        "Endpoint Security": (3, 1),
        "Data Security": (3, 0),
        "Application Security": (1, 0),
        "Other Measures": (6, 5)
    }

    for dom, (expected_mand, expected_opt) in expected_splits.items():
        dom_controls = [c for c in existing_controls if c["control_domain"] == dom]
        mand_count = len([c for c in dom_controls if c["is_mandatory"]])
        opt_count = len([c for c in dom_controls if not c["is_mandatory"]])
        assert mand_count == expected_mand, f"{dom} mandatory count expected {expected_mand}, got {mand_count}"
        assert opt_count == expected_opt, f"{dom} optional count expected {expected_opt}, got {opt_count}"

    # 6. Verify idempotency: calling seed-defaults again does not create duplicate controls
    reseed_res = client.post("/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/seed-defaults?issp_period=2026-2028")
    assert reseed_res.status_code == 200
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    total_controls = db.query(CybersecurityControl).filter(CybersecurityControl.issp_period == "2026-2028").count()
    assert total_controls == 58  # 29 existing + 29 proposed
    db.close()

def test_coa_audit_logging_helper_and_auth_hook():
    """
    Verifies centralized COA immutable audit logging:
    - Asserts log_audit_event accurately records module, IP address, user_id, department_id, and state deltas.
    - Asserts authentication /login endpoint logs user logins in the audit trail.
    """
    db = TestingSessionLocal()

    # 1. Test centralized audit logger helper
    audit_entry = log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="GOVERNANCE_BUDGET_CEILING_OVERRIDE",
        module="GOVERNANCE",
        user_id=3,
        department_id=1,
        ip_address="192.168.1.100",
        old_value={"sub_ceiling": "15000000.00"},
        new_value={"sub_ceiling": "20000000.00"}
    )
    db.commit()

    assert audit_entry.id is not None
    persisted = db.query(AuditTrail).filter(AuditTrail.id == audit_entry.id).first()
    assert persisted is not None
    assert persisted.module == "GOVERNANCE"
    assert persisted.action == "GOVERNANCE_BUDGET_CEILING_OVERRIDE"
    assert persisted.ip_address == "192.168.1.100"
    assert persisted.department_id == 1
    assert persisted.old_value == {"sub_ceiling": "15000000.00"}
    assert persisted.new_value == {"sub_ceiling": "20000000.00"}

    # 2. Test user login audit hook via TestClient
    login_data = {
        "username": f"mis@{TEST_DOMAIN}",
        "password": "admin123"
    }
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", data=login_data)
    assert res.status_code == 200

    auth_log = db.query(AuditTrail).filter(
        AuditTrail.action == "USER_LOGIN_SUCCESS",
        AuditTrail.module == "AUTHENTICATION"
    ).order_by(AuditTrail.id.desc()).first()

    assert auth_log is not None
    assert auth_log.new_value.get("email") == f"mis@{TEST_DOMAIN}"
    assert auth_log.new_value.get("role") == RoleTag.ROLE_MIS_ADMIN.value

    db.delete(persisted)
    if auth_log:
        db.delete(auth_log)
    db.commit()
    db.close()

# track_resources.py
import sys
import time
import psutil

if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    print("Usage: python track_resources.py <PID_OF_CELERY_WORKER>")
    sys.exit(1)

pid = int(sys.argv[1])
try:
    process = psutil.Process(pid)
    print(f"Tracking process {pid} ({process.name()})")
    print("Time(s), CPU(%), Memory(MB)")
    
    start_time = time.time()
    while True:
        # Include child processes since Celery spawns pool workers
        children = process.children(recursive=True)
        total_cpu = process.cpu_percent(interval=0.1)
        total_memory_rss = process.memory_info().rss
        
        for child in children:
            try:
                total_cpu += child.cpu_percent(interval=None)
                total_memory_rss += child.memory_info().rss
            except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.AccessDenied):
                pass
                
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        mem_mb = total_memory_rss / (1024 * 1024)
        
        print(f"{elapsed:.1f}, {total_cpu:.1f}, {mem_mb:.1f}")
        time.sleep(1)
        
except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
    print(f"Process with PID {pid} has terminated.")
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("Monitoring stopped.")

# alembic/env.py
import os
import sys
from logging.config import fileConfig

from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool, text
from alembic import context
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Load environment configurations prior to importing application modules
load_dotenv()

# Add the project root directory to the system path to resolve app modules
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..')))

# Import target application models and global configurations
from app.database.models import Base
from app.config import settings

# This is the Alembic Config object, which provides access to alembic.ini options
config = context.config

# Interpret the config file for Python logging
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

# Add the application metadata for autogenerate detection
target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    """Run migrations in 'offline' mode.

    This configures the context with just a URL
    and not an Engine, though an Engine is acceptable
    here as well. By skipping the Engine creation
    we don't even need a DBAPI to be available.
    """
    # Overwrite static URL with active configuration to prevent environment mismatch
    url = settings.DATABASE_URL
    
    # Detect SQLite in offline mode via URL parsing
    is_sqlite = "sqlite" in url.lower()
    
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        # Conditionally render as batch to prevent table recreation issues on SQLite
        render_as_batch=is_sqlite,
        compare_type=True
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    """Run migrations in 'online' mode.

    In this scenario we need to create an Engine
    and associate a connection with the context.
    """
    url = settings.DATABASE_URL
    # Set the url dynamically inside the configuration block (prevents credential exposure)
    config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", url)

    connectable = engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        # Fix (Anomaly 3): Reliably detect SQLite via the dialect name rather than URL substrings
        is_sqlite = connection.dialect.name == "sqlite"

            connection.execute(text("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON"))

            connection=connection, 
            target_metadata=target_metadata,
            # Conditionally render as batch to prevent table recreation issues on SQLite
            render_as_batch=is_sqlite,
            # Ensure Alembic detects column type alterations (e.g. String to Text)
            compare_type=True
        )

        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()

    run_migrations_offline()

    run_migrations_online()

    1. Ensures 'subsystem_network_layouts_json' column exists.
    2. Migrates any non-null legacy URLs into 'subsystem_network_layouts_json'.
    3. Migrates 'b_3_a_ict_org_url' into 'existing_ict_org_url' if unpopulated.
    4. Drops the 10 legacy institution-specific physical columns.
    """
    bind = op.get_bind()
    inspector = sa.inspect(bind)
    table_names = inspector.get_table_names()

    if 'master_narratives' not in table_names:
        return

    cols = [c['name'] for c in inspector.get_columns('master_narratives')]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Ensure dynamic JSON store column exists
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    if 'subsystem_network_layouts_json' not in cols:
        with op.batch_alter_table('master_narratives', schema=None) as batch_op:
            batch_op.add_column(
                sa.Column(
                    'subsystem_network_layouts_json', 
                    sa.JSON(), 
                    server_default=sa.text("'[]'"), 
                    nullable=False
                )
            )
        cols.append('subsystem_network_layouts_json')

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Data Migration: Preserve legacy diagram URLs into JSON
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    legacy_col_system_map = {
        'net_layout_sias_url': 'Core Frontline Operations IS',
        'net_layout_sias_upgrade_url': 'Public Online Portals & E-Payment Gateways',
        'net_layout_extension_url': 'Regional Extension & Field Branch Linkages',
        'net_layout_library_url': 'Records & Knowledge Repository IS',
        'net_layout_security_url': 'Security Operations & Access Control',
        'net_layout_hris_url': 'Human Resource Information System (HRIS)',
        'net_layout_dms_url': 'Electronic Document Management System (EDMS)',
        'net_layout_supplies_url': 'Property, Supply & Asset Management IS',
        'net_layout_budget_url': 'Financial, Budget & Accounting IS',
    }

    existing_legacy_cols = [col for col in legacy_col_system_map.keys() if col in cols]

    if existing_legacy_cols:
        select_sql = (
            f"SELECT issp_period, subsystem_network_layouts_json, "
            f"{', '.join(existing_legacy_cols)} FROM master_narratives"
        )
        rows = bind.execute(sa.text(select_sql)).fetchall()

        for row in rows:
            issp_period = row[0]
            raw_layouts = row[1]

            if isinstance(raw_layouts, str):
                try:
                    layouts = json.loads(raw_layouts)
                except Exception:
                    layouts = []
            elif isinstance(raw_layouts, list):
                layouts = list(raw_layouts)
            else:
                layouts = []

            existing_names = {
                l.get('system_name', '').lower(): l 
                for l in layouts if isinstance(l, dict)
            }

            modified = False

                col_val = row[col_idx]

                        layouts.append({
                            'system_name': sys_name,
                            'diagram_url': url_clean,
                            'legacy_column': col_name
                        })
                        modified = True
                    elif not existing_names[sys_name.lower()].get('diagram_url'):
                        existing_names[sys_name.lower()]['diagram_url'] = url_clean
                        modified = True

            if modified:
                bind.execute(
                    sa.text(
                        "UPDATE master_narratives "
                        "SET subsystem_network_layouts_json = :layouts "
                        "WHERE issp_period = :period"
                    ),
                    {"layouts": json.dumps(layouts), "period": issp_period}
                )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------

    # -------------------------------------------------------------

            SET existing_ict_org_url = b_3_a_ict_org_url 
            WHERE (existing_ict_org_url IS NULL OR existing_ict_org_url = '') 
              AND b_3_a_ict_org_url IS NOT NULL 
              AND b_3_a_ict_org_url <> ''
        """))

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Drop legacy institution-specific physical columns
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    all_drop_cols = [
        'net_layout_sias_url',
        'net_layout_sias_upgrade_url',
        'net_layout_extension_url',
        'net_layout_library_url',
        'net_layout_security_url',
        'net_layout_hris_url',
        'net_layout_dms_url',
        'net_layout_supplies_url',
        'net_layout_budget_url',
        'b_3_a_ict_org_url'
    ]

# app/celery_app.py
import os
from celery import Celery
from app.config import settings

# Safely retrieve the Redis URL from settings, providing a robust default fallback
redis_url = getattr(settings, "REDIS_URL", "redis://localhost:6379/0")

# Initialize the Celery application using Redis broker and backend configurations
celery_app = Celery(
    "issp_tasks",
    broker=redis_url,
    backend=redis_url
)

# Apply global task execution, reliability, scalability, and security parameters
celery_app.conf.update(
    task_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    result_serializer="json",
    timezone="Asia/Manila",
    enable_utc=True,
    
    # Connection settings: Ensure resilience during worker startup if Redis boots slowly
    broker_connection_retry_on_startup=True,
    
    # Fix (Anomaly 25): Restart child processes after a low threshold to prevent WeasyPrint memory leaks
    worker_max_tasks_per_child=getattr(settings, "CELERY_WORKER_MAX_TASKS_PER_CHILD", 5),
    
    # Concurrency: Limit prefetching to 1 task per worker to balance heavy PDF compilation tasks
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,
    
    # Reliability: Acknowledge tasks only after completion so crashes can be recovered safely
    task_acks_late=True,
    
    # Fix (Anomaly 22): Reject and requeue tasks if a worker process terminates abruptly mid-task
    task_reject_on_worker_lost=getattr(settings, "CELERY_TASK_REJECT_ON_WORKER_LOST", True),
    
    # Lifecycle settings: Extended timeouts to accommodate 300+ page dual-pass compilation
    task_soft_time_limit=getattr(settings, "CELERY_TASK_SOFT_TIME_LIMIT", 1500),  # 25 minutes soft limit
    task_time_limit=getattr(settings, "CELERY_TASK_TIME_LIMIT", 1800),            # 30 minutes hard limit watchdog
    
    # Track the started state to let the frontend identify ongoing background tasks
    task_track_started=True,
    
    # Storage: Automatically expire and prune task results from Redis cache after 24 hours
    result_expires=86400,

    # Periodic Celery Beat Schedule: Automated evaluation of active cycle expiration and archival
    beat_schedule={
        "evaluate-cycle-rollover-daily": {
            "task": "app.tasks.maintenance_tasks.check_cycle_expiration_job",
            "schedule": 86400.0,  # Executes every 24 hours
        },
    },

    # Force registration of tasks on worker startup to prevent KeyError anomalies
    imports=[
        "app.tasks.pdf_tasks",
        "app.tasks.maintenance_tasks"
    ]
)

# Enable automatic task discovery within the tasks package to register modules dynamically
celery_app.autodiscover_tasks(["app.tasks"])

    elif _raw_env in ["test", "testing"]:

    else:

    raise ValueError("Insecure environment configuration: DEFAULT_SEED_PASSWORD must be explicitly configured in all environments.")

# Enforce secure pre-flight checks if storage mode is configured for S3 target buckets
if settings.STORAGE_TYPE == "s3":
    if not settings.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or not settings.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:
        logger.error("STORAGE CONFIGURATION FAILURE: S3 credentials are missing.")

    if not settings.AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME:

        raise ValueError("Invalid storage configuration: AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME must be specified when STORAGE_TYPE='s3'.")

# Check for Celery worker environment database synchronization risks
is_celery_worker = "CELERY_TASK_NAMES" in os.environ or any("celery" in arg.lower() for arg in getattr(sys, "argv", []))
if is_celery_worker:
    logger.info("Worker runtime detected. Verifying database connection sync parameters...")
    if "sqlite" in settings.DATABASE_URL.lower():
        logger.warning(
            "Celery worker is running with a local SQLite database configuration. "
            "Ensure the worker container shares the exact same physical DB file volume path "
            "as the FastAPI web server to prevent transaction and state mismatch anomalies."
        )
    elif settings.DATABASE_URL == "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/issp_core":
        logger.warning(
            "Celery worker is running with the default PostgreSQL fallback URL. "
            "If your FastAPI server is using a different database setup, "
            "background tasks may fail to locate newly registered proposals due to database mismatch. "
            "Verify that the worker's DATABASE_URL matches the core web server's environment configuration."
        )

    )

class BusinessRuleViolation(ValueError):
    """
    Exception raised when an action or database update violates an active 
    ISSP business rule, budget ceiling constraint, or compliance policy.
    
    Inherits from ValueError to maintain backward-compatibility with validation 
    handlers while providing a distinct class name for explicit matching.
    """
    def __init__(self, message: str):
        self.message = message
        super().__init__(message)


class DecryptionError(Exception):
    """
    Exception raised specifically when cryptographic decryption fails during 
    the parsing of EncryptedJSON database columns (e.g., due to key rotation mismatch, 
    incorrect salt evaluation, or payload corruption).
    """
    def __init__(self, message: str = "Cryptographic decryption failed. Data corruption or incorrect key detected."):
        self.message = message
        super().__init__(message)

def patch_runtime_enum_columns():
    """
    Patches column type processors dynamically so that:
    1. Native PostgreSQL Enum columns bind uppercase enum names (e.g. 'FUNCTIONAL').
    2. VARCHAR columns storing human-readable string values deserialize cleanly.
    """
    if hasattr(models_module, 'enforce_issp_singularity_and_accounting'):
        models_module.enforce_issp_singularity_and_accounting.__globals__['item_lower'] = ''

    native_enum_columns = {
        ("existing_inventory", "status"): (AssetStatus, True),
        ("issp_core", "status"): (ProposalStatus, True),
        ("issp_core", "category"): (ProposalCategory, True),
        ("issp_nodes", "node_type"): (NodeType, True),
        ("issp_nodes", "page_orientation"): (PageOrientation, True),
        ("issp_contents", "content_type"): (ContentType, True),
        ("issp_assets", "asset_role"): (AssetRole, True),
        ("users", "role_tag"): (RoleTag, True),
    }

    varchar_enum_columns = {
        ("issp_core", "strategic_category"): (ProjectCategory, False),
        ("issp_core", "office_location"): (OfficeLocation, False),
        ("issp_core", "fund_source"): (FundSource, False),
        ("issp_core", "uacs_object_code"): (UacsObjectCode, False),
        ("issp_core", "expenditure_class"): (ExpenditureClass, False),
        ("issp_core", "system_development_status"): (SystemDevelopmentStatus, False),
        ("existing_inventory", "office_location"): (OfficeLocation, False),
        ("information_systems", "status"): (SystemStatus, False),
        ("information_systems", "classification"): (SystemClassification, False),
        ("information_systems", "hosting_type"): (SystemHostingType, False),
        ("information_systems", "development_strategy"): (DevelopmentStrategy, False),
        ("ict_projects", "project_category"): (ProjectCategory, False),
        ("ict_projects", "funding_source"): (FundSource, False),
        ("master_narratives", "scope_choice"): (ScopeChoice, False),
    }

    if hasattr(models_module, 'DictAssetCategory'):
        varchar_enum_columns[("existing_inventory", "dict_category")] = (getattr(models_module, 'DictAssetCategory'), False)

    configs = {**native_enum_columns, **varchar_enum_columns}

    # Patch Table columns
    for table in Base.metadata.tables.values():
        for column in table.columns:
            key = (table.name, column.name)
            if key in configs:
                enum_cls, send_name = configs[key]
                column.type = SafeEnumType(enum_cls, send_name=send_name)

    # Patch ORM class mappers
    for mapper in Base.registry.mappers:
        t_name = mapper.local_table.name
        for prop in mapper.column_attrs:
            for col in prop.columns:
                key = (t_name, col.name)
                if key in configs:
                    enum_cls, send_name = configs[key]
                    col.type = SafeEnumType(enum_cls, send_name=send_name)


def align_database_schemas(engine):
    """
    Defensively inspects target database tables at runtime and appends any
    columns defined in the canonical models that are physically missing.
    Uses nested savepoints (conn.begin_nested()) to guarantee that a failure
    in any single statement never aborts the overall transaction in PostgreSQL.
    Converts legacy native ENUM columns (system_development_status, scope_choice)
    to standard VARCHAR types to prevent InvalidTextRepresentation crashes.
    Strips static institutional server defaults so configuration parameters govern values.
    """
    logger.info("Running defensive schema alignment checks...")
    is_sqlite = "sqlite" in settings.DATABASE_URL.lower()
    bool_false = "0" if is_sqlite else "false"
    bool_true = "1" if is_sqlite else "true"
    uuid_type = "VARCHAR(36)"

    def safe_exec(connection, sql_statement, params=None):
        try:
            with connection.begin_nested():
                connection.execute(sql_statement, params or {})
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Defensive statement bypassed: {e}")

    with engine.begin() as conn:
        if not is_sqlite:
            # 1. Safely terminate orphan idle transactions
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) 
                FROM pg_stat_activity 
                WHERE datname = current_database() 
                  AND pid <> pg_backend_pid() 
                  AND state IN ('idle in transaction', 'idle in transaction (aborted)');
            """))
            safe_exec(conn, text("SET lock_timeout = '5s';"))

            # Drop broken custom operators that hijack standard varchar comparisons
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    DROP OPERATOR IF EXISTS public.=(character varying, uuid) CASCADE;
                    DROP OPERATOR IF EXISTS public.=(uuid, character varying) CASCADE;
                    DROP OPERATOR IF EXISTS public.=(character, uuid) CASCADE;
                    DROP OPERATOR IF EXISTS public.=(uuid, character) CASCADE;
                    DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.varchar_eq_uuid(character varying, uuid) CASCADE;
                    DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.uuid_eq_varchar(uuid, character varying) CASCADE;
                    DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.bpchar_eq_uuid(character, uuid) CASCADE;
                    DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.uuid_eq_bpchar(uuid, character) CASCADE;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

            # Add implicit cast compatibility so uuid = varchar comparisons never fail
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM pg_cast 
                        WHERE castsource = 'character varying'::regtype 
                          AND casttarget = 'uuid'::regtype
                    ) THEN
                        CREATE CAST (character varying AS uuid) WITH INOUT AS IMPLICIT;
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM pg_cast 
                        WHERE castsource = 'uuid'::regtype 
                          AND casttarget = 'character varying'::regtype
                    ) THEN
                        CREATE CAST (uuid AS character varying) WITH INOUT AS IMPLICIT;
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

            # Defensive Alter: Convert users.role_tag from ENUM to VARCHAR(100)
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 
                        FROM information_schema.columns 
                        WHERE table_name = 'users' 
                          AND column_name = 'role_tag' 
                          AND (data_type = 'USER-DEFINED' OR udt_name = 'roletag')
                    ) THEN
                        ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN role_tag DROP DEFAULT;
                        ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN role_tag TYPE VARCHAR(100) USING role_tag::text;
                        ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN role_tag SET DEFAULT 'ROLE_DEPT_USER';
                        DROP TYPE IF EXISTS roletag CASCADE;
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

            # Defensive Alter: Convert issp_core.system_development_status from ENUM to VARCHAR(100)
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 
                        FROM information_schema.columns 
                        WHERE table_name = 'issp_core' 
                          AND column_name = 'system_development_status' 
                          AND (data_type = 'USER-DEFINED' OR udt_name = 'systemdevelopmentstatus')
                    ) THEN
                        ALTER TABLE issp_core ALTER COLUMN system_development_status DROP DEFAULT;
                        ALTER TABLE issp_core ALTER COLUMN system_development_status TYPE VARCHAR(100) USING system_development_status::text;
                        ALTER TABLE issp_core ALTER COLUMN system_development_status SET DEFAULT 'N/A';
                        UPDATE issp_core SET system_development_status = 'For Development' WHERE system_development_status ILIKE '%development%';
                        UPDATE issp_core SET system_development_status = 'For Enhancement' WHERE system_development_status ILIKE '%enhancement%';
                        UPDATE issp_core SET system_development_status = 'N/A' WHERE system_development_status IS NULL OR system_development_status NOT IN ('For Development', 'For Enhancement');
                        DROP TYPE IF EXISTS systemdevelopmentstatus CASCADE;
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

            # Defensive Alter: Convert master_narratives.scope_choice from ENUM to VARCHAR(100)
            safe_exec(conn, text("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 
                        FROM information_schema.columns 
                        WHERE table_name = 'master_narratives' 
                          AND column_name = 'scope_choice' 
                          AND (data_type = 'USER-DEFINED' OR udt_name = 'scopechoice')
                    ) THEN
                        ALTER TABLE master_narratives ALTER COLUMN scope_choice DROP DEFAULT;
                        ALTER TABLE master_narratives ALTER COLUMN scope_choice TYPE VARCHAR(100) USING scope_choice::text;
                        ALTER TABLE master_narratives ALTER COLUMN scope_choice SET DEFAULT 'Department-Wide';
                        DROP TYPE IF EXISTS scopechoice CASCADE;
                    END IF;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    NULL;
                END $$;
            """))

        # Inspect database tables safely
        inspector = inspect(conn)
        table_names = inspector.get_table_names()

        # 1. Patch 'master_narratives' table (Zero Hardcoding, DICT Co-Branding & MITHI Res 2025-01 Compliance)

            }
            for col_name, col_def in columns_to_sync_proj.items():

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    """
    Handles application startup and shutdown procedures safely.
    Defensively verifies schemas, patches runtime enums, neutralizes operator conflicts,
    and automatically executes cycle expiration / rollover checks.
    """
    agency_label = getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME", "INSTITUTIONAL")
    logger.info("=" * 70)
    logger.info(f"INITIALIZING {agency_label.upper()} E-ISSP COMPLIANCE ENGINE (DICT v.2026)")
    logger.info("=" * 70)
    
    # 0. Defensively patch models listener globals
    if hasattr(models_module, 'enforce_issp_singularity_and_accounting'):
        models_module.enforce_issp_singularity_and_accounting.__globals__['item_lower'] = ''

    # 1. Defensive Schema Alignment & Operator Sanitization
    try:
        align_database_schemas(engine)
    except Exception as schema_err:
        logger.error(f"Defensive schema alignment encountered a non-fatal warning: {str(schema_err)}")

    # 2. Defensively patch all mapped Enum columns for runtime reflection
    try:
        patch_runtime_enum_columns()
    except Exception as enum_err:
        logger.error(f"Runtime enum column patching warning: {str(enum_err)}")

    # 3. Verify and compile database schema structures
    try:
        logger.info("Verifying and registering database schema metadata...")
        Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
        logger.info("Database base tables verified successfully.")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.critical(f"Failed to initialize metadata tables on startup: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)

    # 4. Automated Lifecycle Rollover Evaluation on Startup
    try:
        with SessionLocal() as db:
            from app.services.lifecycle_service import ISSPLifecycleEngine
            rollover_res = ISSPLifecycleEngine.evaluate_and_rollover_cycle(db)
            logger.info(f"Lifecycle evaluation on boot: {rollover_res.get('status')} - {rollover_res.get('message', '')}")
    except Exception as lc_err:
        logger.warning(f"Lifecycle startup check note: {str(lc_err)}")

    # 5. Scan and Log Registered Routing Tables
    logger.info("Scanning active API routing tables...")
    routes_registered = []
    for route in app.routes:
        methods = getattr(route, "methods", None)
        methods_str = f"[{', '.join(methods)}]" if methods else "[STATIC/WS]"
        routes_registered.append(f"  -> {route.path} {methods_str}")
        
    for r in sorted(routes_registered):
        logger.info(r)
        
    logger.info(f"Scan complete: {len(app.routes)} active routes registered.")
    logger.info("=" * 70)
    
    yield  # Application serves incoming requests
    
    logger.info("=" * 70)
    logger.info(f"SHUTTING DOWN {agency_label.upper()} E-ISSP COMPLIANCE ENGINE")
    logger.info("De-allocating connection pool and worker instances...")
    logger.info("=" * 70)


# Initialize the FastAPI application using dynamic settings
app_title = f"{getattr(settings, 'DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME', 'e-ISSP')} Compliance Backend Engine"

app = FastAPI(

    description="Singular governance engine supporting DICT standard compliance, 4-way financial parity, and automated dual-pass PDF rendering.",
    version="5.0",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
    lifespan=lifespan
)

# ==========================================================
# DIAGNOSTICS & REQUEST TRACKING MIDDLEWARE
# ==========================================================

@app.middleware("http")
async def log_requests(request: Request, call_next):
    """
    Tracks and logs every incoming network request, processing duration, and response status.
    Ensures safe database session rollback upon unhandled errors.
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    logger.info(f"Incoming Request: {request.method} {request.url.path}")
    try:
        response = await call_next(request)
        process_time_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
        logger.info(
            f"Outgoing Response: {request.method} {request.url.path} - "
            f"Status: {response.status_code} - Latency: {process_time_ms:.2f}ms"
        )
        return response
    except Exception as exc:
        try:
            db_session.rollback()
            logger.info("Interception: Scoped database session rolled back cleanly.")
        except Exception as db_exc:
            logger.error(f"Failed to roll back database session on request exception: {str(db_exc)}")
        finally:
            db_session.remove()

        process_time_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
        logger.error(
            f"Request failed: {request.method} {request.url.path} - "
            f"Latency: {process_time_ms:.2f}ms - Unhandled Exception: {str(exc)}",
            exc_info=True
        )
        raise exc


# ==========================================================
# CORS-SAFE EXCEPTION HANDLERS
# ==========================================================

def get_cors_headers(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:
    headers = {}
    origin = request.headers.get("origin")
    if origin:
        if origin in cors_origins:
            headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origin
            headers["Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"] = "true"
        elif "*" in cors_origins:
            headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
    return headers


@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):
    logger.warning(f"Request schema validation failed: {exc.errors()}")
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        headers=get_cors_headers(request),
        content={"detail": jsonable_encoder(exc.errors())}
    )


@app.exception_handler(DecryptionError)
async def decryption_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: DecryptionError):
    logger.critical(f"Internal cryptographic failure: {str(exc)}")
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        headers=get_cors_headers(request),
        content={"detail": "An internal system cryptographic error occurred during data processing."}
    )


@app.exception_handler(BusinessRuleViolation)
async def business_rule_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: BusinessRuleViolation):
    logger.warning(f"Business constraint failure intercepted: {str(exc)}")
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
        headers=get_cors_headers(request),
        content={"detail": str(exc)}
    )


@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        headers=get_cors_headers(request),
        content={"detail": exc.detail}
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def global_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    raw_error_message = str(exc)
    sanitized_error = raw_error_message
    for keyword in ["password", "secret", "token", "key", "private", "database_url"]:
        if keyword in sanitized_error.lower():
            sanitized_error = f"[REDACTED_SENSITIVE_DATA_CONTAINING_{keyword.upper()}]"
            break

    logger.error(f"Unhandled Exception: {sanitized_error}", exc_info=exc)
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        headers=get_cors_headers(request),
        content={"detail": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)}"}
    )

# ==========================================================
# SANITIZATION & DESERIALIZATION UTILITIES
# ==========================================================

def sanitize_text(v: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if v is not None:
        return html.escape(v.strip())
    return v

def clean_optional_string(v: Any) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Coerces empty strings, whitespace, or string representations of null
    ('null', 'none', 'undefined', '') into None.
    """
    if v is None:
        return None
    s = str(v).strip()
    if not s or s.lower() in ("none", "null", "undefined", ""):
        return None
    return s

def deserialize_json_if_string(v: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(v, str):
        v_clean = v.strip()
        if (v_clean.startswith("{") and v_clean.endswith("}")) or (v_clean.startswith("[") and v_clean.endswith("]")):
            try:
                return json.loads(v_clean)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return v

def deserialize_list_if_string(v: Any) -> List[Any]:
    if v is None:
        return []
    res = deserialize_json_if_string(v)
    return res if isinstance(res, list) else []

def deserialize_dict_if_string(v: Any) -> Dict[Any, Any]:
    if v is None:
        return {}
    res = deserialize_json_if_string(v)
    return res if isinstance(res, dict) else {}

def coerce_optional_uuid(v: Any) -> Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]]:
    """
    Safely converts empty strings, string UUIDs, or None to Optional[uuid.UUID] or string.
    Prevents Pydantic validation failures when frontend components submit empty selectors.
    """
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, uuid.UUID):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, str):
        v_clean = v.strip()
        if not v_clean or v_clean.lower() in ("none", "null", "undefined", ""):
            return None
        try:
            return uuid.UUID(v_clean)
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            return v_clean
    return v

def coerce_enum(enum_cls: Any, v: Any) -> Any:
    """
    Bi-directional, case-insensitive enum coercion.
    Resolves member names, values, and SafeEnumStr instances seamlessly.
    """
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, enum_cls):
        return v
    v_str = str(getattr(v, "value", v)).strip()
    if not v_str or v_str.lower() in ("none", "null", "undefined", ""):
        return None

    # 1. Exact value or name match
    for member in enum_cls:
        if member.value == v_str or member.name == v_str:
            return member

    # 2. Case-insensitive value or name match
    v_lower = v_str.lower()
    for member in enum_cls:
        if member.value.lower() == v_lower or member.name.lower() == v_lower:
            return member

    # 3. Normalized underscore/space match
    v_normalized = v_lower.replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")
    for member in enum_cls:
        if member.name.lower() == v_normalized:
            return member

    try:
        return enum_cls(v_str)
    except Exception:
        for member in enum_cls:
            if v_lower in member.value.lower() or member.name.lower() in v_lower:
                return member
        return v

class IctProjectCreate(BaseModel):
    system_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None
    project_title: str = Field(..., max_length=255, example="Enterprise Cloud Infrastructure Modernization")
    project_category: ProjectCategory = Field(default=ProjectCategory.INTERNAL_ICT_PROJECT)
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    objectives: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    aligns_pip: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_ncsp: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_egmp: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_pcb: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_others: bool = Field(default=False, description="DICT Part III.E Strategic Alignment 'Others (Specify)'")
    aligns_others_specify: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=255, description="Specific program if aligns_others is True")
    harmonizes_national_priority: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_resource_optimization: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_pegif: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_cross_collaboration: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_scalability: bool = Field(default=False)
    duration_start_year: Optional[int] = Field(default=2026, example=2026)
    duration_end_year: Optional[int] = Field(default=2028, example=2028)
    
    # Dynamic annual deliverables dictionary supporting arbitrary year spans (1 to N years)
    annual_deliverables: Dict[str, str] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, 
        description="Dynamic year-keyed deliverables map, e.g. {'Year 1': '...', 'Year 2': '...'}"
    )
    
    # Backward-compatible properties for 3-year templates
    year_1_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    year_2_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    year_3_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    
    implementing_unit: Optional[str] = Field(default="ICT Management Office")
    funding_source: FundSource = Field(default=FundSource.GAA)
    lead_agency: Optional[str] = None
    partner_agencies: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator('system_id', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_system_id(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_optional_uuid(v)

    @field_validator('project_category', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_proj_cat(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(ProjectCategory, v) or ProjectCategory.INTERNAL_ICT_PROJECT

    @field_validator('funding_source', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_funding(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(FundSource, v) or FundSource.GAA

    @field_validator('annual_deliverables', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_annual_deliverables(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, str]:
        parsed = deserialize_dict_if_string(v)
        return {str(k): str(val) for k, val in parsed.items()} if parsed else {}

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def sync_deliverables(self) -> 'IctProjectCreate':
        if not self.annual_deliverables:
            deliverables = {}
            if self.year_1_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 1"] = self.year_1_deliverables
            if self.year_2_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 2"] = self.year_2_deliverables
            if self.year_3_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 3"] = self.year_3_deliverables
            self.annual_deliverables = deliverables
        else:
            if not self.year_1_deliverables and "Year 1" in self.annual_deliverables:
                self.year_1_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables["Year 1"]
            if not self.year_2_deliverables and "Year 2" in self.annual_deliverables:
                self.year_2_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables["Year 2"]
            if not self.year_3_deliverables and "Year 3" in self.annual_deliverables:
                self.year_3_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables["Year 3"]
        return self

    def coerce_fund_source(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(FundSource, v) or FundSource.GAA

    @field_validator('system_development_status', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_dev_status(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(SystemDevelopmentStatus, v) or SystemDevelopmentStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE

    @field_validator('item_name', 'justification', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def clean_and_sanitize_inputs(cls, v: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
        return sanitize_text(v)

    @field_validator('yearly_quantities', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_quantities(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, int]:
        parsed = deserialize_dict_if_string(v)
        res = {}
        for key, val in parsed.items():
            try:
                res[str(key)] = int(val) if val is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                res[str(key)] = 0
        return res

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def validate_and_classify_outlays(self) -> 'ProposalCreatePayload':
        if self.is_in_house_turnover is not None and not self.created_by_students:
            self.created_by_students = self.is_in_house_turnover
        elif self.created_by_students and self.is_in_house_turnover is None:
            self.is_in_house_turnover = True

        if self.yearly_quantities and len(self.yearly_quantities) > 0:
            years_sorted = sorted([k for k in self.yearly_quantities.keys() if str(k).isdigit()])
            if len(years_sorted) >= 1:
                self.year_1_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[0], 0) or 0)
            if len(years_sorted) >= 2:
                self.year_2_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[1], 0) or 0)
            if len(years_sorted) >= 3:
                self.year_3_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[2], 0) or 0)
        else:
            self.yearly_quantities = {
                "Year 1": self.year_1_qty,
                "Year 2": self.year_2_qty,
                "Year 3": self.year_3_qty
            }

        total_qty = sum(int(v) for v in self.yearly_quantities.values() if v is not None and (isinstance(v, int) or str(v).isdigit()))
        total_outlay = self.unit_cost * Decimal(total_qty)

        if self.created_by_students:
            self.expenditure_class = ExpenditureClass.CAPITAL_OUTLAY
            self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE
        else:
            CAPITALIZATION_THRESHOLD = Decimal("50000.00")
            item_lower = (self.item_name or "").lower()

            if self.category == ProposalCategory.SUBSCRIPTION:
                self.expenditure_class = ExpenditureClass.MOOE
                self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION
            elif self.unit_cost >= CAPITALIZATION_THRESHOLD:
                self.expenditure_class = ExpenditureClass.CAPITAL_OUTLAY
                if "printer" in item_lower or "scanner" in item_lower or "plotter" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.PRINTING_EQUIPMENT
                elif "software" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE
                else:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_EQUIPMENT
            else:
                self.expenditure_class = ExpenditureClass.MOOE
                if "printer" in item_lower or "scanner" in item_lower or "plotter" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.SEMI_EXPENDABLE_PRINTING
                elif "subscription" in item_lower or "cloud" in item_lower or "suite" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION
                elif "training" in item_lower or "seminar" in item_lower or "workshop" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_TRAINING
                elif "contractor" in item_lower or "development" in item_lower:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.ICT_CONSULTING_DEVELOPMENT
                else:
                    self.uacs_object_code = UacsObjectCode.SEMI_EXPENDABLE_ICT

            if self.item_select == "other":
                if not self.justification or len(self.justification.strip()) < 5:
                    raise ValueError("Technical specifications and justification are mandatory for custom requests.")

        if total_outlay >= Decimal("2000000.00") and self.system_development_status == SystemDevelopmentStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE:
            raise ValueError(
                "Proposals with total outlays exceeding ₱2,000,000.00 require a System Development Status option "
                "('For Development' or 'For Enhancement') per DICT guidelines."
            )

        return self

class UpdateCeilingPayload(BaseModel):
    department_id: int
    allocated_capex: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal("0.00"), ge=0)
    allocated_mooe: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal("0.00"), ge=0)
    sub_ceiling: Optional[Decimal] = None

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def resolve_sub_ceiling_assignment(self) -> 'UpdateCeilingPayload':
        """
        Ensures sub_ceiling matches allocated_capex and allocated_mooe without
        forcing an arbitrary 70/30 split ratio.
        """
        if self.sub_ceiling is not None and self.allocated_capex == Decimal("0.00") and self.allocated_mooe == Decimal("0.00"):
            self.allocated_capex = Decimal(str(self.sub_ceiling)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
            self.allocated_mooe = Decimal("0.00")
        return self

    global_ceiling: Decimal = Field(..., gt=0)

        if not self.agency_name:
            self.agency_name = getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME", "National Government Agency")
        self.website_url = self.agency_website_url
        return self

    department_id: Optional[int] = None
    department_name: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator('role_tag', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_role(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(RoleTag, v)

    @model_validator(mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def populate_attributes(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            dept_id = data.get("department_id") or data.get("assigned_department_id")
            data["assigned_department_id"] = dept_id
            data["department_id"] = dept_id
            if "department" in data and isinstance(data["department"], dict):
                data["department_name"] = data["department"].get("name")
            return data
        
        dept_id = getattr(data, "department_id", None)
        dept_rel = getattr(data, "department", None)
        dept_name = dept_rel.name if dept_rel else None

        return {
            "id": getattr(data, "id", None),
            "email": getattr(data, "email", None),
            "role_tag": getattr(data, "role_tag", None),
            "assigned_department_id": dept_id,
            "department_id": dept_id,
            "department_name": dept_name
        }

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    @field_validator('yearly_quantities', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_fields(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, int]:
        parsed = deserialize_dict_if_string(v)
        res = {}
        for key, val in parsed.items():
            try:
                res[str(key)] = int(val) if val is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                res[str(key)] = 0
        return res

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

# 0. DOCUMENT TREE ARCHITECTURE APIS

@router.get("/issp/document-tree", response_model=List[IsspNodeResponse])
def get_issp_document_tree(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        all_nodes = db.query(IsspNode).options(
            joinedload(IsspNode.vocabulary),
            selectinload(IsspNode.contents),
            selectinload(IsspNode.assets)
        ).order_by(IsspNode.sequence_order.asc()).all()
        
        return [node for node in all_nodes if node.parent_id is None]
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to query document tree: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to load document skeleton tree.")


@router.put("/issp/reorder")
def reorder_issp_nodes(
    payload: IsspNodeReorderPayload,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        node = db.query(IsspNode).filter(IsspNode.id == payload.node_id).first()
        if not node:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Document node not found.")

        node.parent_id = payload.parent_id if payload.parent_id != 0 else None
        node.sequence_order = payload.sequence_order
        db.commit()
        return {"status": "success", "message": "Document node hierarchy reordered successfully."}
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to reorder issp nodes: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database failure during node reordering.")


@router.post("/issp/assets", response_model=IsspAssetResponse)
async def upload_issp_asset(
    node_id: int = Query(...),
    asset_role: AssetRole = Query(...),
    custom_title: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    aspect_ratio_preserve: bool = Query(True),
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        node = db.query(IsspNode).filter(IsspNode.id == node_id).first()
        if not node:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Target document node not found.")

        file_bytes = await file.read()
        is_valid_file = (
            file_bytes.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") or
            file_bytes.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff") or
            file_bytes.startswith(b"GIF8") or
            file_bytes.startswith(b"%PDF-")
        )
        if not is_valid_file:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail="Security Violation: Invalid format. Only PNG, JPG, or PDF files are permitted."
            )

        safe_filename = secure_filename(file.filename)
        key = storage_client.get_diagram_key(asset_role.value, safe_filename)
        success = storage_client.upload_canvas_evidence(file_bytes, key)
        if not success:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to write diagram asset to storage.")

        download_url = storage_client.generate_download_url(key)
        if asset_role == AssetRole.FULL_PAGE_DIAGRAM:
            node.force_page_break = True

        new_asset = IsspAsset(
            node_id=node_id,
            file_path=download_url,
            asset_role=asset_role,
            custom_title=custom_title,
            aspect_ratio_preserve=aspect_ratio_preserve
        )
        db.add(new_asset)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_asset)
        return new_asset
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to upload asset: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database failure during asset uploading.")


@router.post("/issp/nodes", response_model=IsspNodeResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

            force_page_break=payload.force_page_break
        )
        db.add(new_node)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_node)
        return new_node
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to create document node: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database failure during node creation.")


@router.put("/issp/nodes/{node_id}", response_model=IsspNodeResponse)
def update_issp_node(
    node_id: int,
    payload: IsspNodeUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        node = db.query(IsspNode).filter(IsspNode.id == node_id).first()
        if not node:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Document node not found.")

        if payload.node_type is not None:
            node.node_type = payload.node_type
        if payload.system_key is not None:
            node.system_key = payload.system_key
        if payload.sequence_order is not None:
            node.sequence_order = payload.sequence_order
        if payload.page_orientation is not None:
            node.page_orientation = payload.page_orientation
        if payload.force_page_break is not None:
            node.force_page_break = payload.force_page_break
        if payload.parent_id is not None:
            node.parent_id = payload.parent_id if payload.parent_id != 0 else None

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(node)
        return node
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to update document node: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database failure during node updates.")

@router.delete("/outcomes/{outcome_id}")
def delete_organizational_outcome(
    outcome_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    outcome = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(OrganizationalOutcome.id == outcome_id).first()
    if not outcome:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Organizational Outcome program not found.")
    
    linked_proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.outcome_id == outcome_id).count()
    if linked_proposals > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Cannot delete program outcome. There are {linked_proposals} active proposals linked to it."
        )

    db.delete(outcome)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Outcome category purged successfully."}

    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    concern = db.query(StrategicConcern).filter(StrategicConcern.id == concern_id).first()
    if not concern:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Strategic concern record not found.")

    concern.outcome_id = payload.outcome_id
    concern.mfo = payload.mfo
    concern.critical_system = payload.critical_system
    concern.problems = payload.problems
    concern.intended_use = payload.intended_use
    concern.order_index = payload.order_index

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(concern)
    return concern


@router.delete("/concerns/{concern_id}")
def delete_strategic_concern(
    concern_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    concern = db.query(StrategicConcern).filter(StrategicConcern.id == concern_id).first()
    if not concern:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Strategic concern not found.")
    
    if concern.needs_assessments:
        for na in concern.needs_assessments:
            na.is_aggregated = False
            na.strategic_concern_id = None

    db.delete(concern)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Strategic concern purged."}


@router.get("/needs-assessments", response_model=List[NeedsAssessmentResponse])
def get_all_needs_assessments(
    dept_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    is_aggregated: Optional[bool] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """
    Returns all departmental Needs Assessments across all organizational units.
    Enables MIS Admin to review and aggregate them into Part II.A Strategic Concerns.
    """
    query = db.query(NeedsAssessment).options(joinedload(NeedsAssessment.department)).filter(
        NeedsAssessment.is_archived == False
    )
    if dept_id:
        query = query.filter(NeedsAssessment.department_id == dept_id)
    if is_aggregated is not None:
        query = query.filter(NeedsAssessment.is_aggregated == is_aggregated)

    records = query.order_by(NeedsAssessment.department_id.asc()).all()
    res = []
    for na in records:
        resp = NeedsAssessmentResponse.model_validate(na)
        resp.department_name = na.department.name if na.department else f"Dept {na.department_id}"
        res.append(resp)
    return res


@router.post("/concerns/aggregate-from-needs", response_model=StrategicConcernResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def aggregate_needs_into_strategic_concern(
    payload: AggregateNeedsAssessmentPayload,
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """
    Converts/Aggregates a department Needs Assessment into an official Part II.A Strategic Concern.
    Establishes bidirectional provenance:
    NeedsAssessment.strategic_concern_id = concern.id
    NeedsAssessment.is_aggregated = True
    """
    period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    na = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(NeedsAssessment.id == payload.needs_assessment_id).first()
    if not na:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Needs Assessment record not found.")

    concern = StrategicConcern(
        issp_period=period,
        outcome_id=payload.outcome_id,
        mfo=payload.mfo,
        critical_system=payload.critical_system,
        problems=payload.problems,
        intended_use=payload.intended_use,
        order_index=payload.order_index
    )
    db.add(concern)
    db.flush()

    na.is_aggregated = True
    na.strategic_concern_id = concern.id

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(concern)
    return concern

@router.post("/cybersecurity-controls/seed-defaults")
def seed_default_cybersecurity_controls(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """
    Seeds all 29 official DICT Cybersecurity Controls (20 Mandatory and 9 Optional)
    across all 7 Security Domains for both Part II.B.2 (Existing) and Part III.A.2 (Proposed) if missing.
    """
    period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    
    OFFICIAL_DICT_CONTROLS = [
        # 1. PHYSICAL SECURITY
        {"domain": "Physical Security", "name": "Perimeter Protection", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Physical Security", "name": "Access Control", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Physical Security", "name": "Surveillance System", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Physical Security", "name": "Detection System", "mandatory": False},

        # 2. PERIMETER SECURITY
        {"domain": "Perimeter Security", "name": "Next Generation Firewalls", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Perimeter Security", "name": "Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS)", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Perimeter Security", "name": "Web Application Firewalls (WAFs)", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Perimeter Security", "name": "Demilitarized Zone (DMZ)", "mandatory": False},

        # 3. NETWORK SECURITY
        {"domain": "Network Security", "name": "Data Encryption", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Network Security", "name": "Network Segmentation", "mandatory": False},

        # 4. ENDPOINT SECURITY
        {"domain": "Endpoint Security", "name": "Anti-virus and Anti-malware Software", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Endpoint Security", "name": "Application Control", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Endpoint Security", "name": "BYOD Security", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Endpoint Security", "name": "Extended Detection and Response (XDR)", "mandatory": False},

        # 5. DATA SECURITY
        {"domain": "Data Security", "name": "Data Classification", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Data Security", "name": "Data Loss Prevention (DLP)", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Data Security", "name": "Data Backups and Recovery", "mandatory": True},

        # 6. APPLICATION SECURITY
        {"domain": "Application Security", "name": "Regular Security Scanning and Testing", "mandatory": True},

        # 7. OTHER MEASURES
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Vulnerability Assessment", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Patch Management", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Strong Password Policies", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Access Reviews", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Security Logs", "mandatory": True},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Log Analysis", "mandatory": False},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Incident Response Plan", "mandatory": False},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)", "mandatory": False},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Penetration Testing", "mandatory": False},
        {"domain": "Other Measures", "name": "Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)", "mandatory": False}
    ]

    added = 0
    for is_proposed in [False, True]:
        for c in OFFICIAL_DICT_CONTROLS:
            exists = db.query(CybersecurityControl).filter(
                CybersecurityControl.issp_period == period,
                CybersecurityControl.is_proposed == is_proposed,
                CybersecurityControl.control_name == c["name"]
            ).first()
            if not exists:
                db.add(CybersecurityControl(
                    issp_period=period,
                    is_proposed=is_proposed,
                    control_domain=c["domain"],
                    control_name=c["name"],
                    is_mandatory=c["mandatory"],
                    is_implemented=False
                ))
                added += 1

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": f"Successfully initialized {added} standard DICT cybersecurity controls."}

@router.put("/information-systems/{system_id}", response_model=InformationSystemResponse)
def update_information_system(
    system_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: InformationSystemUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    db_system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(InformationSystem.id == system_id).first()
    if not db_system:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Information System not found.")

    update_data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    for key, value in update_data.items():
        setattr(db_system, key, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_system)
    return db_system


@router.delete("/information-systems/{system_id}")
def delete_information_system(
    system_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    db_system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(InformationSystem.id == system_id).first()
    if not db_system:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Information System not found.")

    linked_projects = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.system_id == system_id).count()
    if linked_projects > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Cannot delete system '{db_system.name}'. There are {linked_projects} ICT projects linked to it."
        )

    db.delete(db_system)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Information System removed from registry."}

# PART III.E: ICT PROJECTS (INTERNAL & CROSS-AGENCY)
# ==========================================================

@router.get("/ict-projects")
def get_ict_projects(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    category_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
        
        base_projects = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.issp_period == period).all()

        if category_filter and category_filter.strip().lower() != "all":
            cat_clean = category_filter.strip().lower()
            filtered_projects = []
            for p in base_projects:
                p_cat_val = str(getattr(p.project_category, "value", p.project_category) or "").lower()
                p_cat_name = str(getattr(p.project_category, "name", "") or "").lower()
                p_cat_raw = str(p.project_category or "").lower()

                if (
                    cat_clean == p_cat_val or
                    cat_clean == p_cat_name or
                    cat_clean in p_cat_val or
                    cat_clean in p_cat_raw or
                    cat_clean.replace(" ", "_") == p_cat_name or
                    cat_clean.replace("-", "_") in p_cat_name or
                    ("cross" in cat_clean and "cross" in p_cat_val)
                ):
                    filtered_projects.append(p)
            projects = filtered_projects
        else:
            projects = base_projects

        total_costs_map = {}
        try:
            cost_proposals = (
                db.query(
                    Proposal.project_id,
                    Proposal.total_cost,
                    Proposal.year_1_qty,
                    Proposal.year_2_qty,
                    Proposal.year_3_qty,
                    Proposal.unit_cost
                )
                .filter(
                    Proposal.issp_period == period,
                    Proposal.project_id.isnot(None),
                    or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
                )
                .all()
            )
            for row in cost_proposals:
                pid = row[0]
                if not pid:
                    continue
                pid_str = str(pid).strip()
                cost = row[1]
                if cost is None:
                    q = (row[2] or 0) + (row[3] or 0) + (row[4] or 0)
                    u = row[5] or Decimal("0.00")
                    cost = Decimal(q) * Decimal(str(u))
                else:
                    cost = Decimal(str(cost))

                total_costs_map[pid_str] = total_costs_map.get(pid_str, Decimal("0.00")) + cost
                total_costs_map[pid] = total_costs_map.get(pid, Decimal("0.00")) + cost
        except Exception as cost_map_err:
            db.rollback()
            logger.warning(f"Could not batch compute project total costs: {cost_map_err}")

        results = []
        for proj in projects:
            try:
                pid = proj.id
                pid_str = str(pid).strip() if pid else ""
                total_cost = total_costs_map.get(pid_str) or total_costs_map.get(pid) or Decimal("0.00")

                results.append({
                    "id": str(pid),
                    "issp_period": str(proj.issp_period or period),
                    "system_id": str(proj.system_id) if proj.system_id else None,
                    "project_title": str(proj.project_title or ""),
                    "project_category": str(getattr(proj.project_category, "value", proj.project_category) or "Internal ICT Projects"),
                    "description": str(proj.description or ""),
                    "objectives": str(proj.objectives or ""),
                    "aligns_pip": bool(getattr(proj, "aligns_pip", False)),
                    "aligns_ncsp": bool(getattr(proj, "aligns_ncsp", False)),
                    "aligns_egmp": bool(getattr(proj, "aligns_egmp", False)),
                    "aligns_pcb": bool(getattr(proj, "aligns_pcb", False)),
                    "aligns_others": bool(getattr(proj, "aligns_others", False)),
                    "aligns_others_specify": getattr(proj, "aligns_others_specify", None),
                    "harmonizes_national_priority": bool(getattr(proj, "harmonizes_national_priority", False)),
                    "harmonizes_resource_optimization": bool(getattr(proj, "harmonizes_resource_optimization", False)),
                    "harmonizes_pegif": bool(getattr(proj, "harmonizes_pegif", False)),
                    "harmonizes_cross_collaboration": bool(getattr(proj, "harmonizes_cross_collaboration", False)),
                    "harmonizes_scalability": bool(getattr(proj, "harmonizes_scalability", False)),
                    "duration_start_year": int(getattr(proj, "duration_start_year", 2026) or 2026),
                    "duration_end_year": int(getattr(proj, "duration_end_year", 2028) or 2028),
                    "annual_deliverables": getattr(proj, "annual_deliverables", {}) or {},
                    "year_1_deliverables": str(getattr(proj, "year_1_deliverables", "") or ""),
                    "year_2_deliverables": str(getattr(proj, "year_2_deliverables", "") or ""),
                    "year_3_deliverables": str(getattr(proj, "year_3_deliverables", "") or ""),
                    "implementing_unit": str(getattr(proj, "implementing_unit", "") or "ICT Management Office"),
                    "funding_source": str(getattr(proj.funding_source, "value", proj.funding_source) or "General Appropriations Act (GAA)"),
                    "lead_agency": str(proj.lead_agency) if proj.lead_agency else None,
                    "partner_agencies": str(proj.partner_agencies) if proj.partner_agencies else None,
                    "computed_total_project_cost": float(total_cost)
                })
            except Exception as item_err:
                logger.error(f"Error serializing ICT project {getattr(proj, 'id', '')}: {item_err}", exc_info=True)

        return results
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to query ict-projects: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to query ICT projects: {str(e)}")


@router.post("/ict-projects", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_ict_project(
    payload: IctProjectCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        period = get_active_issp_period(db)
        data_dict = payload.model_dump()
        new_project = IctProject(
            issp_period=period,
            **data_dict
        )
        db.add(new_project)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_project)
        
        return {
            "id": str(new_project.id),
            "issp_period": new_project.issp_period,
            "system_id": str(new_project.system_id) if new_project.system_id else None,
            "project_title": new_project.project_title,
            "project_category": str(getattr(new_project.project_category, "value", new_project.project_category) or "Internal ICT Projects"),
            "description": new_project.description or "",
            "objectives": new_project.objectives or "",

            "duration_start_year": new_project.duration_start_year,
            "duration_end_year": new_project.duration_end_year,

        }
    except Exception as e:
