# 2. DYNAMIC PLANNING CYCLE & YEAR ALIGNMENT UTILITIES
# ==========================================================

def get_active_issp_period(db: Session) -> str:
    """
    Queries the database for the active planning cycle configured by the Administrator.
    Falls back to the latest cycle if no active coversheet is explicitly flagged.
    """
    try:
        active_narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.is_active == True).first()
        if active_narrative:
            return active_narrative.issp_period
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.warning(f"Query check: Failed to fetch active MasterNarrative issp_period: {str(e)}")
        
    try:
        latest_narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).order_by(MasterNarrative.issp_period.desc()).first()
        if latest_narrative:
            return latest_narrative.issp_period
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.warning(f"Query check: Failed to fetch latest MasterNarrative issp_period: {str(e)}")
        
    return getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_ISSP_CYCLE", "2026-2028")


def get_cycle_year_range(narrative: Optional[MasterNarrative], issp_period: Optional[str] = None) -> List[int]:
    """
    Resolves the exact sequence of calendar years [from_year, ..., to_year] 
    for any configured cycle horizon (1 to N years).
    """
    start_year = None
    end_year = None

    if narrative:
        start_year = narrative.issp_period_from
        end_year = narrative.issp_period_to
        if not issp_period:
            issp_period = narrative.issp_period

    if not start_year or not end_year:
        period_str = str(issp_period or "2026-2028").strip()
        parts = period_str.split("-")
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit():
            start_year = int(parts[0])
            end_year = int(parts[1])
        elif len(parts) == 1 and parts[0].isdigit():
            start_year = int(parts[0])
            end_year = int(parts[0])
        else:
            start_year, end_year = 2026, 2028

    if start_year > end_year:
        start_year, end_year = end_year, start_year

    return list(range(start_year, end_year + 1))


def validate_active_years_alignment(db: Session, submitted_years: List[Any]) -> str:
    """
    Validates that the keys of a submitted year-by-year dictionary 
    match the active planning period years exactly across any horizon span (1 to N years).
    """
    active_narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.is_active == True).first()
    if not active_narrative:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="No active ISSP planning cycle has been configured by the system administrator."
        )

    year_range = get_cycle_year_range(active_narrative)
    expected_years = [str(y) for y in year_range]
    submitted_years_str = [str(y).strip() for y in submitted_years]

    if sorted(submitted_years_str) != sorted(expected_years):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Validation Failed: Submitted years {submitted_years_str} do not match active cycle horizon {expected_years}."
        )
    return active_narrative.issp_period


def align_and_validate_years(db: Session, yearly_data: Dict[str, int], is_submitting: bool = False) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, int]]:
    """
    Standardizes inputs to use string keys, aligns them dynamically with the active cycle
    horizon (1 to N years), and backfills missing years with zero counts.
    """
    active_narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.is_active == True).first()
    if not active_narrative:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="No active ISSP planning cycle has been configured by the system administrator."
        )

    year_range = get_cycle_year_range(active_narrative)
    expected_years = [str(y) for y in year_range]
    
    sanitized_input = {}
    if yearly_data and isinstance(yearly_data, dict):
        for k, v in yearly_data.items():
            try:
                sanitized_input[str(k).strip()] = int(v) if v is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                sanitized_input[str(k).strip()] = 0

    aligned_data = {year: sanitized_input.get(year, 0) for year in expected_years}

    # Shift sequential data if cycle keys shifted (e.g., rollover to a new planning horizon)
    original_sorted_keys = sorted([k for k in sanitized_input.keys() if k.isdigit()])
    if not any(y in sanitized_input for y in expected_years) and original_sorted_keys:
        for idx, year in enumerate(expected_years):
            if idx < len(original_sorted_keys):
                orig_key = original_sorted_keys[idx]
                aligned_data[year] = sanitized_input[orig_key]
            
    if is_submitting:
        original_keys = set(sanitized_input.keys())
        expected_set = set(expected_years)
        if original_keys != expected_set and not all(k in expected_set for k in original_keys):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"Validation Failed: Submitted years {sorted(list(original_keys))} do not match active cycle {expected_years}."
            )
    return active_narrative.issp_period, aligned_data


# ==========================================================
# 3. DBM CAPITALIZATION & UACS AUTOMATIC RESOLUTION
# ==========================================================

def classify_uacs_and_expenditure(
    item_name: str, 
    unit_cost: Decimal, 
    strategic_category: ProjectCategory,
    category: Optional[ProposalCategory] = None,
    created_by_students: bool = False
) -> Tuple[UacsObjectCode, ExpenditureClass]:
    """
    Enforces DBM capitalization thresholds (₱50,000.00), student-developed software
    capitalization rules, and assigns the correct Unified Accounts Code Structure (UACS)
    Object Code automatically.
    - Systems created by students are always Capital Outlay (50604070 01 - ICT Software).
    - ICT Training/Seminars are always MOOE (50202010 00 - Training Expenses) per DICT Guidelines Page 24.
    - Consulting and contractor services are categorized as MOOE under UACS 50211030 00.
    - Recurring software licenses and cloud services are MOOE under UACS 50299070 00.
    """
    # Rule 1: Student-created software systems are Capital Outlay (ICT Software)
    if created_by_students:
        return UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE, ExpenditureClass.CAPITAL_OUTLAY

    cat_val = getattr(category, "value", str(category or ""))
    if cat_val in [ProposalCategory.SUBSCRIPTION.value, "Subscription"]:
        return UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION, ExpenditureClass.MOOE

    CAPITALIZATION_THRESHOLD = Decimal("50000.00")
    item_lower = (item_name or "").lower().strip()
    strat_cat_val = getattr(strategic_category, "value", str(strategic_category or ""))

    # Mandated by DICT Guidelines Page 24: Training Expenses under UACS 50202010 00
    if any(k in item_lower for k in ["training", "seminar", "workshop"]):
        return UacsObjectCode.ICT_TRAINING, ExpenditureClass.MOOE

    # Contractor / Consulting services are always MOOE (DICT Template Page 29, UACS 50211030 00)
    if any(k in item_lower for k in ["contractor", "consultant", "consulting"]):
        return UacsObjectCode.ICT_CONSULTING_DEVELOPMENT, ExpenditureClass.MOOE

    # Continuing Costs are always MOOE (Recurring subscriptions, maintenance, internet)
    if strat_cat_val in [ProjectCategory.CONTINUING_COSTS.value, "Continuing Costs/Expenses"]:
        if any(k in item_lower for k in ["software", "subscription", "cloud", "internet", "license"]):
            return UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION, ExpenditureClass.MOOE
        return UacsObjectCode.ICT_CONSULTING_DEVELOPMENT, ExpenditureClass.MOOE

    # Rule 3 & 4: General DBM Threshold Rule: >= ₱50,000 is CO; < ₱50,000 is MOOE
    if unit_cost >= CAPITALIZATION_THRESHOLD:
        exp_class = ExpenditureClass.CAPITAL_OUTLAY
        if any(k in item_lower for k in ["printer", "scanner", "plotter"]):
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.PRINTING_EQUIPMENT
        elif any(k in item_lower for k in ["software", "system", "platform"]) and not any(k in item_lower for k in ["subscription", "cloud"]):
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE
        else:
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.ICT_EQUIPMENT
    else:
        exp_class = ExpenditureClass.MOOE
        if any(k in item_lower for k in ["printer", "scanner", "plotter"]):
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.SEMI_EXPENDABLE_PRINTING
        elif any(k in item_lower for k in ["suite", "license", "subscription", "cloud"]):
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION
        elif any(k in item_lower for k in ["development"]):
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.ICT_CONSULTING_DEVELOPMENT
        else:
            uacs = UacsObjectCode.SEMI_EXPENDABLE_ICT

    return uacs, exp_class


# ==========================================================
# 4. PART IV.B DYNAMIC FOUR-WAY FINANCIAL PARITY CALCULATOR
# ==========================================================

def calculate_financial_summaries(db: Session, issp_period: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Dynamically computes Part IV.B Summary of Investments (B.1, B.2, B.3, B.4)
    from atomic line items for any planning horizon span (1 to N years)
    and strictly asserts the Four-Way Parity Constraint down to the centavo.
    """
    narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == issp_period).first()
    if not narrative:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Active cycle narrative for '{issp_period}' not found."
        )

    # Resolve dynamic year sequence: [FY_1, FY_2, ..., FY_N]
    year_range = get_cycle_year_range(narrative, issp_period)
    all_year_keys = [f"FY {y}" for y in year_range]

    items = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.issp_period == issp_period,
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).all()

    def create_row():
        row = {y_key: Decimal("0.00") for y_key in all_year_keys}
        row["Total"] = Decimal("0.00")
        return row

    # Table B.1: General Summary
    b1 = {cat.value: create_row() for cat in ProjectCategory}
    b1["GRAND TOTAL"] = create_row()

    # Table B.2: Fund Source
    b2 = {source.value: create_row() for source in FundSource}
    b2["GRAND TOTAL"] = create_row()

    # Table B.3: Statement of Expenditure
    b3 = {exp.value: create_row() for exp in ExpenditureClass}
    b3["GRAND TOTAL"] = create_row()

    # Table B.4: Object of Expenditure (UACS)
    b4 = {code.value: create_row() for code in UacsObjectCode}
    b4["GRAND TOTAL"] = create_row()

    def find_matching_key(grid: dict, candidate_val: Any, enum_cls: Any = None) -> Optional[str]:
        if candidate_val is None:
            return None
        cand_str = str(getattr(candidate_val, "value", candidate_val) or "").strip()
        cand_norm = cand_str.lower().replace(" ", "").replace("_", "").replace("-", "")

        for k in grid.keys():
            if k == "GRAND TOTAL":
                continue
            k_norm = k.lower().replace(" ", "").replace("_", "").replace("-", "")
            if k == cand_str or k.lower() == cand_str.lower() or k_norm == cand_norm:
                return k

        if enum_cls:
            for member in enum_cls:
                m_name = member.name.lower().replace("_", "")
                m_val = member.value.lower().replace(" ", "").replace("_", "").replace("-", "")
                if (
                    member.name == cand_str or 
                    member.name.lower() == cand_str.lower() or 
                    m_name == cand_norm or
                    m_val == cand_norm or
                    cand_str.lower() in member.value.lower()
                ):
                    if member.value in grid:
                        return member.value

        return None

    for item in items:
        unit_price = item.unit_cost if item.unit_cost is not None else Decimal("0.00")
        line_total = Decimal("0.00")

        cat_key = find_matching_key(b1, item.strategic_category, ProjectCategory)
        fund_key = find_matching_key(b2, item.fund_source, FundSource)
        exp_key = find_matching_key(b3, item.expenditure_class, ExpenditureClass)
        uacs_key = find_matching_key(b4, item.uacs_object_code, UacsObjectCode)

        # Parse yearly_quantities defensively if stored as a raw JSON string
        y_quantities = item.yearly_quantities
        if isinstance(y_quantities, str):
            try:
                y_quantities = json.loads(y_quantities)
            except Exception:
                y_quantities = {}

        # Dynamic loop across all active planning years in the horizon
        for idx, yr in enumerate(year_range):
            y_key = f"FY {yr}"
            qty = 0

            # 1. Primary lookup: direct year string/int key from yearly_quantities
            if y_quantities and isinstance(y_quantities, dict):
                qty = y_quantities.get(str(yr))
                if qty is None:
                    qty = y_quantities.get(yr)
                if qty is None:
                    qty = y_quantities.get(f"Year {idx + 1}")

            # 2. Legacy fallback: fallback to static year columns if yearly_quantities is unpopulated
            if qty is None or qty == 0:
                if idx == 0:
                    qty = item.year_1_qty or 0
                elif idx == 1:
                    qty = item.year_2_qty or 0
                elif idx == 2:
                    qty = item.year_3_qty or 0

            try:
                qty_int = int(qty) if qty is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                qty_int = 0

            cost_for_year = Decimal(qty_int) * unit_price
            line_total += cost_for_year

            # Accumulate into each dynamic year column
            if cat_key in b1:
                b1[cat_key][y_key] += cost_for_year
            if fund_key in b2:
                b2[fund_key][y_key] += cost_for_year
            if exp_key in b3:
                b3[exp_key][y_key] += cost_for_year
            if uacs_key in b4:
                b4[uacs_key][y_key] += cost_for_year

        # Accumulate line totals
        if cat_key in b1:
            b1[cat_key]["Total"] += line_total
        if fund_key in b2:
            b2[fund_key]["Total"] += line_total
        if exp_key in b3:
            b3[exp_key]["Total"] += line_total
        if uacs_key in b4:
            b4[uacs_key]["Total"] += line_total

    # Compute Grand Totals across all dynamic year columns and the Total column
    for col_key in all_year_keys + ["Total"]:
        b1["GRAND TOTAL"][col_key] = sum((b1[cat.value][col_key] for cat in ProjectCategory), Decimal("0.00"))
        b2["GRAND TOTAL"][col_key] = sum((b2[source.value][col_key] for source in FundSource), Decimal("0.00"))
        b3["GRAND TOTAL"][col_key] = sum((b3[exp.value][col_key] for exp in ExpenditureClass), Decimal("0.00"))
        b4["GRAND TOTAL"][col_key] = sum((b4[code.value][col_key] for code in UacsObjectCode), Decimal("0.00"))

    # Four-Way Parity Verification down to the exact centavo
    t_b1 = b1["GRAND TOTAL"]["Total"].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    t_b2 = b2["GRAND TOTAL"]["Total"].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    t_b3 = b3["GRAND TOTAL"]["Total"].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    t_b4 = b4["GRAND TOTAL"]["Total"].quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

    is_parity_valid = (t_b1 == t_b2 == t_b3 == t_b4)
    discrepancy = max(abs(t_b1 - t_b2), abs(t_b1 - t_b3), abs(t_b1 - t_b4))

    return {
        "b1_general_summary": b1,
        "b2_fund_source": b2,
        "b3_statement_of_expenditure": b3,
        "b4_object_of_expenditure": b4,
        "certified_grand_total": t_b1,
        "is_parity_valid": is_parity_valid,
        "parity_discrepancy": discrepancy,
        "year_columns": all_year_keys
    }


# ==========================================================
# 5. CROSS-SECTIONAL DEPENDENCY AUDITORS
# ==========================================================

def verify_annex1_obsolescence_link(
    db: Session, 
    issp_period: str, 
    item_name: str, 
    requested_qty: int,
    department_id: Optional[int] = None
) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Asserts that replacement hardware requested in Part IV.A is justified by an equivalent 
    or greater volume of physical End of Life (EOL) or Condemned units in Annex 1.
    Optionally scopes to a specific department if provided.
    Defensively casts status to String so PostgreSQL doesn't crash with
    'function lower(assetstatus) does not exist'.
    """
    status_str = cast(ExistingInventory.status, String)
    unserviceable_filter = or_(
        ExistingInventory.is_end_of_life == True,
        ExistingInventory.status == AssetStatus.CONDEMNED,
        ExistingInventory.status == AssetStatus.NEEDS_REPAIR,
        func.lower(status_str) == "condemned",
        func.lower(status_str) == "needs repair"
    )

    query = db.query(func.sum(ExistingInventory.quantity)).filter(
        ExistingInventory.is_software == False,
        unserviceable_filter,
        ExistingInventory.item_name.ilike(f"%{item_name}%")
    )
    
    if department_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(ExistingInventory.department_id == department_id)
        
    eol_units = query.scalar() or 0

    if requested_qty > int(eol_units):
        scope_str = f"for department {department_id}" if department_id else "in inventory"
        return False, (
            f"Obsolescence Discrepancy: Requesting {requested_qty} replacement units for '{item_name}', "
            f"but Annex 1 Asset Inventory {scope_str} records only {int(eol_units)} End of Life (EOL) or Condemned physical units."
        )
    return True, "Obsolescence link verified."


def verify_pia_compliance(db: Session, system_id: uuid.UUID) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Enforces Data Privacy Act of 2012 compliance. If a system handles personal data
    without an audit, a PIA phase must be scheduled in the project milestones.
    Inspects both legacy year deliverable fields and dynamic annual_deliverables dicts.
    """
    system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(InformationSystem.id == system_id).first()
    if not system:
        return False, "Information System record not found."

    if system.processes_personal_information and not system.has_undergone_pia:
        has_pia_milestone = False
        for proj in system.projects:
            deliverables_list = []
            annual_deliv = getattr(proj, "annual_deliverables", {})
            if isinstance(annual_deliv, dict):
                deliverables_list.extend(str(v) for v in annual_deliv.values())

            deliverables_list.extend([
                str(getattr(proj, "year_1_deliverables", "") or ""),
                str(getattr(proj, "year_2_deliverables", "") or ""),
                str(getattr(proj, "year_3_deliverables", "") or "")
            ])
            
            deliverables_text = " ".join(deliverables_list).lower()
            if any(k in deliverables_text for k in ["pia", "privacy impact assessment", "privacy impact", "privacy audit"]):
                has_pia_milestone = True
                break

        if not has_pia_milestone:
            return False, (
                f"Data Privacy Compliance Violation: System '{system.name}' processes personal information (PIA=Yes) "
                f"without a prior audit, but no milestone in Part III.E schedules a PIA phase."
            )

    return True, "PIA compliance verified."


def verify_drbcp_funding(db: Session, issp_period: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Verifies that mission-critical systems in Annex 2 (RTO <= 4 hours) have appropriate
    cloud hosting and offsite backup funding allocated under Part IV.A Continuing Costs.
    """
    critical_bias = db.query(BusinessImpactAnalysis).filter(
        BusinessImpactAnalysis.issp_period == issp_period,
        BusinessImpactAnalysis.rto_hours <= 4
    ).all()

    if critical_bias:
        cloud_items = db.query(Proposal).filter(
            Proposal.issp_period == issp_period,
            Proposal.strategic_category.in_([ProjectCategory.CONTINUING_COSTS, ProjectCategory.CONTINUING_COSTS.value]),
            Proposal.uacs_object_code.in_([UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION, UacsObjectCode.ICT_SOFTWARE_SUBSCRIPTION.value]),
            or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
        ).all()

        total_cloud_funding = sum((Decimal(item.total_cost or 0) for item in cloud_items), Decimal("0.00"))
        if total_cloud_funding <= Decimal("0.00"):
            return False, (
                "Annex 2 DRBCP Funding Violation: Frontline mission-critical systems require an RTO <= 4 hours "
                "(mandating GovCloud real-time failover), but Part IV.A allocates ₱0.00 under Continuing Costs for Cloud Subscriptions."
            )

    return True, "DRBCP continuity funding verified."


# ==========================================================
# 6. CENTRALIZED COA AUDIT LOGGING HELPER
# ==========================================================

def log_audit_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    module: str = "GOVERNANCE",
    user_id: Optional[int] = None,
    department_id: Optional[int] = None,
    proposal_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
    ip_address: Optional[str] = None,
    old_value: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    new_value: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
) -> AuditTrail:
    """
    Centralized, immutable COA audit logger.
    Records user logins, entity mutations (proposals, inventory, narratives, ceilings),
    previous vs. new JSON state deltas, IP addresses, and timestamped operator identities.
    """
    from app.database.models import AuditTrail
    audit = AuditTrail(
        action=action,
        module=module,
        user_id=user_id,
        department_id=department_id,
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        ip_address=ip_address,
        old_value=old_value,
        new_value=new_value
    )
    db.add(audit)
    try:
        db.flush()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to record audit trail event '{action}' in module '{module}': {str(e)}")
    return audit

// --- ROLE-BASED ROUTE GUARD ---
const ProtectedRoute = ({ children, allowedRoles }) => {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          <span>Verifying institutional session credentials...</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (allowedRoles && !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  return children;
};

// --- AUTOMATED ROOT PATH REDIRECTION ---
const RootRedirect = () => {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          <span>Resolving user navigation path...</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (user.role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN") {
    return <Navigate to="/admin/dashboard" replace />;
  }

  if (user.role === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER") {
    return <Navigate to="/supply/inventory" replace />;
  }

  return <Navigate to="/dept/dashboard" replace />;
};

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Router future={{ v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true }}>
      <NotificationProvider>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
          <Route path="/" element={<RootRedirect />} />

          {/* Department User Workspace Routes */}
          <Route
            path="/dept"
            element={
              <ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["ROLE_DEPT_USER"]}>
                <DashboardLayout />
              </ProtectedRoute>
            }
          >
            <Route index element={<Navigate to="dashboard" replace />} />
            <Route path="dashboard" element={<DeptDashboard />} />
            <Route path="proposals" element={<UnifiedProposals />} />
            <Route path="inventory" element={<InventoryManager />} />
            <Route path="needs" element={<NeedsAssessment />} />
            <Route path="quotations" element={<QuotationManager />} />
            <Route path="glacier" element={<GlacierConsole />} />
            <Route path="vault" element={<DocumentVault />} />
            <Route path="inbox" element={<ActionInbox />} />
            <Route path="catalog" element={<CatalogViewer />} />
            <Route path="profile" element={<ProfileSettings />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Supply User Workspace Routes (Annex 1 Management) */}
          <Route
            path="/supply"
            element={
              <ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["ROLE_SUPPLY_USER", "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN"]}>
                <DashboardLayout />
              </ProtectedRoute>
            }
          >
            <Route index element={<Navigate to="inventory" replace />} />
            <Route path="inventory" element={<SupplyInventory />} />
            <Route path="profile" element={<ProfileSettings />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Administrator & Governance Routes */}
          <Route
            path="/admin"
            element={
              <ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["ROLE_MIS_ADMIN"]}>
                <DashboardLayout />
              </ProtectedRoute>
            }
          >
            <Route index element={<Navigate to="dashboard" replace />} />
            <Route path="dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
            <Route path="queue" element={<ConsolidatedQueue />} />
            <Route path="budget" element={<CeilingControl />} />
            <Route path="analytics" element={<ComplianceAnalytics />} />
            
            <Route path="narratives" element={<NarrativeManager />} />
            <Route path="diagrams" element={<DiagramVault />} />
            <Route path="mithi" element={<MithiSurveys />} />
            <Route path="users" element={<UserWhitelisting />} />
            <Route path="catalog" element={<CatalogManager />} />
            <Route path="audit" element={<AuditTrails />} />
            <Route path="vault" element={<DocumentVault />} />

            {/* Core Singularity Workspaces */}
            <Route path="outcomes" element={<OrganizationalOutcomes />} />
            <Route path="narratives/concerns" element={<StrategicConcernsManager />} />
            <Route path="systems" element={<InformationSystemsManager />} />
            <Route path="projects/internal" element={<InternalProjectsManager />} />
            <Route path="narratives/cross-projects" element={<CrossProjectsManager />} />
            <Route path="narratives/gantt" element={<GanttScheduleManager />} />
            <Route path="narratives/metrics" element={<PerformanceMetricsManager />} />
            <Route path="narratives/costs" element={<CostBreakdownManager />} />
            <Route path="parity-summary" element={<InvestmentSummaryViewer />} />
            <Route path="narratives/staff-positions" element={<StaffPositionsManager />} />

// frontend/src/api/admin.js

const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
export const API_BASE_URL = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;

/**
 * Enhanced error parsing handler that formats Pydantic validation arrays
 * and DICT Singularity DAG violation envelopes into human-readable messages.
 */
async function handleResponse(res, errorMessage) {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    let detailMessage = "";

    if (errorData.detail) {
      if (typeof errorData.detail === "string") {
        detailMessage = errorData.detail;
      } else if (Array.isArray(errorData.detail)) {
        // Format Pydantic field-level validation errors
        detailMessage = errorData.detail
          .map(err => `${err.loc ? err.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") + ": " : ""}${err.msg || JSON.stringify(err)}`)
          .join(" | ");
      } else if (typeof errorData.detail === "object") {
        // Format DICT Singularity Engine violations list
        if (Array.isArray(errorData.detail.violations)) {
          detailMessage = `${errorData.detail.error || "Integrity Violation"}: ${errorData.detail.violations.join(" | ")}`;
        } else {
          detailMessage = JSON.stringify(errorData.detail);
        }
      }
    } else if (errorData.message) {
      detailMessage = errorData.message;
    }

    throw new Error(detailMessage || `${errorMessage} (HTTP ${res.status})`);
  }
  if (res.status === 204) {
    return null;
  }
  return res.json();
}

/**
 * Resolves standard authorization and content-type headers.
 * Safely falls back to localStorage if the token argument is omitted.
 */
const getHeaders = (token, isMultipart = false) => {
  const resolvedToken = token || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") : null);
  const headers = {};

  if (resolvedToken) {
    headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${resolvedToken}`;
  }
  if (!isMultipart) {
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  }
  return headers;
};

/**
 * Retrieves ICT projects with flexible cycle or object parameters.
 */
export const getIctProjects = async (token, cycleOrParams = "", categoryFilter = "") => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (typeof cycleOrParams === "object" && cycleOrParams !== null) {
    if (cycleOrParams.issp_period) params.append("issp_period", cycleOrParams.issp_period);
    if (cycleOrParams.category_filter && cycleOrParams.category_filter !== "All") {
      params.append("category_filter", cycleOrParams.category_filter);
    }
  } else {
    if (cycleOrParams) params.append("issp_period", cycleOrParams);
    if (categoryFilter && categoryFilter !== "All") params.append("category_filter", categoryFilter);
  }
  const qs = params.toString();
  const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/ict-projects${qs ? `?${qs}` : ""}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: getHeaders(token) });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load ICT projects");
};

/**
 * Updates the master planning narrative coversheet and statutory parameters.
 * Maps DICT v.2026 dynamic head position (agency_head_position), 
 * DRBCP approval date (drbcp_approval_date), Section 6 MITHI policies (drbcp_compliance_narrative_html),
 * and official co-branding logos (dict_logo_url, bagong_pilipinas_logo_url, agency_logo_url).
 */
export const updateNarrative = async (token, cycle, payload) => {
  const formattedPayload = {
    ...payload,
    agency_head_position: payload.agency_head_position || payload.agency_head_title || payload.head_of_agency_position || undefined,
    drbcp_approval_date: payload.drbcp_approval_date || payload.approval_date || undefined,
    drbcp_compliance_narrative_html: payload.drbcp_compliance_narrative_html || undefined,
    dict_logo_url: payload.dict_logo_url !== undefined ? payload.dict_logo_url : undefined,
    bagong_pilipinas_logo_url: payload.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url !== undefined ? payload.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url : undefined,
    agency_logo_url: payload.agency_logo_url !== undefined ? payload.agency_logo_url : undefined,
    cert_logo_url: payload.cert_logo_url !== undefined ? payload.cert_logo_url : undefined
  };

  // Strip undefined keys to allow backend defaults to handle missing inputs cleanly
  Object.keys(formattedPayload).forEach(key => {
    if (formattedPayload[key] === undefined) {
      delete formattedPayload[key];
    }
  });

  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(cycle)}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(token),
    body: JSON.stringify(formattedPayload)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to update master narrative");
};

/**
 * Uploads a diagram asset or government co-branding seal with optional metadata.
 */
export const uploadDiagram = async (token, cycle, category, file, extraData = {}) => {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", file);
  if (extraData && typeof extraData === "object") {
    Object.entries(extraData).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) {
        formData.append(k, String(v));
      }
    });
  }
  const res = await fetch(
    `${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(cycle)}/upload-diagram?category=${encodeURIComponent(category)}`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: getHeaders(token, true),
      body: formData
    }
  );
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to upload diagram");
};

/**
 * Retrieves immutable COA audit logs supporting module and department filtering.
 */
export const getAuditLogs = async (token, params = {}) => {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (typeof params === "object" && params !== null) {
    Object.entries(params).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== "" && v !== "All") {
        query.append(k, String(v));
      }
    });
  } else if (typeof params === "string" && params && params !== "All") {
    query.append("module", params);
  }
  const qs = query.toString();
  const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/audit-logs${qs ? `?${qs}` : ""}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, { 
    headers: getHeaders(token) 
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load COA audit logs");
};

// frontend/src/api/auth.js

const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
export const API_ROOT = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;
const BASE_URL = `${API_ROOT}/api/auth`;

/**
 * Parses FastAPI error envelopes, handling strings, Pydantic validation arrays,
 * or custom exception objects into clear, human-readable messages.
 */
async function parseErrorMessage(response, defaultMsg) {
  try {
    const errorData = await response.json();
    if (errorData) {
      if (errorData.detail) {
        if (typeof errorData.detail === "string") {
          return errorData.detail;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(errorData.detail)) {
          // Flatten and format Pydantic validation error lists
          return errorData.detail
            .map((err) => {
              const field = err.loc ? err.loc.filter((p) => p !== "body").join(" -> ") : "";
              return field ? `[${field}]: ${err.msg}` : (err.msg || JSON.stringify(err));
            })
            .join(" | ");
        }
        return JSON.stringify(errorData.detail);
      }
      if (errorData.message) {
        return errorData.message;
      }
      return JSON.stringify(errorData);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("API response parsing note: Response body is not valid JSON.", err);
  }
  return `${defaultMsg} (HTTP ${response.status})`;
}

/**
 * Authenticates an institutional user via standard manual credentials (email + password).
 * Dispatches an application/x-www-form-urlencoded payload conforming to OAuth2PasswordRequestForm.
 *
 * @param {string} email - Institutional email address
 * @param {string} password - User password
 * @returns {Promise<{ access_token: string, token_type: string, role: string, department_id: number|null }>}
 */
export const login = async (email, password) => {
  const formData = new URLSearchParams();
  formData.append("username", (email || "").trim().toLowerCase());
  formData.append("password", password);

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/login`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorMessage = await parseErrorMessage(response, "Authentication failed");
    throw new Error(errorMessage);
  }

  return response.json();
};

 * - DICT Annex 1 Standard Category (dict_category & other_category_name) Support
 * - Live S3 Glacier Cold Storage Retrieval Monitoring
 * - Dual-Pass Compilation Pre-Flight Headroom Checks
 * ==============================================================================
 */

const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
export const API_BASE_URL = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;

/**
 * Builds standard authorization and content headers.
 * Automatically omits 'Content-Type' during multipart/form-data uploads 
 * to let the browser configure boundary identifiers cleanly.
 *
 * @param {boolean} isMultipart - True if uploading FormData (files)
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 * @returns {HeadersInit} Standard request headers
 */
function getHeaders(isMultipart = false, customToken = null) {
  let token = customToken;
  if (!token && typeof window !== "undefined") {
    token = localStorage.getItem("access_token");
  }
  const headers = {};

  if (token) {
    headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  if (!isMultipart) {
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  }

  return headers;
}

/**
 * Standardized HTTP response evaluator.
 * Gracefully extracts string messages, Pydantic validation error lists,
 * and structured backend exception payloads to avoid '[object Object]' UI errors.
 *
 * @param {Response} res - Native Fetch Response object
 * @param {string} fallbackMessage - Default error context message
 * @returns {Promise<any>} Parsed JSON response
 */
async function handleResponse(res, fallbackMessage) {
  if (!res.ok) {
    let detailMessage = "";
    try {
      const errorData = await res.json();
      if (errorData) {
        if (typeof errorData.detail === "string") {
          detailMessage = errorData.detail;
        } else if (Array.isArray(errorData.detail)) {
          // Flatten Pydantic validation error objects
          detailMessage = errorData.detail
            .map((err) => {
              const field = err.loc ? err.loc.filter((p) => p !== "body").join(" -> ") : "";
              return field ? `[${field}]: ${err.msg}` : err.msg;
            })
            .join(" | ");
        } else if (typeof errorData.detail === "object" && errorData.detail !== null) {
          if (errorData.detail.violations && Array.isArray(errorData.detail.violations)) {
            detailMessage = errorData.detail.violations.join(" | ");
          } else {
            detailMessage = JSON.stringify(errorData.detail);
          }
        } else if (errorData.message) {
          detailMessage = errorData.message;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Body is not JSON
      detailMessage = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    }

    const finalError = detailMessage || `${fallbackMessage} (HTTP Status: ${res.status})`;
    throw new Error(finalError);
  }

  // Handle 204 No Content
  if (res.status === 204) {
    return null;
  }

  return res.json();
}

// 7. ANNEX 1: DEPARTMENT INVENTORY (Read-Only Scoped View — Rule 9 & DICT Categories)
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Retrieves the department's baseline ICT equipment and software inventory.
 * Strictly scoped so department planners view ONLY their own assets (Rule 9).
 * Supports optional filtering by DICT standard category (dict_category), search query,
 * obsolescence/EOL flags, software classification, and condition status.
 *
 * @param {number|Object} paramsOrSkip - Pagination offset (number) OR options/filter object
 * @param {number} limit - Items per page (if first parameter is numeric offset)
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function getInventory(paramsOrSkip = 0, limit = 100, customToken = null) {
  const queryParams = new URLSearchParams();
  let token = customToken;

  if (typeof paramsOrSkip === "object" && paramsOrSkip !== null) {
    const {
      skip = 0,
      limit: lim = 100,
      search = "",
      dict_category = "",
      dictCategory = "",
      is_software = null,
      isSoftware = null,
      is_end_of_life = null,
      isEndOfLife = null,
      status_filter = "",
      statusFilter = "",
      token: optToken = null
    } = paramsOrSkip;

    queryParams.append("skip", String(skip));
    queryParams.append("limit", String(lim));
    if (search) queryParams.append("search", String(search).trim());

    const resolvedCategory = dict_category || dictCategory;
    if (resolvedCategory && resolvedCategory !== "All") {
      queryParams.append("dict_category", String(resolvedCategory).trim());
    }

    const resolvedIsSoftware = is_software !== null ? is_software : isSoftware;
    if (resolvedIsSoftware !== null && resolvedIsSoftware !== undefined) {
      queryParams.append("is_software", String(resolvedIsSoftware));
    }

    const resolvedEol = is_end_of_life !== null ? is_end_of_life : isEndOfLife;
    if (resolvedEol !== null && resolvedEol !== undefined) {
      queryParams.append("is_end_of_life", String(resolvedEol));
    }

    const resolvedStatus = status_filter || statusFilter;
    if (resolvedStatus && resolvedStatus !== "All") {
      queryParams.append("status_filter", String(resolvedStatus).trim());
    }

    if (optToken) token = optToken;
  } else {
    queryParams.append("skip", String(paramsOrSkip));
    queryParams.append("limit", String(limit));
  }

  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/inventory?${queryParams.toString()}`, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, token)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load departmental baseline inventory");
}

/**
 * Logs an inventory asset into Annex 1.
 * Routes to the master supply handler with fallback support.
 * Explicitly preserves dict_category and other_category_name in payload.
 *
 * @param {Object} payload - SupplyInventoryCreate schema (including dict_category and other_category_name)
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function logExistingAsset(payload, customToken = null) {
  let res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/supply/inventory`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });

  if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 405) {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/inventory`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
  }

  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to register baseline inventory asset");
}

// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Retrieves the collaborative discussion thread and admin remarks for a proposal.
 *
 * @param {string} proposalId - UUID of the proposal
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function getComments(proposalId, customToken = null) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}/comments`, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load proposal comments thread");
}

/**
 * Posts an inline feedback remark or flags a revision action item on a proposal.
 *
 * @param {string} proposalId - UUID of the proposal
 * @param {Object} payload - CommentCreate schema
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function postComment(proposalId, payload, customToken = null) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}/comments`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to post comment");
}

/**
 * Marks a flagged administrative action item as resolved,
 * releasing the submission lock on the proposal draft.
 *
 * @param {string} proposalId - UUID of the proposal
 * @param {string} commentId - Unique identifier of the pinned remark
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function resolveComment(proposalId, commentId, customToken = null) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}/comments/${encodeURIComponent(commentId)}/resolve`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to resolve action item");
}

// ==============================================================================
// 10. NOTIFICATIONS INBOX & ACTION ITEMS COUNTER
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Retrieves unified audit alerts, status transitions, and pending feedback
 * for the department's workspace inbox.
 *
 * @param {string|null} category - Optional notification filter
 * @param {number|null} days - Optional days horizon filter
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function getNotifications(category = null, days = null, customToken = null) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (category) params.append("category", category);
  if (days) params.append("days", String(days));

  const qs = params.toString();
  const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/notifications${qs ? `?${qs}` : ""}`;

  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load workspace notifications");
}

/**
 * Queries counts of unresolved action items and returned proposals.
 * Used by NotificationContext to render live red badges in the sidebar.
 *
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function getActionItemsSummary(customToken = null) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/action-items/summary`, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load action items summary count");
}

import React from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, Info, X } from "lucide-react";

export default function AlertBanner({ text, type = "info", onDismiss = null }) {
  const configs = {
    success: {
      style: "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-955/30 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
      icon: <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    warning: {
      style: "bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-955/30 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:text-amber-300",
      icon: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    danger: {
      style: "bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-955/30 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:text-rose-300",
      icon: <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    info: {
      style: "bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-955/30 dark:border-blue-900/60 dark:text-blue-300",
      icon: <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
    }
  };

  const { style, icon } = configs[type] || configs.info;

  return (
    <div className={`p-3.5 border rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed flex items-start justify-between gap-3 shadow-2xs ${style}`}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
        <span className="mt-0.5">{icon}</span>
        <span>{text}</span>
      </div>
      {onDismiss && (
        <button onClick={onDismiss} className="text-current opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer">
          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/DataTable.jsx
import React from "react";

export default function DataTable({ 
  headers = [], 
  data = [], 
  renderRow, 
  emptyMessage = "No active records found.",
  headerActions = null 
}) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
      {headerActions && (
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
          {headerActions}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[9.5px] tracking-wider font-mono">
              {headers.map((header, idx) => (
                <th key={idx} className="p-3.5">
                  {header}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            {data.length > 0 ? (
              data.map((item, idx) => renderRow(item, idx))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={headers.length} className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
                  {emptyMessage}
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/Modal.jsx
import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

export default function Modal({ 
  isOpen, 
  onClose, 
  title, 
  subtitle = null,
  size = "md",
  children,
  footer = null
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen && onClose) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: "max-w-sm",
    md: "max-w-lg",
    lg: "max-w-2xl",
    xl: "max-w-4xl",
    "2xl": "max-w-6xl"
  }[size] || "max-w-lg";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className={`bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl w-full ${sizeClasses} flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans`}
      >
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{title}</h3>
            {subtitle && (
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <div className="px-6 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../context/CycleContext";
import { useNotifications } from "../../context/NotificationContext";
import { useTheme } from "../../context/ThemeContext";
import { 
  Search, Bell, Mail, CheckCircle2, Sun, Moon, 
  LayoutDashboard, FolderKanban, Database, 
  Landmark, Coins, TrendingUp, Users, 
  ImageIcon, History, LogOut,
  ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Key, FileText,
  ClipboardList, UploadCloud, Inbox, BookOpen,
  GraduationCap, ShieldCheck, MapPin, Network,
  ShieldAlert, CheckSquare, Activity,
  FileBarChart, MessageSquare, ArrowRight, X
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DashboardLayout() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { user, logoutSession } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, agencyLogoUrl, agencyName: cycleAgencyName } = useCycle();
  const { actionCount, returnedCount, recentNotifications, recentRemarks } = useNotifications();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  const [globalSearch, setGlobalSearch] = useState("");
  const [headroom, setHeadroom] = useState(null);
  const searchInputRef = useRef(null);

  const [activePopover, setActivePopover] = useState(null);
  const popoverRef = useRef(null);

  const [openSections, setOpenSections] = useState({
    dashboards: true,
    strategy: true,
    finance: true,
    governance: true
  });

  const toggleSection = (sectionKey) => {
    setOpenSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [sectionKey]: !prev[sectionKey] }));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (popoverRef.current && !popoverRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setActivePopover(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        searchInputRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const defaultAgencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME || "National Government Agency";
  const agencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_AGENCY_NAME || cycleAgencyName || user?.agency_name || defaultAgencyName;
  const userEmail = user?.email || "admin@agency.gov.ph";
  const userRole = user?.role || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";

  const deptName = user?.department_name || (
    userRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" 
      ? "MIS Governance Directorate" 
      : userRole === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER" 
      ? "Property & Supply Office" 
      : "Department Planning Office"
  );

  const currentPath = location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  const breadcrumbSection = currentPath[0]?.toUpperCase() || "WORKSPACE";
  const breadcrumbPage = currentPath[1] 
    ? currentPath[1].replace(/-/g, " ").toUpperCase() 
    : "DASHBOARD";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userRole === "ROLE_DEPT_USER") {
      const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
      const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
      const authToken = user?.token || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";

      fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/dept/budget-summary`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}` }
      })
      .then(res => res.ok ? res.json() : null)
      .then(data => data && setHeadroom(data))
      .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [userRole, user?.token, activeCycle]);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    if (logoutSession) logoutSession();
    navigate("/login");
  };

  const executeGlobalSearch = () => {
    if (!globalSearch.trim()) return;
    const q = encodeURIComponent(globalSearch.trim());
    if (userRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN") {
      navigate(`/admin/queue?search=${q}`);
    } else if (userRole === "ROLE_DEPT_USER") {
      navigate(`/dept/proposals?search=${q}`);
    } else {
      navigate(`/supply/inventory?search=${q}`);
    }
    setGlobalSearch("");

// frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

/**
 * Safe Base64-URL decoding utility.
 * Handles URL-safe character conversions (- to +, _ to /), proper padding,
 * and multi-byte UTF-8 string encoding to prevent window.atob exceptions.
 */
const safeDecodeJWT = (token) => {
  if (!token || typeof token !== "string") return null;
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;

    const base64Url = parts[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const paddedBase64 = base64.padEnd(base64.length + (4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4, '=');

    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      window.atob(paddedBase64)
        .split('')
        .map((c) => '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join('')
    );
    return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("JWT Decoding Failure:", error);
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Targeted Storage Cleanup.
 * Wipes only authentication-specific keys, avoiding destruction of unrelated
 * storage keys like UI theme preferences or table sorting states.
 */
const clearAuthSession = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
  localStorage.removeItem("user_role");
  localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
  localStorage.removeItem("user_email");
};

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Synchronizes and restores existing session credentials on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem("access_token");
      const storedRole = localStorage.getItem("user_role");
      const storedDeptId = localStorage.getItem("department_id");
      const storedEmail = localStorage.getItem("user_email");

      if (token) {
        const payload = safeDecodeJWT(token);

        if (payload) {
          // Hydration Deadlock & Clock Skew Guard:
          // Uses a 60-second grace window to absorb system clock drift.
          const isExpired = payload.exp ? (((payload.exp * 1000) - 60000) <= Date.now()) : false;

          if (!isExpired) {
            const resolvedRole = payload.role || storedRole || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";
            const resolvedEmail = payload.sub || storedEmail || "";
            const rawDept = payload.dept_id !== undefined ? payload.dept_id : storedDeptId;
            const resolvedDeptId = rawDept !== null && rawDept !== undefined && rawDept !== "null"
              ? parseInt(rawDept, 10) 
              : null;

            setUser({
              token,
              email: resolvedEmail,
              role: resolvedRole,
              department_id: resolvedDeptId
            });
          } else {
            console.warn("Hydration pre-flight notice: Access token has expired. Clearing session.");
            clearAuthSession();
            setUser(null);
          }
        } else {
          console.error("Malformed authentication token encountered. Purging session.");
          clearAuthSession();
          setUser(null);
        }
      } else {
        setUser(null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to restore previous authentication session:", e);
      clearAuthSession();
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  /**
   * Atomically commits user credentials and claims to both state and localStorage.
   * Automatically decodes the JWT token to extract the user's email (`sub`) if not explicitly supplied.
   *
   * @param {string} token - Bearer JWT access token
   * @param {string} role - Authorization role tag (e.g., ROLE_MIS_ADMIN, ROLE_DEPT_USER, ROLE_SUPPLY_USER)
   * @param {number|string|null} departmentId - Assigned institutional unit ID
   * @param {string|null} email - Optional explicit email override
   */
  const loginSession = (token, role, departmentId, email = null) => {
    const payload = safeDecodeJWT(token);
    const resolvedEmail = email || payload?.sub || "";
    const resolvedRole = role || payload?.role || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";
    const rawDept = departmentId !== undefined && departmentId !== null ? departmentId : payload?.dept_id;
    const resolvedDeptId = rawDept !== null && rawDept !== undefined && rawDept !== "null"
      ? parseInt(rawDept, 10)
      : null;

    localStorage.setItem("access_token", token);
    localStorage.setItem("user_role", resolvedRole);

    if (resolvedEmail) {
      localStorage.setItem("user_email", resolvedEmail);
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem("user_email");
    }

    if (resolvedDeptId !== null && !isNaN(resolvedDeptId)) {
      localStorage.setItem("department_id", String(resolvedDeptId));
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
    }

    setUser({
      token,
      email: resolvedEmail,
      role: resolvedRole,
      department_id: resolvedDeptId
    });
  };

  /**
   * Dynamically updates user metadata in context and localStorage without requiring a full re-login.
   *
   * @param {Object} updates - Object containing fields to update (e.g., { email, role, department_id })
   */
  const updateUser = (updates) => {
    setUser((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return null;
      const next = { ...prev, ...updates };

      if (updates.role) localStorage.setItem("user_role", updates.role);
      if (updates.email) localStorage.setItem("user_email", updates.email);
      if (updates.department_id !== undefined) {
        if (updates.department_id !== null && !isNaN(updates.department_id)) {
          localStorage.setItem("department_id", String(updates.department_id));
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
        }
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  /**
   * Atomically clears all active session parameters to prevent authorization leaks.
   */
  const logoutSession = () => {
    clearAuthSession();
    setUser(null);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, loginSession, logoutSession, updateUser }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useAuth must be consumed within an AuthProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/CycleContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

const CycleContext = createContext(null);

const rawRoot = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
const API_ROOT = rawRoot.endsWith("/") ? rawRoot.slice(0, -1) : rawRoot;

export function CycleProvider({ children }) {
  const [activeCycle, setActiveCycleState] = useState("2026-2028");
  const [planningYears, setPlanningYears] = useState([2026, 2027, 2028]);
  const [fromYear, setFromYear] = useState(2026);
  const [toYear, setToYear] = useState(2028);
  const [agencyName, setAgencyName] = useState(
    import.meta.env?.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME || 
    import.meta.env?.VITE_AGENCY_NAME || 
    "National Government Agency"
  );
  const [agencyLogoUrl, setAgencyLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [dictLogoUrl, setDictLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [bagongPilipinasLogoUrl, setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [cycleLoading, setCycleLoading] = useState(true);

  const computeYearsFromPeriod = (period, startHint = null, endHint = null) => {
    if (!period) return { start: 2026, end: 2028, years: [2026, 2027, 2028] };

    const parts = String(period).trim().split("-");
    let start = startHint ? parseInt(startHint, 10) : parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    let end = endHint ? parseInt(endHint, 10) : (parts.length > 1 ? parseInt(parts[1], 10) : start);

    if (isNaN(start)) start = 2026;
    if (isNaN(end)) end = start;

    if (start > end) {
      const temp = start;
      start = end;
      end = temp;
    }

    const years = [];
    for (let y = start; y <= end; y++) {
      years.push(y);
    }

    return { start, end, years };
  };

  const setActiveCycle = useCallback((period, customFrom = null, customTo = null) => {
    setActiveCycleState(period);
    const { start, end, years } = computeYearsFromPeriod(period, customFrom, customTo);
    setFromYear(start);
    setToYear(end);
    setPlanningYears(years);
  }, []);

  const setAgencyBranding = useCallback((branding) => {
    if (branding?.agency_name) setAgencyName(branding.agency_name);
    if (branding?.agency_logo_url !== undefined) setAgencyLogoUrl(branding.agency_logo_url);
    if (branding?.dict_logo_url !== undefined) setDictLogoUrl(branding.dict_logo_url);
    if (branding?.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url !== undefined) setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl(branding.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url);
  }, []);

  const fetchActiveCycle = useCallback(async () => {
    setCycleLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_ROOT}/api/auth/active-cycle`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.issp_period) {
          setActiveCycleState(data.issp_period);
          const { start, end, years } = computeYearsFromPeriod(
            data.issp_period,
            data.from_year,
            data.to_year
          );
          setFromYear(start);
          setToYear(end);
          setPlanningYears(years);
        }
        if (data.agency_name) {
          setAgencyName(data.agency_name);
        }
        if (data.agency_logo_url) {
          setAgencyLogoUrl(data.agency_logo_url);
        }
        if (data.dict_logo_url) {
          setDictLogoUrl(data.dict_logo_url);
        }
        if (data.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url) {
          setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl(data.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to load active cycle and agency branding:", e);
    } finally {
      setCycleLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchActiveCycle();
  }, [fetchActiveCycle]);

  const cycleSpan = planningYears.length;

  return (
    <CycleContext.Provider
      value={{
        activeCycle,
        setActiveCycle,
        planningYears,
        setPlanningYears,
        fromYear,
        toYear,
        cycleSpan,
        cycleLoading,
        agencyName,
        agencyLogoUrl,
        dictLogoUrl,
        bagongPilipinasLogoUrl,
        setAgencyBranding,
        fetchActiveCycle,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </CycleContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCycle = () => {
  const context = useContext(CycleContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCycle must be consumed within a CycleProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/NotificationContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from './AuthContext';

const NotificationContext = createContext(null);

export function NotificationProvider({ children }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [actionCount, setActionCount] = useState(0);
  const [returnedCount, setReturnedCount] = useState(0);
  const [recentNotifications, setRecentNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [recentRemarks, setRecentRemarks] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user?.token) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      if (user.role === 'ROLE_DEPT_USER') {
        const summaryRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/dept/action-items/summary`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
        });
        if (summaryRes.ok) {
          const sData = await summaryRes.json();
          setActionCount(sData.unread_actions || 0);
          setReturnedCount(sData.returned_proposals || 0);
        }

        const notifRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/dept/notifications?days=14`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
        });
        if (notifRes.ok) {
          const nData = await notifRes.json();
          const items = Array.isArray(nData) ? nData : [];
          setRecentNotifications(items.filter(i => i.type !== 'comment'));
          setRecentRemarks(items.filter(i => i.type === 'comment'));
        }
      } else if (user.role === 'ROLE_MIS_ADMIN') {
        const auditRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/audit-logs`, {
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
        });
        if (auditRes.ok) {
          const aData = await auditRes.json();
          const logs = Array.isArray(aData) ? aData.slice(0, 10) : [];
          
          setRecentNotifications(logs.map(l => ({
            id: String(l.id),
            title: l.action.replace(/_/g, ' '),
            description: l.new_value ? Object.entries(l.new_value).slice(0, 2).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join(' | ') : 'System Audit Log',
            type: l.module === 'AUTHENTICATION' ? 'security' : l.module === 'PROPOSALS' ? 'status_change' : 'budget',
            timestamp: l.timestamp,
            ref_id: l.proposal_id || '',
            url_path: l.proposal_id ? '/admin/queue' : '/admin/audit'
          })));

          const propRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/proposals?status_filter=Submitted`, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user.token}` }
          });
          if (propRes.ok) {
            const pData = await propRes.json();
            const count = pData.total !== undefined ? pData.total : (Array.isArray(pData) ? pData.length : 0);
            setActionCount(count);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("Failed to update notification feeds:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user, apiUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchNotifications, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchNotifications]);

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider
      value={{
        actionCount,
        returnedCount,
        recentNotifications,
        recentRemarks,
        loading,
        fetchNotifications
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useNotifications = () => {
  const context = useContext(NotificationContext);
  if (!context) {
    return { 
      actionCount: 0, 
      returnedCount: 0, 
      recentNotifications: [], 
      recentRemarks: [], 
      loading: false, 
      fetchNotifications: async () => {} 
    };
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  // Safe initialization with localStorage or dark mode default fallback
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme");
      if (savedTheme === "light" || savedTheme === "dark") {
        return savedTheme;
      }
      // Standard preference check, default to dark to match the CSPC academic layout
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      return prefersDark ? "dark" : "dark"; 
    } catch (e) {
      return "dark";
    }
  });

  // Automatically apply the target theme class to the document root element
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const root = window.document.documentElement;
      if (theme === "dark") {
        root.classList.add("dark");
        root.style.colorScheme = "dark";
      } else {
        root.classList.remove("dark");
        root.style.colorScheme = "light";
      }
      localStorage.setItem("theme", theme);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to persist theme state to storage:", e);
    }
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((prevTheme) => (prevTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme, toggleTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTheme must be consumed within a ThemeProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
}

                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Custom Items</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-sm">{dept.custom_proposals}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Custom Ratio</span>
                  <span className={`font-bold text-sm ${hasAbuse ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                    {dept.custom_ratio_percent}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Progress Bar */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Custom Ratio:</span>
                  <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${hasAbuse ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                    {customRatio}% {hasAbuse ? "(Exceeds 20.0% Threshold)" : "(Within Limit)"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <div 
                    className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${hasAbuse ? "bg-rose-500" : "bg-blue-600"}`} 
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(customRatio, 100)}%` }} 
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center text-[10.5px]">
                <span className="text-slate-500">
                  Missing Canvas: <strong className={dept.missing_canvas_count > 0 ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"}>{dept.missing_canvas_count} items</strong>
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/admin/queue?dept_id=${dept.department_id}`)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline font-bold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>Inspect Queue</span>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\admin\Audit\AuditTrails.jsx
