// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/DocumentStructureManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  FolderTree, 
  FileText, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronDown, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  Settings2, 
  ArrowUp, 
  ArrowDown, 
  AlignLeft, 
  Layout, 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw,
  AlertTriangle,
  FolderOpen
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DocumentStructureManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  
  const [treeData, setTreeData] = useState([]);
  const [selectedNode, setSelectedNode] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Expanded tree node tracked states
  const [expandedNodes, setExpandedNodes] = useState({});

  // Node editing state variables
  const [displayTitle, setDisplayTitle] = useState("");
  const [tocLabel, setTocLabel] = useState("");
  const [forcePageBreak, setForcePageBreak] = useState(false);
  const [orientation, setPageOrientation] = useState("landscape");
  const [nodeType, setNodeType] = useState("section");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchDocumentTree = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/document-tree`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setTreeData(data);
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to load document skeletal hierarchy.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchDocumentTree();
    }
  }, [token]);

  const toggleExpand = (nodeId) => {
    setExpandedNodes(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [nodeId]: !prev[nodeId]
    }));
  };

  const handleSelectNode = (node) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSelectedNode(node);
    setDisplayTitle(node.vocabulary?.display_title || "");
    setTocLabel(node.vocabulary?.toc_label || "");
    setForcePageBreak(node.force_page_break);
    setPageOrientation(node.page_orientation);
    setNodeType(node.node_type);
  };

  // Node Addition Handler
  const handleAddNode = async (parentId = null) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/nodes`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          parent_id: parentId,
          node_type: "section",
          system_key: `NODE_${uuidv4().substring(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
          sequence_order: 1.000,
          page_orientation: "landscape",
          force_page_break: false
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to append node.");
      setSuccess("New structural node added. Set properties in the editor.");
      fetchDocumentTree();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  // Node Reordering Handler
  const handleReorder = async (nodeId, direction) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/reorder`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          node_id: nodeId,
          direction: direction // "up", "down", "indent", "outdent"
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to adjust sequence position.");
      setSuccess("Sequence reordered.");
      fetchDocumentTree();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  // Save Node Details Update
  const handleSaveProperties = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedNode) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/nodes/${selectedNode.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          node_type: nodeType,
          page_orientation: orientation,
          force_page_break: forcePageBreak,
          vocabulary: {
            display_title: displayTitle.trim(),
            toc_label: tocLabel.trim()
          }
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to update node configuration.");
      setSuccess("Properties saved successfully.");
      fetchDocumentTree();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Node deletion Handler
  const handleDeleteNode = async (nodeId) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently delete this node and all of its children?")) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/nodes/${nodeId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to delete node.");
      setSuccess("Structural node removed.");
      setSelectedNode(null);
      fetchDocumentTree();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  // Helper utility to generate unique UUIDs for placeholder keys
  const uuidv4 = () => {
    return "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {
      const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0,
        v = c === "x" ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
      return v.toString(16);
    });
  };

  // Recursive Tree Rendering inside Sidebar Workspace
  const renderTreeNodes = (nodes) => {
    return (
      <ul className="space-y-1.5 pl-4 border-l border-slate-800/80">
        {nodes.map(node => {
          const hasChildren = node.children && node.children.length > 0;
          const isExpanded = !!expandedNodes[node.id];
          const isSelected = selectedNode?.id === node.id;

          return (
            <li key={node.id} className="space-y-1 animate-fadeIn">
              <div 
                className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg transition-all text-xs ${
                  isSelected 
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-600/10" 
                    : "bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-900 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-900/60"
                }`}
              >
                <div 
                  onClick={() => handleSelectNode(node)} 
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer flex-1 truncate pr-2"
                >
                  {hasChildren ? (
                    <button 
                      type="button" 
                      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleExpand(node.id); }}
                      className="p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-800/60 rounded text-slate-500"
                    >
                      {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="font-bold font-mono tracking-tight text-[10px] text-blue-400 bg-blue-950/45 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-900/40 shrink-0">
                    {node.sequence_order}
                  </span>
                  <span className="truncate font-semibold text-[11px]">
                    {node.vocabulary?.display_title || node.system_key}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Inline Reordering & Child Actions */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleReorder(node.id, "up")}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400"
                    title="Move Up"
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleReorder(node.id, "down")}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400"
                    title="Move Down"
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleReorder(node.id, "indent")}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400"
                    title="Indent (Nest Child)"
                  >
                    <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleReorder(node.id, "outdent")}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400"
                    title="Outdent"
                  >
                    <AlignLeft className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleAddNode(node.id)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400"
                    title="Append Child Section"
                  >
                    <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  </button>
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteNode(node.id)}
                    className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400"
                    title="Delete Node"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {hasChildren && isExpanded && (
                <div className="mt-1">
                  {renderTreeNodes(node.children)}
                </div>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-100 select-none max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <FolderTree className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT Document Hierarchy Tree Manager</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Build strict document layouts, orient landscape diagrams, and manage sequential DICT vocabulary definitions.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchDocumentTree}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded border border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Hierarchy</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-955/20 border border-red-900 text-red-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Left Panel: Draggable/Reorderable Tree Skelton */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
              <span>Skeletal Tree Outline</span>
            </h3>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleAddNode(null)}
              className="p-1 px-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white rounded text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Part / Root</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-2">
            {loading && treeData.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading document mapping...</span>
              </div>
            ) : treeData.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="-ml-4">
                {renderTreeNodes(treeData)}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500 italic">
                Tree is currently empty. Define a parent Root node to begin.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Panel: Content / Vocabulary editor for Selected Node */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
          {selectedNode ? (
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveProperties} className="space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Settings2 className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                  <span>Configure Node: {selectedNode.system_key}</span>
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 text-slate-500 font-mono select-all">
                  Node Index: {selectedNode.id}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">RICT Structural Type</label>
                  <select
                    value={nodeType}
                    onChange={(e) => setNodeType(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-white"
                  >
                    <option value="root">Root</option>
                    <option value="part">Part / Chapter</option>
                    <option value="section">Section</option>
                    <option value="subsection">Subsection</option>
                    <option value="leaf">Leaf Node</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Page Orientation</label>
                  <select
                    value={orientation}
                    onChange={(e) => setPageOrientation(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-955 border border-slate-855 rounded-lg text-white"
                  >
                    <option value="portrait">Portrait Orientation</option>
                    <option value="landscape">Landscape Orientation</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Vocabulary Display Properties */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-850 space-y-4 font-sans">
                <span className="block text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">
                  Vocabulary Dictionary Validation (TOC Alignment)
                </span>
                
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Official Title Header</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={displayTitle}
                    onChange={(e) => setDisplayTitle(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. A.1. Mandate (Legal Basis)"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white font-semibold font-mono"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">TOC Short Label</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={tocLabel}
                    onChange={(e) => setTocLabel(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. A.1. Mandate"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Force Page Break toggle */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-slate-955/50 border border-slate-850/80 rounded-xl">
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-300 tracking-wider block">Force Page Break</label>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Inject break tags before rendering this node.</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={forcePageBreak}
                  onChange={(e) => setForcePageBreak(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 pt-2"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Preserving Properties..." : "Save Properties"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-slate-500 gap-2 text-center max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed border-2 border-dashed border-slate-850 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/20">
              <Settings2 className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-600 animate-pulse" />
              <p className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Node Editor Sandbox</p>
              <p className="text-[10px]">Click any structural node in the tree outline to edit display titles, TOC mappings, and page properties.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\admin\Narrative\GanttScheduleManager.jsx

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/GanttScheduleManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
  ChevronRight,
  FolderKanban,
  Clock,
  Activity,
  Sparkles,
  Info
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GanttScheduleManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, planningYears } = useCycle();
  
  // Data States
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Notification States
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiEndpoint = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") : "");

  // Safe fallback for planning years
  const activeYears = (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) ? planningYears : [2026, 2027, 2028];
  const quarters = ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"];

  const fetchSchedulesAndProjects = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!activeCycle || !token) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // 1. Fetch Narrative to retrieve saved implementation_schedules
      const narrativeRes = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      const narrativeData = narrativeRes.ok ? await narrativeRes.json() : {};
      const savedSchedules = Array.isArray(narrativeData.implementation_schedules) 
        ? narrativeData.implementation_schedules 
        : [];

      // 2. Fetch Active ICT Projects (Part III.E) to ensure complete synchronization
      const projRes = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/ict-projects?issp_period=${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      const projData = projRes.ok ? await projRes.json() : [];
      const activeProjects = Array.isArray(projData) ? projData : (projData.data || []);

      // 3. Intelligently merge Part III.E projects with saved milestones
      if (activeProjects.length > 0) {
        const merged = activeProjects.map(proj => {
          const existing = savedSchedules.find(s => 
            (s.project_id && String(s.project_id) === String(proj.id)) ||
            (s.project_name && s.project_name.toLowerCase().trim() === (proj.project_title || "").toLowerCase().trim())
          );
          return {
            project_id: proj.id,
            project_name: proj.project_title,
            milestones: existing?.milestones || {}
          };
        });
        setSchedules(merged);
      } else {
        setSchedules(savedSchedules);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve implementation schedule matrices.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [activeCycle, apiEndpoint, token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchSchedulesAndProjects();
    }
  }, [fetchSchedulesAndProjects, token, activeCycle]);

  const handleToggleQuarter = (projectIndex, key) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    
    const updatedSchedules = [...schedules];
    const project = { ...updatedSchedules[projectIndex] };
    const currentMilestones = { ...(project.milestones || {}) };
    
    currentMilestones[key] = !currentMilestones[key];
    project.milestones = currentMilestones;
    updatedSchedules[projectIndex] = project;
    
    setSchedules(updatedSchedules);
  };

  const handleSaveTimelines = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiEndpoint}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ implementation_schedules: schedules })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to preserve quarterly implementation milestones.");
      }

      setSuccess("Gantt timeline implementation schedule preserved successfully.");
      fetchSchedulesAndProjects();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save Gantt milestone configurations.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // KPI Calculations
  const totalProjectsCount = schedules.length;
  const activeMilestonesCount = schedules.reduce((total, row) => {
    return total + Object.values(row.milestones || {}).filter(Boolean).length;
  }, 0);
  const totalQuartersSpan = activeYears.length * 4;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Title Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500" />
            <span>Interactive Gantt Timeline Editor (Part III.E Implementation Schedule)</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Configure quarterly deployment milestones and schedules across the planning horizon (FY {activeCycle}). Automatically synchronizes with Part III.E ICT projects.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={fetchSchedulesAndProjects}
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs font-bold"
            title="Refresh Milestones"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span>Sync</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleSaveTimelines}
            disabled={submitting || loading || schedules.length === 0}
            className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-sm"
          >
            <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{submitting ? "Preserving..." : "Save Timelines"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Aggregate KPI Metric Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Scheduled Projects</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{totalProjectsCount} Initiatives</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Active Quarter Blocks</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{activeMilestonesCount} Milestones</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Planning Horizon</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{activeYears.length} Years ({totalQuartersSpan} Quarters)</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Timeline Editor Board Container */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
            <span>Quarterly Deployment Milestones Matrix (Click blocks to toggle execution quarters)</span>
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold">
            Horizon: FY {activeCycle || "N/A"}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
              <span>Parsing schedule matrix and registered ICT projects...</span>
            </div>
          ) : schedules.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-center border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <th className="p-4 text-left border-r border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 w-1/4 min-w-[240px] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Project Strategic Module
                  </th>
                  {activeYears.map(year => (
                    <th key={year} colSpan={4} className="border-r border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs py-2.5 font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                      FY {year}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 font-mono text-[9px] text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <th className="border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800"></th>
                  {activeYears.map(year => (
                    quarters.map(q => (
                      <th key={`${year}_${q}`} className="border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 py-1.5 uppercase font-bold text-center">
                        {q}
                      </th>
                    ))
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                {schedules.map((row, projectIdx) => (
                  <tr key={row.project_id || projectIdx} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/30 transition-colors">
                    {/* Project Title Column */}
                    <td className="text-left font-bold p-4 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 max-w-[240px] break-words">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{row.project_name}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Timeline Block Toggles */}
                    {activeYears.map(year => (
                      quarters.map(q => {
                        const key = `${year}_${q}`;
                        const active = !!row.milestones?.[key];
                        return (
                          <td key={key} className="border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 p-2 relative">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleToggleQuarter(projectIdx, key)}
                              className={`w-full h-8 rounded-md border cursor-pointer transition-all duration-150 flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[9px] font-bold ${
                                active 
                                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-xs dark:bg-blue-600/30 dark:border-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400 dark:shadow-inner dark:shadow-blue-500/20" 
                                  : "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955/60 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-950"
                              }`}
                              title={`${row.project_name} - FY ${year} ${q} (Click to toggle)`}
                            >
                              <span>{active ? "ACTIVE" : "—"}</span>
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        );
                      })
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
              No project implementation schedules found for active cycle '{activeCycle}'. Register projects in Part III.E to populate this matrix.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\admin\Narrative\MithiSurveys.jsx

// frontend/src/views/admin/Narrative/MithiSurveys.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Network, 
  HardDrive, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Archive, 
  AlertTriangle,
  Globe,
  Wifi,
  Users,
  FileText
} from "lucide-react";

export default function MithiSurveys() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // 1. Network Profile States (Fully Parameterized)
  const [hasLan, setHasLan] = useState(true);
  const [hasIntranet, setHasIntranet] = useState(false);
  const [hasVpn, setHasVpn] = useState(false);
  const [isConnectedToInternet, setIsConnectedToInternet] = useState(true);
  const [isps, setIsps] = useState("GovNet, Dedicated Leased Line, Commercial ISP");
  const [internetAccessModes, setInternetAccessModes] = useState("Dedicated Leased Line, Fiber Optic");
  const [internetBandwidth, setInternetBandwidth] = useState("100");
  const [employeesWithInternet, setEmployeesWithInternet] = useState("100");
  const [employeesWithEmail, setEmployeesWithEmail] = useState("100");

  // 2. Data Center Profile States
  const [hasDataCenter, setHasDataCenter] = useState(true);
  const [activeServersCount, setActiveServersCount] = useState(2);
  const [hasBackupSite, setHasBackupSite] = useState(false);
  const [maintenanceStrategy, setMaintenanceStrategy] = useState("In-house");

  // 3. Section 4: Security, Disaster Recovery & Backup States
  const [hasSecurityPolicy, setHasSecurityPolicy] = useState(false);
  const [hasDrPlan, setHasDrPlan] = useState(false);
  const [hasBackUpPower, setHasBackUpPower] = useState(false);
  const [hasDigitalSignatures, setHasDigitalSignatures] = useState(false);
  const [hasEncryption, setHasEncryption] = useState(false);
  const [hasOffsiteBackup, setHasOffsiteBackup] = useState(false);
  const [hasHardwareFirewall, setHasHardwareFirewall] = useState(false);

  // 4. Section 5: Data Archiving States (Fully Parameterized - Neutral Government Records)
  const [hasArchivingSystem, setHasArchivingSystem] = useState(false);
  const [archivingMode, setArchivingMode] = useState("Electronic");
  const [archivingMedium, setArchivingMedium] = useState("Hard Disk, Cloud Storage, NAS");
  const [archivedInformation, setArchivedInformation] = useState(
    "Official Publications, Public Registry Records, Executive Directives, Financial Ledgers"
  );

  // 5. Section 8.2: ICT Governance Bottlenecks
  const [hasBudgetIssues, setHasBudgetIssues] = useState(false);
  const [hasProcurementIssues, setHasProcurementIssues] = useState(false);
  const [hasReluctantStakeholders, setHasReluctantStakeholders] = useState(false);
  const [hasEmployeeSkillsIssues, setHasEmployeeSkillsIssues] = useState(false);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token;

  const fetchSurvey = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        
        // 1. Network Profile
        const net = data.mithi_network_profile || {};
        setHasLan(net.has_lan ?? true);
        setHasIntranet(net.has_intranet ?? false);
        setHasVpn(net.has_vpn ?? false);
        setIsConnectedToInternet(net.is_connected_to_internet ?? true);
        setIsps(
          Array.isArray(net.isps) 
            ? net.isps.join(", ") 
            : (net.isps || "GovNet, Dedicated Leased Line, Commercial ISP")
        );
        setInternetAccessModes(
          Array.isArray(net.internet_access_modes) 
            ? net.internet_access_modes.join(", ") 
            : (net.internet_access_modes || "Dedicated Leased Line, Fiber Optic")
        );
        setInternetBandwidth(String(net.combined_bandwidth_mbps || "100"));
        setEmployeesWithInternet(String(net.employees_with_internet_access ?? "100"));
        setEmployeesWithEmail(String(net.employees_with_official_email ?? "100"));

        // 2. Data Center
        const dc = data.mithi_data_center || {};
        setHasDataCenter(dc.has_data_center ?? true);
        setActiveServersCount(dc.data_center_count || 0);
        setHasBackupSite(dc.has_backup_site ?? false);
        setMaintenanceStrategy(dc.maintenance_strategy || "In-house");

        // 3. Section 4: Security & DR
        const sec = data.mithi_security_dr || {};
        setHasSecurityPolicy(sec.has_security_policy ?? false);
        setHasDrPlan(sec.has_dr_plan ?? false);
        setHasBackUpPower(sec.has_back_up_power ?? false);
        setHasDigitalSignatures(sec.has_digital_signatures ?? false);
        setHasEncryption(sec.has_encryption ?? false);
        setHasOffsiteBackup(sec.has_offsite_backup ?? false);
        setHasHardwareFirewall(sec.has_hardware_firewall ?? false);

        // 4. Section 5: Archiving
        const arc = data.mithi_data_archiving || {};
        setHasArchivingSystem(arc.has_archiving_system ?? false);
        setArchivingMode(arc.archiving_mode || "Electronic");
        setArchivingMedium(
          Array.isArray(arc.archiving_medium) 
            ? arc.archiving_medium.join(", ") 
            : (arc.archiving_medium || "Hard Disk, Cloud Storage, NAS")
        );
        setArchivedInformation(
          Array.isArray(arc.archived_information) 
            ? arc.archived_information.join(", ") 
            : (arc.archived_information || "Official Publications, Public Registry Records, Executive Directives, Financial Ledgers")
        );

        // 5. Section 8.2: ICT Bottlenecks
        const iss = data.mithi_ict_issues || {};
        setHasBudgetIssues(iss.has_budget_issues ?? false);
        setHasProcurementIssues(iss.has_procurement_issues ?? false);
        setHasReluctantStakeholders(iss.has_reluctant_stakeholders ?? false);
        setHasEmployeeSkillsIssues(iss.has_employee_skills_issues ?? false);
      } else {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to query the survey parameters.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchSurvey();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    // Parse comma-separated inputs into clean string arrays
    const parsedIsps = isps
      ? isps.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : ["GovNet / Dedicated Leased Line"];

    const parsedAccessModes = internetAccessModes
      ? internetAccessModes.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : ["Dedicated Leased Line"];

    const parsedMedium = archivingMedium
      ? archivingMedium.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : ["Hard Disk", "Cloud Storage"];

    const parsedInfoTypes = archivedInformation
      ? archivedInformation.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : ["Official Publications", "Directives", "Records"];

    const networkPayload = {
      has_lan: hasLan,
      has_intranet: hasIntranet,
      has_vpn: hasVpn,
      is_connected_to_internet: isConnectedToInternet,
      internet_access_modes: parsedAccessModes,
      isps: parsedIsps,
      combined_bandwidth_mbps: parseInt(internetBandwidth, 10) || 0,
      employees_with_internet_access: parseInt(employeesWithInternet, 10) || 0,
      employees_with_official_email: parseInt(employeesWithEmail, 10) || 0
    };

    const dcPayload = {
      has_data_center: hasDataCenter,
      data_center_count: parseInt(activeServersCount, 10) || 0,
      has_backup_site: hasBackupSite,
      maintenance_strategy: maintenanceStrategy.trim() || "In-house"
    };

    const securityPayload = {
      has_security_policy: hasSecurityPolicy,
      has_dr_plan: hasDrPlan,
      has_back_up_power: hasBackUpPower,
      has_digital_signatures: hasDigitalSignatures,
      has_encryption: hasEncryption,
      has_offsite_backup: hasOffsiteBackup,
      has_hardware_firewall: hasHardwareFirewall
    };

    const archivingPayload = {
      has_archiving_system: hasArchivingSystem,
      archiving_mode: archivingMode,
      archiving_medium: parsedMedium,
      archived_information: parsedInfoTypes
    };

    const issuesPayload = {
      has_budget_issues: hasBudgetIssues,
      has_procurement_issues: hasProcurementIssues,
      has_reluctant_stakeholders: hasReluctantStakeholders,
      has_employee_skills_issues: hasEmployeeSkillsIssues
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          mithi_network_profile: networkPayload,
          mithi_data_center: dcPayload,
          mithi_security_dr: securityPayload,
          mithi_data_archiving: archivingPayload,
          mithi_ict_issues: issuesPayload
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Failed to update MITHI survey database parameters.");
      }
      
      setSuccess("ICT Infrastructure & MITHI Survey parameters updated successfully.");
      fetchSurvey();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none transition-colors duration-200">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Network className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500" />
            <span>MITHI Survey: ICT Infrastructure & Governance Readiness</span>
          </h2>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            Active Cycle: FY {activeCycle}
          </span>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{typeof error === "object" ? error.message : error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16 gap-2 text-slate-500">
            <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
            <span>Syncing infrastructure survey parameters...</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              
              {/* 1. Network Profile Segment (Dynamic ISPs & Metrics) */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <Network className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Section 1: Network Connectivity Survey</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Local Area Network (LAN) present</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasLan} onChange={(e) => setHasLan(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Institutional Intranet Portal</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasIntranet} onChange={(e) => setHasIntranet(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Virtual Private Network (VPN) Support</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasVpn} onChange={(e) => setHasVpn(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Internet Service Providers (Comma-Separated)</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={isps} 
                    onChange={(e) => setIsps(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. GovNet, Dedicated Leased Line, Commercial ISP"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Internet Access Modes (Comma-Separated)</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={internetAccessModes} 
                    onChange={(e) => setInternetAccessModes(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Leased Line, Fiber Optic, Fixed Wireless"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1 font-mono">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Bandwidth (Mbps)</label>
                    <input 
                      type="number" min="0" value={internetBandwidth} onChange={(e) => setInternetBandwidth(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-center"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Net Access (%)</label>
                    <input 
                      type="number" min="0" max="100" value={employeesWithInternet} onChange={(e) => setEmployeesWithInternet(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-center"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Email Access (%)</label>
                    <input 
                      type="number" min="0" max="100" value={employeesWithEmail} onChange={(e) => setEmployeesWithEmail(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-center"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 2. Data Center Profile Segment */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <HardDrive className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>Section 2: Data Center Profile</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">On-Premises Physical Data Center</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasDataCenter} onChange={(e) => setHasDataCenter(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-emerald-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Disaster Recovery (DR) Alternate Site</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasBackupSite} onChange={(e) => setHasBackupSite(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-emerald-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Active Physical / Virtual Server Count</label>
                  <input 
                    type="number" min="0" value={activeServersCount} onChange={(e) => setActiveServersCount(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono outline-none"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Maintenance Strategy</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" value={maintenanceStrategy} onChange={(e) => setMaintenanceStrategy(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. In-house, Vendor SLA, Managed Cloud Services"
                    className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 3. Section 4: Security & Disaster Recovery Checklist */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
                  <span>Section 4: Security & Disaster Recovery Checklist</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Formal Information Security Policy Adopted?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasSecurityPolicy} onChange={(e) => setHasSecurityPolicy(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Disaster Recovery (DR) Plan Established?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasDrPlan} onChange={(e) => setHasDrPlan(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Backup Power Generation (Generator / Rack UPS)?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasBackUpPower} onChange={(e) => setHasBackUpPower(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Employs Digital Signatures (PNPKI)?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasDigitalSignatures} onChange={(e) => setHasDigitalSignatures(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Database & Network Encryption Active?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasEncryption} onChange={(e) => setHasEncryption(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Automated Off-site Backups Configured?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasOffsiteBackup} onChange={(e) => setHasOffsiteBackup(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Hardware Firewalls (NGFW / WAF) Deployed?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasHardwareFirewall} onChange={(e) => setHasHardwareFirewall(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-purple-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 4. Section 5 & 8.2: Data Archiving & Institutional Bottlenecks */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
                  <Archive className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                  <span>Sections 5 & 8.2: Archiving & Governance Issues</span>
                </h4>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Active Electronic Archiving System?</label>
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" checked={hasArchivingSystem} onChange={(e) => setHasArchivingSystem(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 accent-amber-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                {hasArchivingSystem && (
                  <div className="space-y-3 animate-fadeIn">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Archiving Mode</label>
                      <select
                        value={archivingMode}
                        onChange={(e) => setArchivingMode(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <option value="Manual">Manual Filing</option>
                        <option value="Electronic">Electronic / Cold Cloud Tier</option>
                        <option value="Both">Hybrid (Manual + Electronic)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Archiving Storage Mediums (Comma-Separated)</label>
                      <input 
                        type="text" 
                        value={archivingMedium} 
                        onChange={(e) => setArchivingMedium(e.target.value)}

                      />
                    </div>

                      <label className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">Archived Record Types (Comma-Separated)</label>
                      <input 
                        type="text" 
                        value={archivedInformation} 
                        onChange={(e) => setArchivedInformation(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Official Communications, Public Registries, Audit Disclosures, Financial Statements"
                        className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850/60 pt-3 space-y-3">
                  <span className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                    <span>8.2 Institutional Implementation Issues</span>
                  </span>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Insufficient Budgetary Constraints?</label>
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" checked={hasBudgetIssues} onChange={(e) => setHasBudgetIssues(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Procurement & Public Bidding Delays?</label>
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" checked={hasProcurementIssues} onChange={(e) => setHasProcurementIssues(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Stakeholder Transition Reluctance?</label>
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" checked={hasReluctantStakeholders} onChange={(e) => setHasReluctantStakeholders(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400">Internal Technical Skills Gaps?</label>
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" checked={hasEmployeeSkillsIssues} onChange={(e) => setHasEmployeeSkillsIssues(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <button
              type="submit" 
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full p-3 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer text-xs shadow-md"
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Saving MITHI survey parameters...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Commit MITHI Survey Profiles</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

    if (!htmlString || typeof htmlString !== "string") return;
    setRawSec6Html(htmlString);

    const extractPillarText = (keyword) => {
      try {
        const regex = new RegExp(`<strong>${keyword}:?<\\/strong>\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(?=<\\/li>|<li>|$)`, "i");
        const match = htmlString.match(regex);
        if (match && match[1]) {
          return match[1].replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "").trim();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`Could not parse pillar ${keyword}:`, e);
      }
      return null;
    };

    const cyber = extractPillarText("Cybersecurity Integration");
    const drills = extractPillarText("Testing and Maintenance");
    const audit = extractPillarText("Audit and Review");
    const budget = extractPillarText("UACS and Budgeting");

    if (cyber) setSec6CyberIntegration(cyber);

  }, [activeCycle, apiUrl, token]);

    setLoadingTree(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/issp/document-tree`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) setNodes(await res.json());
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to load document skeleton:", e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingTree(false);
    }
  }, [apiUrl, token]);

  const loadAllData = useCallback(() => {
    if (!token || !activeCycle) return;
    fetchCycleData();
    fetchHumanCapitals();
    fetchStakeholders();
    fetchNetworkAndCyber();
    fetchEgovChecklists();
    fetchDrTeams();
    fetchDrBias();
    fetchDrMetrics();
    fetchDocumentTree();
  }, [token, activeCycle, fetchCycleData, fetchHumanCapitals, fetchStakeholders, fetchNetworkAndCyber, fetchEgovChecklists, fetchDrTeams, fetchDrBias, fetchDrMetrics, fetchDocumentTree]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllData();
  }, [loadAllData]);

  const handleSaveNarratives = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    const safeStart = parseInt(startYear, 10) || 2026;
    const safeEnd = parseInt(endYear, 10) || (safeStart + 2);
    const { scope_choice, scope_json } = resolveScopePayload();
    const compiledSec6 = buildSection6Html();

    const payload = {
      agency_name: agencyName.trim() || defaultAgencyName,
      agency_website_url: websiteUrl.trim() || null,
      is_amendment: Boolean(isAmendment),
      amendment_number: isAmendment ? (amendmentNumber.trim() || "1st") : null,
      scope_choice,
      scope_json,
      issp_period_from: safeStart,
      issp_period_to: safeEnd,

      mandate_html: legalBasis.trim(),
      functions: functions.trim(),
      vision_html: vision.trim(),
      mission_html: mission.trim(),
      present_situation_html: presentSituation.trim(),

      enterprise_architecture_narrative: eaNarrative.trim(),

      drbcp_approval_date: drbcpApprovalDate.trim() || null,
      drbcp_affected_assets_json: drAffectedAssets || [],
      drbcp_recovery_strategy_html: drRecoveryStrategy.trim(),
      drbcp_sop_phases_html: drSopPhases.trim(),
      drbcp_compliance_narrative_html: compiledSec6,

      cio_name: cioName.trim() || null,
      cio_plantilla_position: cioPosition.trim() || null,
      cio_organizational_unit: cioUnit.trim() || null,
      cio_email: cioEmail.trim() || null,
      cio_contact_no: cioContact.trim() || null,

      focal_name: focalName.trim() || null,
      focal_position: focalPosition.trim() || null,
      focal_organizational_unit: focalUnit.trim() || null,
      focal_email: focalEmail.trim() || null,
      focal_contact_no: focalContact.trim() || null,

      head_of_agency_name: headOfAgencyName.trim() || null,
      agency_head_position: agencyHeadPosition.trim() || defaultAgencyHeadTitle,
      signatory_prepared_by: cioName.trim() || "Chief Information Officer",
      signatory_approved_by: headOfAgencyName.trim() || defaultAgencyHeadTitle
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        let detail = errData.detail;
        if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
          detail = detail.map(d => `${d.loc ? d.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") + ": " : ""}${d.msg}`).join(" | ");
        } else if (typeof detail === "object" && detail !== null) {
          detail = JSON.stringify(detail);
        }
        throw new Error(detail || "Failed to persist primary coversheet parameters.");
      }

      setSuccess("Primary narrative, statutory mandates, Agency Head title, and DRBCP compliance sections saved successfully.");
      fetchCycleData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save parameters.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleActivateCycle = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const start = parseInt(startYear, 10);
    const end = parseInt(endYear, 10);

    if (isNaN(start) || isNaN(end) || start > end) {
      setError("Please specify valid planning years (Start Year <= End Year).");
      return;
    }

    const span = end - start + 1;
    if (span < 1 || span > 20) {
      setError(`ISSP planning horizons must span between 1 and 20 years (Current span: ${span} years).`);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const targetCycle = `${start}-${end}`;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(targetCycle)}/activate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        let detail = err.detail;
        if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
          detail = detail.map(d => `${d.loc ? d.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") + ": " : ""}${d.msg}`).join(" | ");
        } else if (typeof detail === "object" && detail !== null) {
          detail = JSON.stringify(detail);
        }
        throw new Error(detail || "Failed to activate cycle.");
      }

      setSuccess(`Planning cycle updated and activated to: FY ${targetCycle} (${span}-Year Horizon)`);
      await fetchActiveCycle();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetCycle = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm(`CRITICAL WARNING: Safe-reset cycle '${activeCycle}'? All drafts, child matrices, and ceilings for this period will be transactionally flushed.`)) {
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}/reset`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        let detail = err.detail;
        if (typeof detail === "object" && detail !== null) detail = JSON.stringify(detail);
        throw new Error(detail || "Cycle reset aborted.");
      }

      setSuccess("Active cycle successfully reset. Clean state established.");
      await fetchActiveCycle();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }

  const handleEvaluateRollover = async (force = false) => {

      setError(err.message || "Failed to execute lifecycle rollover evaluation.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddAffectedAsset = () => {

      ...prev,

  const handleDeleteAffectedAsset = (index) => {

  };

  const handleAddHumanCapital = async (e) => {

  // Add Cybersecurity Control with Tier Validation
  const handleAddCyberControl = async (e) => {

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const nameToSave = cyberForm.selected_standard === "__custom__" 
      ? cyberForm.control_name.trim() 
      : (cyberForm.selected_standard || cyberForm.control_name).trim();

    if (!nameToSave) {
      setError("Control Name cannot be empty.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        is_proposed: cyberForm.is_proposed,
        control_domain: cyberForm.control_domain,

      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls?issp_period=${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to record cybersecurity control.");
      setSuccess(`Control '${nameToSave}' saved under ${payload.is_mandatory ? "MANDATORY" : "OPTIONAL"} column.`);
      
      handleDomainOrTierChange(cyberForm.control_domain, cyberForm.control_tier);
      fetchNetworkAndCyber();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  };

  const handleToggleCyberImplemented = async (item) => {
    try {
      await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...item, is_implemented: !item.is_implemented })
      });
      fetchNetworkAndCyber();
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
  };

  const handleDeleteCyberControl = async (id) => {
    try {
      await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      fetchNetworkAndCyber();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); }
  };

  // Seed / Restore All 29 Official DICT Cybersecurity Controls Endpoint Trigger
  const handleSeedDefaultControls = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSeedingControls(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/cybersecurity-controls/seed-defaults?issp_period=${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}`, {

        body: JSON.stringify(egForm)

      fetchEgovChecklists();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  };

    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); }
  };

  const handleAddDrTeam = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}/dr-teams`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify(drTeamForm)
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to record DRT member.");
      setSuccess("DRT Member added.");
      setDrTeamForm({ role: "Incident Commander", responsibility: "", contact_person: "", contact_details: "" });
      fetchDrTeams();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  };

  const handleDeleteDrTeam = async (id) => {

  };

  const handleAddDrBia = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}/dr-bias`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...drBiaForm,
          mtpd_hours: parseInt(drBiaForm.mtpd_hours, 10),
          rto_hours: parseInt(drBiaForm.rto_hours, 10),
          rpo_hours: parseInt(drBiaForm.rpo_hours, 10)
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to record BIA targets.");
      setSuccess("BIA targets preserved.");
      setDrBiaForm({ system_name: "", classification: "Frontline / Mission-Critical", mtpd_hours: 24, rto_hours: 4, rpo_hours: 1 });
      fetchDrBias();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  };

      fetchDrBias();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const handleAddDrMetric = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/narratives/${encodeURIComponent(activeCycle)}/dr-metrics`, {
        method: "POST",

        body: JSON.stringify(drMetricsForm)
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to register DR KPI metric.");
      setSuccess("DR KPI metric added.");
