  const [role, setRole] = useState("ROLE_DEPT_USER");
  const [deptId, setDeptId] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  // Department Management States
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [newDeptName, setNewDeptName] = useState("");
  const [creatingDept, setCreatingDept] = useState(false);

  // Global Notification States
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Search Filter
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // EDIT MODAL STATES: USER
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null);
  const [editEmail, setEditEmail] = useState("");
  const [editPassword, setEditPassword] = useState("");
  const [showEditPassword, setShowEditPassword] = useState(false);
  const [editRole, setEditRole] = useState("ROLE_DEPT_USER");
  const [editDeptId, setEditDeptId] = useState("");

  // EDIT MODAL STATES: DEPARTMENT
  const [editingDept, setEditingDept] = useState(null);
  const [editDeptName, setEditDeptName] = useState("");

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";

  const parseErrorMessage = async (res, defaultContext) => {
    let detail = "";
    try {
      const errorData = await res.json();
      if (errorData?.detail) {
        if (typeof errorData.detail === "string") {
          detail = errorData.detail;
        } else if (Array.isArray(errorData.detail)) {
          detail = errorData.detail
            .map(err => `${err.loc ? err.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") + ": " : ""}${err.msg || JSON.stringify(err)}`)
            .join(" | ");
        } else {
          detail = JSON.stringify(errorData.detail);
        }
      } else if (errorData?.message) {
        detail = errorData.message;
      }
    } catch {
      detail = await res.text().catch(() => `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
    }
    return detail || `${defaultContext} (HTTP ${res.status})`;
  };

  const fetchDepartments = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setDepartments(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
        if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0 && !deptId) {
          setDeptId(String(data[0].department_id || data[0].id));
        }
      } else {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to load departments registry");
        setError(msg);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || "Failed to query the departments endpoint.");
    }
  };

  const fetchWhitelist = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setWhitelist(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } else {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to query user registry");
        setError(msg);
        setWhitelist([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || "Network error querying user registry.");
      setWhitelist([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchDepartments();
      fetchWhitelist();
    }
  }, [token]);

  // CREATE USER (Mandatory Password & Multi-Role Support)
  const handleAddUser = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    // Initial password is required for manual administrative onboarding
    if (!password || password.trim().length < 8) {
      setError("Initial account password is required and must be at least 8 characters long.");
      return;
    }

    if (role !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && !deptId) {
      setError("Department assignment is mandatory for Department Users and Supply Officers.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
          password: password.trim(),
          assigned_department_id: role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? null : parseInt(deptId, 10),
          role_tag: role
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to onboard user account");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`User account '${email}' successfully onboarded and authorized.`);
        setEmail("");
        setPassword("");
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to connect to user onboarding service.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // UPDATE USER
  const openEditUserModal = (u) => {
    setEditingUser(u);
    setEditEmail(u.email);
    setEditRole(u.role_tag);
    setEditDeptId(
      u.department_id 
        ? String(u.department_id) 
        : (departments[0]?.department_id ? String(departments[0].department_id) : "")
    );
    setEditPassword("");
    setShowEditPassword(false);
  };

  const handleUpdateUser = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (editRole !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && !editDeptId) {
      setError("Department assignment is mandatory for this role.");
      return;
    }

    if (editPassword.trim() && editPassword.trim().length < 8) {
      setError("New password must be at least 8 characters long.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const payload = {
      email: editEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),
      role_tag: editRole,
      assigned_department_id: editRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? null : parseInt(editDeptId, 10)
    };

    if (editPassword.trim()) {
      payload.password = editPassword.trim();
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist/${editingUser.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to update user profile");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Account profile for '${editEmail}' updated successfully.`);
        setEditingUser(null);
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to submit user updates.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // DELETE USER
  const handleDeleteUser = async (userId, userEmail) => {
    if (userEmail === user?.email) {
      setError("Administrative Guard: You are prohibited from deleting your active account session.");
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently remove account '${userEmail}' from the institutional registry?`)) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/users/whitelist/${userId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to delete user account");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Account '${userEmail}' successfully removed from registry.`);
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error deleting user.");
    }
  };

  // CREATE DEPARTMENT
  const handleCreateDepartment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newDeptName.trim()) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setCreatingDept(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: newDeptName.trim() })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to create department");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Department '${newDeptName.trim()}' added successfully to active registry.`);
        setNewDeptName("");
        await fetchDepartments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error creating department.");
    } finally {
      setCreatingDept(false);
    }
  };

  // UPDATE DEPARTMENT
  const openEditDeptModal = (dept) => {
    setEditingDept(dept);
    setEditDeptName(dept.department_name || dept.name || "");
  };

  const handleUpdateDepartment = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setCreatingDept(true);

    const targetId = editingDept.department_id || editingDept.id;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments/${targetId}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: editDeptName.trim() })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to update department details");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess("Department designation updated successfully.");
        setEditingDept(null);
        setEditDeptName("");
        fetchDepartments();
        fetchWhitelist();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error updating department.");
    } finally {
      setCreatingDept(false);
    }
  };

  // DELETE DEPARTMENT
  const handleDeleteDepartment = async (id, name) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete the department '${name}'? This may affect linked accounts and proposals.`)) return;

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/departments/${id}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const msg = await parseErrorMessage(res, "Failed to delete department");
        setError(msg);
      } else {
        setSuccess(`Department '${name}' removed successfully from active registry.`);
        await fetchDepartments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error deleting department.");
    }
  };

  // Filter accounts list based on search term
  const filteredWhitelist = whitelist.filter((u) => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchesEmail = (u.email || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const matchesRole = (u.role_tag || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const matchesDept = (u.department_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
    return matchesEmail || matchesRole || matchesDept;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none text-xs font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500" />
            <span>Institutional User Management & Manual Onboarding</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Manually register Department Planners, Supply Officers, and Administrators with direct credential access and department mappings.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchWhitelist}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer self-start"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Refresh</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/20 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column: Creator Form & Department Management */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* User Onboarding Form Box */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500" />
              <span>Manually Onboard User</span>
            </h3>
            
            <form onSubmit={handleAddUser} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                  Institutional Email Address
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="user@agency.gov.ph"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                  Initial Password (Mandatory)
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                    required
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Min. 8 characters"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                  System Role Scope
                </label>
                <select
                  value={role}
                  onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                >
                  <option value="ROLE_DEPT_USER">Department User (Proposals & Needs)</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_SUPPLY_USER">Supply Officer (Annex 1 Master Inventory)</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_MIS_ADMIN">MIS Admin (Full Governance & Compiler)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {role !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                    Assigned Department
                  </label>
                  {departments.length > 0 ? (
                    <select
                      value={deptId}
                      onChange={(e) => setDeptId(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                      required
                    >
                      {departments.map((dept) => (
                        <option key={dept.department_id || dept.id} value={String(dept.department_id || dept.id)}>
                          {dept.department_name || dept.name}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-slate-500 italic block text-[10px] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850">
                      Please register a department division below first.
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting || (role !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && departments.length === 0)}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
              >
                <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Onboarding..." : "Create & Authorize User"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Department Management Panel */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
              <span>Department Registry</span>
            </h3>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateDepartment} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={newDeptName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewDeptName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Planning & Management Service"
                className="flex-1 p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-xs"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={creatingDept}
                className="p-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{creatingDept ? "..." : "Add"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>

            <div className="max-h-44 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pt-1 pr-1">
              {departments.map((dept) => {
                const deptIdVal = dept.department_id || dept.id;
                const deptNameVal = dept.department_name || dept.name;
                return (
                  <div key={deptIdVal} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 text-xs">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{deptNameVal}</span>
                    <div className="flex gap-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => openEditDeptModal(dept)}
                        className="p-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        title="Edit Department Name"
                      >
                        <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteDepartment(deptIdVal, deptNameVal)}
                        className="p-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-red-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        title="Delete Department"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: User Accounts Table */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm h-fit">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                Active Institutional Accounts
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">
                {whitelist.length} Registered User Accounts
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-60">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search email, role, or unit..."
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs placeholder-slate-400"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto text-blue-500 mb-2" />
                <span>Loading accounts...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredWhitelist.length > 0 ? (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Email Address</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Role</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Assigned Unit</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850">
                  {filteredWhitelist.map((u) => (
                    <tr key={u.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-950/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">{u.email}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase font-mono border ${
                          u.role_tag === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN"
                            ? "bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400"
                            : u.role_tag === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER"
                            ? "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400"
                            : "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400"
                        }`}>
                          {u.role_tag === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? "Admin" : u.role_tag === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER" ? "Supply" : "Dept"}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {u.department_name || (u.role_tag === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" ? "Global Access" : "Unassigned")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => openEditUserModal(u)}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Edit Credentials"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteUser(u.id, u.email)}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-red-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            title="Delete Account"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
                {searchQuery ? "No accounts match your search filter." : "No institutional accounts registered yet. Use the onboarding form on the left to add users."}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* EDIT USER CREDENTIALS MODAL */}
      {editingUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">Edit User Credentials</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setEditingUser(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUpdateUser} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Email Address</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={editEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="user@agency.gov.ph"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Change Password (Leave blank to keep existing)
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type={showEditPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                    value={editPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Enter new password (min. 8 chars)"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowEditPassword(!showEditPassword)}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {showEditPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">System Role Scope</label>
                <select
                  value={editRole}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                >
                  <option value="ROLE_DEPT_USER">Department User (Proposals & Needs)</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_SUPPLY_USER">Supply Officer (Annex 1 Master Inventory)</option>
                  <option value="ROLE_MIS_ADMIN">MIS Admin (Full Governance & Compiler)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {editRole !== "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Assigned Department</label>
                  <select
                    value={editDeptId}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditDeptId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                    required
                  >
                    {departments.map((dept) => (
                      <option key={dept.department_id || dept.id} value={String(dept.department_id || dept.id)}>
                        {dept.department_name || dept.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{submitting ? "Saving..." : "Save Credentials"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* EDIT DEPARTMENT MODAL */}
      {editingDept && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl w-full max-w-sm p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">Edit Department Name</h3>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setEditingDept(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUpdateDepartment} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Department Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={editDeptName}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditDeptName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Planning & Management Service"
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-xs"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={creatingDept}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-sm text-xs"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{creatingDept ? "Updating..." : "Update Department"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/auth/Login.jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useCycle } from '../../context/CycleContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { login } from '../../api/auth';
import { 
  Shield, 
  ArrowRight, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Eye, 
  EyeOff, 
  Lock,
  Sun,
  Moon
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { loginSession } = useAuth();
  const { agencyName: ctxAgencyName, agencyLogoUrl } = useCycle();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  // Strict clean state: NO pre-filled credentials or demo accounts
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const appTitle = import.meta.env.VITE_APP_TITLE || "e-ISSP Compliance Engine";
  const defaultAgencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME || "National Government Agency";
  const agencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_AGENCY_NAME || ctxAgencyName || defaultAgencyName;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const data = await login(email.trim().toLowerCase(), password);
      loginSession(data.access_token, data.role, data.department_id);

      if (data.role === 'ROLE_MIS_ADMIN') {
        navigate('/admin/dashboard');
      } else if (data.role === 'ROLE_SUPPLY_USER') {
        navigate('/supply/inventory');
      } else if (data.role === 'ROLE_DEPT_USER') {
        navigate('/dept/dashboard');
      } else {
        setError('Unauthorized role allocation. Contact your MIS Administrator.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Authentication failed. Please verify your credentials.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0b1329] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 overflow-hidden px-4 select-none font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Light / Dark Mode Toggle Button */}
      <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 z-20">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-850 shadow-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-xs"
          title={theme === "dark" ? "Switch to Light Mode" : "Switch to Dark Mode"}
        >
          {theme === "dark" ? <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> : <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />}
          <span>{theme === "dark" ? "Light" : "Dark"}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div 
        className="absolute pointer-events-none" 
        style={{ 
          top: '-20%', 
          left: '-20%', 
          width: '140%', 
          height: '140%', 
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,99,235,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%)', 
          zIndex: 0 
        }} 
      />

      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-8 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 z-10 shadow-xl space-y-6">
        
        {/* Institutional Branding Header linked to Uploaded Seal */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 p-1.5 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs overflow-hidden shrink-0">
            {agencyLogoUrl ? (
              <img 
                src={agencyLogoUrl} 
                alt={agencyName} 
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                onError={(e) => { e.target.style.display = 'none'; }}
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white">
                <Shield className="w-7 h-7" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-serif text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold tracking-tight">{appTitle}</h1>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">{agencyName}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Security-Hardened Login Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10.5px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Institutional Email
            </label>
            <input 
              type="email" 
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-all font-mono placeholder:text-slate-400"
              placeholder="username@agency.gov.ph" 
              autoComplete="username"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10.5px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input 
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} 
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-all font-mono placeholder:text-slate-400"
                placeholder="••••••••••••" 
                autoComplete="current-password"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                title={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button 
            type="submit" 
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 mt-2"
          >
            <span>{loading ? 'Authenticating Credentials...' : 'Sign In to Workspace'}</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* Security Compliance Guarantee */}
        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2 text-center text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
            <span>DICT ISSP v.2026 CSPC © All rights reserved</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 leading-tight">
            Official Government System &bull; Unauthorized access prohibited
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Catalog/CatalogViewer.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { getDeptCatalog } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  BookOpen, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Search, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  AlertCircle,
  Tag
} from "lucide-react";

export default function CatalogViewer() {
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getDeptCatalog();
      setCatalog(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message || "Failed to load reference catalog details.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const filteredCatalog = catalog.filter(item => 
    (item.display_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    (item.item_key || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
    (item.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-5xl mx-auto select-none transition-colors duration-200 font-sans">
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2 font-serif">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Standard Pricing & Reference Catalog</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Browse pre-approved specifications. Planners selecting from this standard catalog bypass custom canvas review delays.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors shadow-xs font-bold shrink-0"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Catalog</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 items-center gap-2.5 max-w-md shadow-xs">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={searchTerm}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Filter catalog items by key, name, or category..."
          className="w-full bg-transparent outline-none border-none text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Catalog Table */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading && catalog.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
              <span>Fetching standard catalog entries...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filteredCatalog.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                  <th className="p-3.5">Reference Item</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Category Classification</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Maximum Approved Unit Cost</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5 text-right">Verification Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                {filteredCatalog.map((item) => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3.5">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">{item.display_name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5 select-all">{item.item_key}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 capitalize text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                        <Tag className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                        <span>{item.category ? item.category.replace(/_/g, " ") : "Uncategorized"}</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
                      ₱{parseFloat(item.standard_unit_cost || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-right">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Pre-Approved
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
              No catalog references match your search query.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Dashboard/DeptDashboard.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getBudgetSummary } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  LayoutDashboard, 
  TrendingUp, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Landmark, 
  FileText, 
  Clock, 
  ArrowRight, 
  FolderKanban, 
  ClipboardList 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DeptDashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const [headroom, setHeadroom] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState({ expiring_standard_items: [], expiring_custom_proposals: [] });
  const [loadingAlerts, setLoadingAlerts] = useState(false);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getBudgetSummary(user?.token);
      setHeadroom(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to retrieve budget summary balances.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchExpirationAlerts = async () => {
    setLoadingAlerts(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/dept/catalog/expiring-alerts`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${user?.token}` }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setAlerts(await res.json());
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to load catalog canvas alerts:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingAlerts(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchData();
      fetchExpirationAlerts();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const subCeiling = headroom?.sub_ceiling || 0;
  const totalSpent = headroom?.total_spent || 0;
  const allocatedCapex = headroom?.allocated_capex || 0;
  const spentCapex = headroom?.current_spent_capex || 0;
  const allocatedMooe = headroom?.allocated_mooe || 0;
  const spentMooe = headroom?.current_spent_mooe || 0;

  const overallSpentPercent = subCeiling > 0 ? (totalSpent / subCeiling) * 100 : 0;
  const capexPercent = allocatedCapex > 0 ? (spentCapex / allocatedCapex) * 100 : 0;
  const mooePercent = allocatedMooe > 0 ? (spentMooe / allocatedMooe) * 100 : 0;

  const totalActiveAlerts = (alerts.expiring_standard_items?.length || 0) + (alerts.expiring_custom_proposals?.length || 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none font-sans">
      
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <LayoutDashboard className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>Departmental Budget Headroom &amp; Progress Monitor</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Tracking active CapEx (Hardware) and MOOE (Software) expenditure balances against your allocated sub-ceiling for <strong>FY {activeCycle}</strong>.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => { fetchData(); fetchExpirationAlerts(); }}
          disabled={loading || loadingAlerts}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${(loading || loadingAlerts) ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Balances</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Expiration Alert Notice */}
      {totalActiveAlerts > 0 && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-955/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60 rounded-2xl space-y-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
            <span>Validity Alert: {totalActiveAlerts} Quotation Canvases Expiring Soon</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
            Market quotations expire after their set validity window. Update them in your proposals before submitting to the review queue.
          </p>
          <button 
            onClick={() => navigate("/dept/quotations")}
            className="text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer pt-1"
          >
            <span>Review &amp; Attach Updated Quotations</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Progress Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
        
        {/* Total Sub-Ceiling */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />
              <span>Total Sub-Ceiling</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono">{overallSpentPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            ₱{totalSpent.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">/ ₱{subCeiling.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div 
              className="bg-purple-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(overallSpentPercent, 100)}%` }} 
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">
            Remaining: ₱{Math.max(0, subCeiling - totalSpent).toLocaleString()}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* CapEx Limit */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Capital Outlay (CapEx)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono">{capexPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            ₱{spentCapex.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">/ ₱{allocatedCapex.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div 
              className="bg-blue-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(capexPercent, 100)}%` }} 
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">
            Remaining: ₱{Math.max(0, allocatedCapex - spentCapex).toLocaleString()}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* MOOE Limit */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
              <span>Operating Services (MOOE)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono">{mooePercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            ₱{spentMooe.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">/ ₱{allocatedMooe.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div 
              className="bg-emerald-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
              style={{ width: `${Math.min(mooePercent, 100)}%` }} 
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block">
            Remaining: ₱{Math.max(0, allocatedMooe - spentMooe).toLocaleString()}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Navigation Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
        <div 
          onClick={() => navigate("/dept/proposals")}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-400 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl">
              <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Draft &amp; Manage Resource Proposals</h4>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] mt-0.5">Submit hardware outlays and software subscriptions for MIS review</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
        </div>

        <div 
          onClick={() => navigate("/dept/needs")}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-teal-400 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-3 bg-teal-50 dark:bg-teal-950 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 rounded-xl">
              <ClipboardList className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Log Needs Assessment (Sec 8.0)</h4>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] mt-0.5">Document operational bottlenecks for MIS Admin aggregation</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
