// frontend/src/views/department/Inventory/InventoryManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  getInventory, 
  getProposals, 
  uploadUnserviceableReport 
} from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  Database, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Calendar, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  UploadCloud, 
  HardDrive, 
  Coins, 
  FileText, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Info, 
  Search, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  ArrowUpRight, 
  Tag, 
  X 
} from "lucide-react";

// Official DICT Annex 1 Standard Categories
const DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES = [
  "Servers",
  "Desktop",
  "Laptop",
  "Mobile Phone",
  "Tablet",
  "Printer",
  "Network Switch",
  "Others (ICT Equipment)"
];

const DICT_SOFTWARE_CATEGORIES = [
  "Office Productivity Tool",
  "Grammar checker",
  "Graphics and Simulation Software",
  "Antivirus",
  "IT Help Desk Tool",
  "Photo and Video Editing Software",
  "Web Application Firewall",
  "Others (ICT Software)"
];

const resolveCategoryString = (category) => {
  if (!category) return "";
  if (typeof category === "object" && category !== null && category.value) {
    return String(category.value);
  }
  return String(category);
};

export default function InventoryManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  // Data States
  const [inventory, setInventory] = useState([]);
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Search & Filter States
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("all");
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState("All");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // IIRUP Upload Modal State
  const [activeReportAsset, setActiveReportAsset] = useState(null);
  const [reportFile, setReportFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadingReport, setUploadingReport] = useState(false);

  const formatPHP = (val) => {
    const num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return "₱" + num.toLocaleString("en-PH", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  const isObsolete = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return false;
    const acqDate = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(acqDate.getTime())) return false;
    const threeYearsAgo = new Date();
    threeYearsAgo.setFullYear(threeYearsAgo.getFullYear() - 3);
    return acqDate < threeYearsAgo;
  };

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [invData, propData] = await Promise.all([
        getInventory(),
        getProposals(activeCycle).catch(() => [])
      ]);
      setInventory(Array.isArray(invData) ? invData : []);
      setProposals(Array.isArray(propData) ? propData : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load departmental baseline inventory.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      loadData();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleUploadIirupReport = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reportFile || !activeReportAsset) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setUploadingReport(true);

    try {
      await uploadUnserviceableReport(activeReportAsset.id, reportFile);
      setSuccess(`COA Inspection Report (IIRUP) linked to '${activeReportAsset.item_name}'.`);
      setActiveReportAsset(null);
      setReportFile(null);
      loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to upload inspection report.");
    } finally {
      setUploadingReport(false);
    }
  };

  const isItemEolOrDepreciated = (item) => {
    return !item.is_software && (item.is_end_of_life || item.status === "Condemned" || isObsolete(item.date_acquired));
  };

  const eolByCategory = useMemo(() => {
    return DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.reduce((acc, cat) => {
      const isOthers = cat.startsWith("Others");
      const count = inventory
        .filter(i => {
          if (!isItemEolOrDepreciated(i)) return false;
          const dictCat = resolveCategoryString(i.dict_category);
          if (dictCat) {
            return isOthers ? dictCat.startsWith("Others") : dictCat === cat;
          }
          return isOthers
            ? !DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.slice(0, -1).some(c => (i.item_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(c.toLowerCase()))
            : (i.item_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(cat.toLowerCase());
        })
        .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity || 1), 0);
      acc[cat] = count;
      return acc;
    }, {});
  }, [inventory]);

  const isFilteredToEquipmentCategory = categoryFilter !== "All" && DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.includes(categoryFilter);

  const eolHardwareUnits = isFilteredToEquipmentCategory
    ? (eolByCategory[categoryFilter] || 0)
    : inventory.filter(isItemEolOrDepreciated).reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity || 1), 0);

  const replacementRequestedUnits = proposals
    .filter(p => {
      if (p.strategic_category !== "Office Productivity" || p.is_expansion) return false;
      if (isFilteredToEquipmentCategory) {
        const catLower = categoryFilter.toLowerCase().replace("others (ict equipment)", "others");
        const nameLower = (p.item_name || "").toLowerCase();
        return nameLower.includes(catLower);
      }
      return true;
    })
    .reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.total_qty || p.year_1_qty || 0), 0);

  const isObsolescenceJustified = eolHardwareUnits >= replacementRequestedUnits;

  const totalUnits = inventory.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity || 1), 0);
  const totalHardwareVal = inventory.reduce((sum, i) => sum + ((parseFloat(i.acquired_price) || 0) * (i.quantity || 1)), 0);
  const operationalUnits = inventory.filter(i => !i.is_end_of_life && i.status === "Functional").reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.quantity || 1), 0);

  const filteredInventory = useMemo(() => {
    return inventory.filter(item => {
      if (filterType === "hardware" && item.is_software) return false;
      if (filterType === "software" && !item.is_software) return false;
      if (filterType === "eol" && !item.is_end_of_life && item.status !== "Condemned") return false;
      if (filterType === "backup" && !item.is_backup) return false;
      if (filterType === "obsolete" && !isObsolete(item.date_acquired)) return false;
      if (filterType === "condemned" && item.status !== "Condemned") return false;

      if (categoryFilter !== "All") {
        const isOthers = categoryFilter.startsWith("Others");
        const dictCat = resolveCategoryString(item.dict_category);
        if (dictCat) {
          const match = isOthers ? dictCat.startsWith("Others") : dictCat === categoryFilter;
          if (!match) return false;
        } else {
          const catClean = categoryFilter.toLowerCase();
          const nameClean = (item.item_name || "").toLowerCase();
          if (isOthers) {
            const matchedAnyStd = [...DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.slice(0, -1), ...DICT_SOFTWARE_CATEGORIES.slice(0, -1)]
              .some(c => nameClean.includes(c.toLowerCase()));
            if (matchedAnyStd) return false;
          } else if (!nameClean.includes(catClean)) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      }

      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
        const matchesName = (item.item_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesModel = (item.exact_model || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesSpecs = (item.specs || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesCategory = resolveCategoryString(item.dict_category).toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesOther = (item.other_category_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchesName && !matchesModel && !matchesSpecs && !matchesCategory && !matchesOther) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [inventory, filterType, categoryFilter, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto font-sans select-none">
      
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-xs">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 className="text-base font-serif font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Department ICT Asset Inventory &amp; Obsolescence Audit (Annex 1)</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20 font-mono">
              {user?.department_name || "Department Registry"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Audit localized equipment conditions by DICT Annex 1 Standard Categories, attach COA Unserviceable Property Inspection Reports (IIRUP), and verify hardware replacement quotas for Part IV.A.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={loadData}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 font-bold shadow-xs text-xs"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Inventory</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* DBM Obsolescence Counter Banner (Clean Contrast - NO BLINDING WHITE GLARE) */}
      <div className={`p-6 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col gap-4 transition-all shadow-xs ${
        isObsolescenceJustified 
          ? "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300" 
          : "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300"
      }`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3.5">
            {isObsolescenceJustified ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            ) : (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5 animate-pulse" />
            )}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {isObsolescenceJustified 
                    ? "Part IV.A Replacement Quota Fully Justified by Annex 1" 
                    : "DBM Hardware Obsolescence Discrepancy Warning"}
                </h4>
                {isFilteredToEquipmentCategory && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono font-bold uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Category: {categoryFilter}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-[11px] leading-relaxed max-w-3xl">
                {isObsolescenceJustified 
                  ? `Your department has recorded ${eolHardwareUnits} End-of-Life (EOL), condemned, or depreciated (>3 yrs) units ${isFilteredToEquipmentCategory ? `for [${categoryFilter}]` : "across all equipment"} in Annex 1. This fully justifies the ${replacementRequestedUnits} replacement units requested in Part IV.A.`
                  : `Your department has requested ${replacementRequestedUnits} replacement units in Part IV.A ${isFilteredToEquipmentCategory ? `under [${categoryFilter}]` : ""}, but Annex 1 records only ${eolHardwareUnits} EOL or condemned assets. Under DBM standards, uncataloged additions must be marked as "Expansion Projects" in your proposals.`}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 shrink-0 font-mono text-right bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 block">Annex 1 EOL Units</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">{eolHardwareUnits}</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-lg">/</span>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 block">Part IV.A Requests</span>
              <span className={`font-bold text-base ${isObsolescenceJustified ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"}`}>
                {replacementRequestedUnits}
              </span>
            </div>
            <Link
              to="/dept/proposals"
              className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors"
              title="Review Part IV.A Proposals"
            >
              <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* DICT Equipment EOL Category Breakdown Tags (Balanced Contrast) */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono">
          <span className="text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold text-[9px] mr-1 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Tag className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>EOL by DICT Category:</span>
          </span>
          {DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
            const count = eolByCategory[cat] || 0;
            const isSelected = categoryFilter === cat;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(isSelected ? "All" : cat)}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border text-[9.5px] transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 font-bold"
                    : count > 0
                    ? "bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-400"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                {cat.replace(" (ICT Equipment)", "")}: <strong>{count}</strong>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Aggregate KPI Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl">
            <HardDrive className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Total Department Assets</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{totalUnits.toLocaleString()} units</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl">
            <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Operational In-Service</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{operationalUnits.toLocaleString()} units</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-xl">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Depreciated (&gt;3 Yrs Old)</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
              {inventory.filter(i => isObsolete(i.date_acquired)).reduce((s, i) => s + (i.quantity || 1), 0)} units
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl">
            <Coins className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Historical Acquisition Cost</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{formatPHP(totalHardwareVal)}</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Department Inventory Directory */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-xs">
        
        {/* Governance Information Callout Banner (Clean Inset - NO BLINDING WHITE BOX) */}
        <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <span>
            <strong>Institutional Custody Standard (Rule 9):</strong> Master ICT asset records are officially logged and categorized by the <strong>Supply and Property Management Office</strong> according to DICT Annex 1 Standard Categories. Departments inspect assigned inventory here to attach COA unserviceable inspection reports (IIRUP) and audit hardware replacement justifications.
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Toolbar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
            {[
              { id: "all", label: "All Items" },
              { id: "hardware", label: "Hardware" },
              { id: "software", label: "Software" },
              { id: "eol", label: "EOL Assets" },
              { id: "obsolete", label: ">3 Yrs Old" },
              { id: "condemned", label: "Condemned" },
              { id: "backup", label: "Backups" }
            ].map(tab => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setFilterType(tab.id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold text-[10px] cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  filterType === tab.id 
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs" 
                    : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                }`}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Tag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={categoryFilter}
                onChange={e => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer outline-none text-xs max-w-[190px]"
              >
                <option value="All">All DICT Categories</option>
                <optgroup label="1. ICT Equipment Inventory">
                  {DICT_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORIES.map(cat => (
                    <option key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
                <optgroup label="2. ICT Software Inventory">
                  {DICT_SOFTWARE_CATEGORIES.map(scat => (
                    <option key={scat} value={scat}>{scat}</option>
                  ))}
                </optgroup>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-56">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search asset, model, specs..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchTerm("")}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Table View */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-600" />
              <span>Querying department baseline inventory...</span>
            </div>
          ) : filteredInventory.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-[11px]">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[9px] tracking-wider font-mono">
                  <th className="p-3.5 w-56">Asset Description &amp; DICT Category</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Deployment Site</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Condition &amp; Classification</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5">Acquisition Details</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5 text-right">Count</th>
                  <th className="p-3.5 text-center">IIRUP Inspection Report</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850">
                {filteredInventory.map(item => {
                  const obsolete = isObsolete(item.date_acquired);
                  const isCondemned = item.status === "Condemned";

                  return (
                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="p-3.5">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{item.item_name}</div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                          <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                            {resolveCategoryString(item.dict_category) || (item.is_software ? "Software" : "Hardware")}
                          </span>
                          {item.other_category_name && (
                            <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 font-mono italic">
                              ({item.other_category_name})
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {item.exact_model && (
                            <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              {item.exact_model}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {item.specs && (
                          <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic truncate max-w-xs mt-0.5" title={item.specs}>
                            {item.specs}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3.5">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 block">
                          {item.is_central_office ? "Central Office" : "Regional / Field Campus"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          {item.office_location || "Central Office"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3.5 space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 items-center font-mono">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase border ${
                            item.status === "Functional" 
                              ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20" 
                              : "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20"
                          }`}>
                            {item.is_software ? (item.is_perpetual ? "Perpetual" : "Subscription") : item.status}
                          </span>

                          {item.is_end_of_life && (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20 text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase">
                              EOL
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {item.is_backup && (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500/20 text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase">
                              Backup
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {obsolete && (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20 text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase">
                              &gt;3 Yrs Old
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                        <div>{formatPHP(item.acquired_price)} / unit</div>
                        <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                          <span>{item.date_acquired ? new Date(item.date_acquired).toLocaleDateString() : "N/A"}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs">
                        {item.quantity} units
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-3.5 text-center">
                        {item.unserviceable_report_url ? (
                          <a
                            href={item.unserviceable_report_url}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer"
                            className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-[10px]"
                          >
                            <FileText className="w-3 h-3" />
                            <span>View IIRUP</span>
                            <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          </a>
                        ) : (
                          (isCondemned || item.is_end_of_life || item.status === "Needs Repair") ? (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setActiveReportAsset(item)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:hover:bg-rose-900 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                            >
                              Upload IIRUP
                            </button>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono">-</span>
                          )
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-400 italic">
              No departmental inventory assets match your active filter criteria.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* MODAL: UPLOAD COA IIRUP REPORT */}
      {activeReportAsset && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-sm p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">Upload Unserviceable Report</h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">Asset: {activeReportAsset.item_name}</span>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => { setActiveReportAsset(null); setReportFile(null); }}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleUploadIirupReport} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">
                  COA Inspection &amp; Inventory Appraisal Report (IIRUP PDF)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="file"
                  required
                  accept="application/pdf"
                  onChange={e => setReportFile(e.target.files[0])}
                  className="w-full text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs file:mr-3 file:py-1 file:px-2 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white file:cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[10px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-normal">
                Attaching an approved IIRUP justifies replacement funding under DBM guidelines for Part IV.A.
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={uploadingReport}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
              >
                <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{uploadingReport ? "Uploading..." : "Link IIRUP Report to Asset"}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Needs/NeedsAssessment.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  getNeedsAssessments, 
  createNeedsAssessment, 
  updateNeedsAssessment,
  deleteNeedsAssessment,
  getOutcomes 
} from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  ClipboardCheck, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Plus, 
  Search, 
  CheckSquare, 
  Clock, 
  Layers, 
  X, 
  Info, 
  GraduationCap, 
  Building,
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  Save,
  RotateCcw
} from "lucide-react";

export default function NeedsAssessment() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();

  // Data States
  const [needs, setNeeds] = useState([]);
  const [outcomes, setOutcomes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form Fields & Edit Mode State
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [mfo, setMfo] = useState("");
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState("");
  const [solution, setProposedSolution] = useState("");
  const [expectedImpacts, setExpectedImpacts] = useState("");
  const [otherImpact, setOtherImpact] = useState("");

  // Search & Filter State
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");

  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchOutcomesList = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getOutcomes();
      const outcomeList = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      setOutcomes(outcomeList);
      if (outcomeList.length > 0 && !mfo) {
        setMfo(outcomeList[0].outcome_name || outcomeList[0].program_name || "");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not dynamically load program outcomes:", e);
    }
  }, [mfo]);

  const fetchNeeds = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    getNeedsAssessments()
      .then((data) => {
        setNeeds(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        setError(err.message || "Failed to load department needs assessments.");
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchOutcomesList();
    fetchNeeds();
  }, [fetchOutcomesList, fetchNeeds, activeCycle]);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setTitle("");
    setProblem("");
    setProposedSolution("");
    setExpectedImpacts("");
    setOtherImpact("");
    if (outcomes.length > 0) {
      setMfo(outcomes[0].outcome_name || outcomes[0].program_name || "");
    }
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (item) => {
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setEditingId(item.id);
    setTitle(item.title || "");
    setMfo(item.mfo_alignment || (outcomes[0]?.outcome_name || ""));
    setProblem(item.current_problem || "");
    setProposedSolution(item.proposed_solution || "");
    setExpectedImpacts(Array.isArray(item.expected_impacts) ? item.expected_impacts.join(", ") : "");
    setOtherImpact(item.other_impact || "");
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    resetForm();
    setError(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id, assessmentTitle) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently delete Needs Assessment '${assessmentTitle}'?`)) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteNeedsAssessment(id);
      setSuccess(`Needs Assessment '${assessmentTitle}' removed successfully.`);
      if (editingId === id) resetForm();
      fetchNeeds();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete assessment.");
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (!title.trim()) {
      setError("Please provide an assessment title.");
      return;
    }
    if (!mfo.trim()) {
      setError("Please specify or select the statutory program alignment (OO / SO / MFO).");
      return;
    }
    if (!problem.trim()) {
      setError("Please describe the current operational bottleneck or problem.");
      return;
    }
    if (!solution.trim()) {
      setError("Please describe the proposed solution or technical intervention.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const parsedImpacts = expectedImpacts
        ? expectedImpacts.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        : [];

      const payload = {
        title: title.trim(),
        mfo_alignment: mfo.trim(),
        current_problem: problem.trim(),
        proposed_solution: solution.trim(),
        expected_impacts: parsedImpacts,
        other_impact: otherImpact.trim() || null
      };

      if (editingId) {
        await updateNeedsAssessment(editingId, payload);
        setSuccess("Needs Assessment updated successfully.");
      } else {
        await createNeedsAssessment(payload);
        setSuccess("Needs Assessment submitted successfully to the institutional planning intake pool.");
      }

      resetForm();
      fetchNeeds();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(typeof err === "object" ? (err.message || JSON.stringify(err)) : String(err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const totalCount = needs.length;
  const aggregatedCount = needs.filter(n => n.is_aggregated).length;
  const pendingCount = totalCount - aggregatedCount;

  const filteredNeeds = useMemo(() => {
    return needs.filter((item) => {
      if (statusFilter === "aggregated" && !item.is_aggregated) return false;
      if (statusFilter === "pending" && item.is_aggregated) return false;

      if (!searchTerm.trim()) return true;
      const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
      const matchesTitle = (item.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesMfo = (item.mfo_alignment || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesProblem = (item.current_problem || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesSolution = (item.proposed_solution || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchesTitle || matchesMfo || matchesProblem || matchesSolution;
    });
  }, [needs, statusFilter, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 className="text-base font-serif font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <ClipboardCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Section 8.0: Department Needs Assessment &amp; Problem Intake Pool</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 font-mono">
              FY {activeCycle || "2026-2028"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Document operational bottlenecks, technology gaps, and proposed solutions for {user?.department_name || "your department"}. Submitted assessments form the intake pool for MIS Admin aggregation into Part II.A Strategic Concerns.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => { fetchOutcomesList(); fetchNeeds(); }}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 font-bold self-start shadow-xs"
          title="Refresh assessments list"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync List</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Metric Summary Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Total Needs Documented</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{totalCount} Assessments</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <CheckSquare className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Aggregated into Part II.A</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{aggregatedCount} Concerns</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-955/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-lg shrink-0">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Under Governance Review</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{pendingCount} Pending</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setError(null)} className="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold rounded-lg flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setSuccess(null)} className="text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-800 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Workspace Layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Left Column: Assessment Submission / Update Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 h-fit shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {editingId ? (
                <>
                  <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                  <span>Update Needs Assessment</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Log Technical Needs Assessment</span>
                </>
              )}
            </h3>
            {editingId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {editingId && (
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-955/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
              <span>Editing Assessment ID: {String(editingId).slice(0, 8)}...</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={handleCancelEdit} className="font-bold underline text-[10px] cursor-pointer">
                Discard
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
              Assessment Title / Initiative Name
            </label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              value={title} 
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-semibold text-xs" 
              placeholder="e.g. Core Network Infrastructure Upgrade for Administrative Facilities"
              required 
            />
          </div>

          {/* Dynamic Program Alignment Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Program Alignment (Part I.A.4)</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono">MFO / OO</span>
            </label>
            {outcomes.length > 0 ? (
              <select 
                value={mfo} 
                onChange={(e) => setMfo(e.target.value)} 
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer focus:border-blue-500 text-xs font-medium"
              >
                {outcomes.map((o) => (
                  <option key={o.id} value={o.outcome_name || o.program_name}>
                    {o.outcome_name || o.program_name} ({o.type_label || "Outcome"})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : (
              <input 
                type="text" 
                value={mfo} 
                onChange={(e) => setMfo(e.target.value)} 
                placeholder="e.g. Citizen Frontline Public Services Program"
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                required 
              />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
              Current Problem / Operational Bottleneck
            </label>
            <textarea 
              value={problem} 
              onChange={(e) => setProblem(e.target.value)} 
              rows={3} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 leading-relaxed resize-none text-xs" 
              placeholder="Detail paper backlogs, processing latency, network bottlenecks, or single-point server vulnerabilities..."
              required 
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
              Proposed ICT Solution / Intervention
            </label>
            <textarea 
              value={solution} 
              onChange={(e) => setProposedSolution(e.target.value)} 
              rows={3} 
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 leading-relaxed resize-none text-xs" 
              placeholder="Describe the hardware deployment, cloud containerization, or digital automation upgrade required..."
              required 
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
              Expected Strategic Impacts (Comma-Separated)
            </label>
            <input 
              type="text"
              value={expectedImpacts}
              onChange={(e) => setExpectedImpacts(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Sub-15 min turnaround, 99.9% uptime, Automated verification"
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
              Other Regulatory / Accreditation Impact (Optional)
            </label>
            <input 
              type="text"
              value={otherImpact}
              onChange={(e) => setOtherImpact(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. ISO 27001 readiness, Data Privacy Act compliance"
              className="w-full p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Clean Info Box */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-[10.5px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>
              <strong>Provenance Flow:</strong> Once submitted, the MIS Admin can aggregate this need into Part II.A Strategic Concerns, and your department can link it directly to your Part IV.A proposals.
            </span>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {editingId && (
              <button
                type="button"

            >
              {editingId ? <Save className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ClipboardCheck className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span>{submitting ? "Saving..." : editingId ? "Save Assessment Changes" : "Submit Needs Assessment to Queue"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Right Column: Recent Assessments Log & Directory */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col space-y-0">
          
          {/* Controls Bar */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 p-0.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850">
                {[
                  { id: "all", label: `All (${totalCount})` },
                  { id: "pending", label: `In Review (${pendingCount})` },
                  { id: "aggregated", label: `Aggregated (${aggregatedCount})` }
                ].map(tab => (
                  <button
                    key={tab.id}
                    onClick={() => setStatusFilter(tab.id)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1 text-[10.5px] font-bold rounded-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      statusFilter === tab.id 
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs" 
                        : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {tab.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-2 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Filter by title, program, problem..."
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-8 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchTerm("")}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 overflow-y-auto max-h-[640px] flex-grow">
            {loading && needs.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-16 text-center text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
                <span>Loading department needs assessments...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredNeeds.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-16 text-center text-slate-400 italic">
                No needs assessments found matching your filter criteria.
              </div>
            ) : (
              filteredNeeds.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-5 space-y-3 hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-all">
                  
                  {/* Header Row with Actions */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20 font-mono">
                          {item.mfo_alignment}
                        </span>

                        {item.is_aggregated ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20 font-bold uppercase font-mono">
                            <CheckSquare className="w-3 h-3" /> Aggregated into Part II.A
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20 font-bold uppercase font-mono">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> Under MIS Review
                          </span>
                        )}

                        <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:border-slate-700 font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Building className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                          <span>{item.department_name || user?.department_name || `Dept ${item.department_id}`}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm mt-1">{item.title}</h4>
                    </div>

                    {/* Edit and Delete Action Buttons */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleStartEdit(item)}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold"
                        title="Edit Needs Assessment"
                      >
                        <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Edit</span>
                      </button>

                      {!item.is_aggregated ? (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id, item.title)}
                          className="p-1.5 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:hover:bg-rose-900 rounded-lg text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title="Delete Needs Assessment"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <span 
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed text-[10px] font-mono"
                          title="Cannot delete: Assessment has been aggregated into Part II.A Strategic Concerns by MIS Admin"
                        >
                          Locked
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Problem & Proposed Solution Side-by-Side */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                    <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider block">
                        Problem / Operational Bottleneck
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{item.current_problem}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 tracking-wider block">
                        Proposed Solution / Intervention
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{item.proposed_solution}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Expected Strategic Impacts */}
                  {((item.expected_impacts && item.expected_impacts.length > 0) || item.other_impact) && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[9px] font-mono">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase mr-1">Expected Impacts:</span>
                      {item.expected_impacts && item.expected_impacts.map((imp, idx) => (
                        <span key={idx} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                          {imp}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                      {item.other_impact && (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/20 font-bold">
                          {item.other_impact}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Profile/ProfileSettings.jsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { 
  Key, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Shield, 
  User, 
  Eye, 
  EyeOff 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ProfileSettings() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [currentPassword, setCurrentPassword] = useState("");
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");

  const [showCurrentPassword, setShowCurrentPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showNewPassword, setShowNewPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const rawUrl = import.meta.env?.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env?.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:8000";
  const apiUrl = rawUrl.endsWith("/") ? rawUrl.slice(0, -1) : rawUrl;
  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") : "");

  const handleUpdatePassword = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Validation Error: New password and confirmation do not match.");
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 8) {
      setError("Validation Error: New password must be at least 8 characters long.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/auth/change-password`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          current_password: currentPassword,
          new_password: newPassword
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.detail || "Password rotation rejected by the authorization system.");
      }

      setSuccess("Account password rotated successfully.");
      setCurrentPassword("");
      setNewPassword("");
      setConfirmPassword("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "An error occurred during password modification.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-lg mx-auto text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none transition-colors duration-200 font-sans">
      {/* Account Info Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
        <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
          <User className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <span>User Profile Information</span>
        </h3>
        
        <div className="space-y-3 font-mono">
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-850/60 pb-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Authorized Email:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">{user?.email || "Unknown User"}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-850/60 pb-2">
            <span className="text-slate-500">System Role Scope:</span>
            <span className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
              {user?.role === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" 
                ? "MIS Administrator" 
                : user?.role === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER" 
                ? "Supply Officer" 
                : "Department Planner"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between">
            <span className="text-slate-500">Department Assignment:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">
              {user?.department_name 
                ? `${user.department_name} (ID: ${user.department_id})` 
                : user?.department_id 
                ? `ID Code: ${user.department_id}` 
                : "Global Administration / Unassociated"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Security Credentials Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
        <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 pb-2">
          <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          <span>Rotate Account Password</span>
        </h3>

        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {success && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleUpdatePassword} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Current Password</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type={showCurrentPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                required
                value={currentPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowCurrentPassword(!showCurrentPassword)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                title={showCurrentPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showCurrentPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">New Password</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type={showNewPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                required
                value={newPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Minimum 8 characters"
                className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500 placeholder:text-slate-400"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowNewPassword(!showNewPassword)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                title={showNewPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showNewPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Confirm New Password</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                type={showConfirmPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                required
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 pr-10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono tracking-widest outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                title={showConfirmPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full p-2.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-lg font-bold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Processing password rotation...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Save New Credentials</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: .\frontend\src\views\department\Proposals\ActionInbox.jsx
