// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/ActionInbox.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { useNotifications } from "../../../context/NotificationContext";
import { getNotifications, resolveComment } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  Inbox, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Calendar, 
  Coins, 
  MessageSquare, 
  Key, 
  ShieldAlert, 
  CheckSquare, 
  History, 
  Search, 
  Filter, 
  Eye, 
  User, 
  X, 
  Clock, 
  ExternalLink 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ActionInbox() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const { fetchNotifications } = useNotifications();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const [notificationsList, setNotificationsList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // Filtering States
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("All");
  const [dateSpan, setDateSpan] = useState("All");
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");

  // Inspection Drawer State
  const [selectedNotification, setSelectedNotification] = useState(null);

  const fetchActionItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getNotifications();
      setNotificationsList(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      
      if (fetchNotifications) {
        fetchNotifications();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load department workspace updates.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchActionItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  const handleResolveAction = async (e, parentId, commentId) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!parentId || !commentId) return;
    try {
      await resolveComment(parentId, commentId);
      setSelectedNotification(null);
      await fetchActionItems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to resolve action item.");
    }
  };

  const handleDeepLinkRedirect = (item) => {
    if (!item.url_path || !item.ref_id) return;
    setSelectedNotification(null);
    navigate(item.url_path, { 
      state: { 
        highlightId: item.ref_id 
      } 
    });
  };

  // Maps notification types to clean, high-contrast badges (NO MUDDY TRANSLUCENT BOXES)
  const renderBadge = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "budget":
        return {
          icon: <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
          style: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20",
          label: "Budget Update"
        };
      case "comment":
        return {
          icon: <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
          style: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20",
          label: "Action Item"
        };
      case "security":
        return {
          icon: <Key className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
          style: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20",
          label: "Security Audit"
        };
      case "override":
        return {
          icon: <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
          style: "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:text-purple-400 dark:border-purple-500/20",
          label: "Admin Override"
        };
      case "status_change":
      default:
        return {
          icon: <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
          style: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500/20",
          label: "Status Transition"
        };
    }
  };

  // Filtered notifications pipeline
  const filteredNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    return notificationsList.filter(item => {
      const query = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch = query === "" || 
        item.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        item.description.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        (item.target_name && item.target_name.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (item.operator_email && item.operator_email.toLowerCase().includes(query));

      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === "All" || item.type === selectedCategory;

      let matchesDate = true;
      if (dateSpan !== "All") {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.timestamp);
        const boundaryDate = new Date();
        
        if (dateSpan === "Today") {
          boundaryDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          matchesDate = itemDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Week") {
          boundaryDate.setDate(boundaryDate.getDate() - 7);
          matchesDate = itemDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Month") {
          boundaryDate.setMonth(boundaryDate.getMonth() - 1);
          matchesDate = itemDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Custom") {
          const start = startDate ? new Date(startDate) : null;
          const end = endDate ? new Date(endDate) : null;
          if (start) {
            start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            matchesDate = matchesDate && itemDate >= start;
          }
          if (end) {
            end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            matchesDate = matchesDate && itemDate <= end;
          }
        }
      }

      return matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesDate;
    });
  }, [notificationsList, searchTerm, selectedCategory, dateSpan, startDate, endDate]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-4xl mx-auto select-none transition-colors duration-200 font-sans">
      
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Inbox className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>Workspace Notifications &amp; Revisions Inbox</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Track budget modifications, proposal status movements, whitelisting updates, and admin remarks. Click any card for audit logs.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchActionItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs font-bold text-xs"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Workspace</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Advanced Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-center justify-between">
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by title, target, operator..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none placeholder-slate-400 text-xs focus:border-blue-500"
            />
            {searchTerm && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchTerm("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto justify-end">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={selectedCategory}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedCategory(e.target.value)}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <option value="All">All Categories</option>
                <option value="status_change">Status Transitions</option>
                <option value="comment">Action Items / Remarks</option>
                <option value="budget">Ceiling Modifications</option>
                <option value="override">Admin Overrides</option>
                <option value="security">Account Security</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={dateSpan}
                onChange={(e) => setDateSpan(e.target.value)}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <option value="All">All Time</option>
                <option value="Today">Today Only</option>
                <option value="Week">Past 7 Days</option>
                <option value="Month">Past 30 Days</option>
                <option value="Custom">Custom Range</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {dateSpan === "Custom" && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 animate-fadeIn max-w-md">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">Start Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={startDate}
                onChange={e => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1">End Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={endDate}
                onChange={e => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Notifications List: Clean Cards on Slate Surface */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-20 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 shadow-xs">
            <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
            <span>Synchronizing workspace notifications...</span>
          </div>
        ) : filteredNotifications.length > 0 ? (
          filteredNotifications.map((item) => {
            const badge = renderBadge(item.type);
            return (
              <div 
                key={item.id} 
                onClick={() => setSelectedNotification(item)}
                className="p-5 rounded-2xl border bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-400 dark:hover:border-slate-700 cursor-pointer transition-all space-y-3 shadow-xs group"
              >
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {badge.icon}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">
                      {item.title}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border font-mono ${badge.style}`}>
                    {badge.label}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed font-sans text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap line-clamp-2">
                    {item.description}
                  </p>
                  
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 font-mono">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      <span>{new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </span>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {item.operator_email && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold">
                          By: {item.operator_email.split('@')[0]}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      
                      {item.type === "comment" && !item.is_resolved && (
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => handleResolveAction(e, item.ref_id, item.id)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          Resolve
                        </button>
                      )}

                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        <span>Inspect</span>
                        <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-20 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-xs">
            <Inbox className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400" />
            <p className="italic">No notifications or remarks found for your criteria.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Detailed Action Inspection Modal */}
      {selectedNotification && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-xl p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl animate-fadeIn">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-sm">{selectedNotification.title}</h3>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-slate-500 uppercase">EVENTID: {selectedNotification.id}</span>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSelectedNotification(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white text-lg font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Executed By</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="font-bold">{selectedNotification.operator_email || "System/Cron"}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Operator Rank</span>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 uppercase tracking-wide font-mono">
                    {selectedNotification.operator_role || "SYSTEM"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Description of Event</span>
                <p className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 leading-relaxed font-sans whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  {selectedNotification.description}
                </p>
              </div>

              {selectedNotification.target_name && (
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Affected Resource Item</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{selectedNotification.target_name}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                {selectedNotification.type === "comment" && !selectedNotification.is_resolved && (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => handleResolveAction(e, selectedNotification.ref_id, selectedNotification.id)}
                    className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Resolve Action Item</span>
                  </button>
                )}
                {selectedNotification.url_path && selectedNotification.ref_id && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedNotification)}
                    className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect Target Proposal</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/GlacierConsole.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  getProposals, 
  getSubscriptions, 
  syncProposalMetadata, 
  requestProposalRestore,
  syncSubscriptionMetadata,
  requestSubscriptionRestore
} from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  Snowflake, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  DownloadCloud, 
  HardDrive, 
  Clock 
} from "lucide-react";

export default function GlacierConsole() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const [archivedProposals, setArchivedProposals] = useState([]);
  const [archivedSubscriptions, setArchivedSubscriptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingId, setSyncingId] = useState(null);
  const [restoringId, setRestoringId] = useState(null);
  
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const fetchArchivedItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [pData, sData] = await Promise.all([
        getProposals(activeCycle),
        getSubscriptions(activeCycle)
      ]);
      
      // Filter items stored in cold storage or currently undergoing active Glacier restoration
      setArchivedProposals(pData.filter(p => p.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" || p.is_restoring));
      setArchivedSubscriptions(sData.filter(s => s.s3_storage_class === "GLACIER" || s.is_restoring));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load archival records.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchArchivedItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  // Dynamic Background Polling to monitor ongoing restorations
  useEffect(() => {
    const activeProposalIds = archivedProposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring).map(p => p.id);
    const activeSubscriptionIds = archivedSubscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring).map(s => s.id);

    if (activeProposalIds.length === 0 && activeSubscriptionIds.length === 0) return;

    const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
      // Background poll for proposals
      for (const id of activeProposalIds) {
        try {
          const res = await syncProposalMetadata(id);
          setArchivedProposals(prev => 
            prev.map(item => 
              item.id === id 
                ? { 
                    ...item, 
                    s3_storage_class: res.storage_class, 
                    is_restoring: res.is_restoring, 
                    restore_progress: res.restore_progress 
                  } 
                : item
            )
          );
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error background polling metadata for proposal ${id}:`, err);
        }
      }

      // Background poll for subscriptions
      for (const id of activeSubscriptionIds) {
        try {
          const res = await syncSubscriptionMetadata(id);
          setArchivedSubscriptions(prev => 
            prev.map(item => 
              item.id === id 
                ? { 
                    ...item, 
                    s3_storage_class: res.storage_class, 
                    is_restoring: res.is_restoring, 
                    restore_progress: res.restore_progress 
                  } 
                : item
            )
          );
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error background polling metadata for subscription ${id}:`, err);
        }
      }
    }, 10000); // Poll restoration progress updates every 10 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [
    archivedProposals.filter(p => p.is_restoring).map(p => p.id).join(","),
    archivedSubscriptions.filter(s => s.is_restoring).map(s => s.id).join(",")
  ]);

  const handleSyncMetadata = async (id, isMooe) => {
    setSyncingId(id);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const syncFn = isMooe ? syncSubscriptionMetadata : syncProposalMetadata;
      const res = await syncFn(id);
      setSuccess(`Metadata synchronized. Storage Class is currently: '${res.storage_class}'`);
      
      const updateState = (prev) =>
        prev.map((item) =>
          item.id === id
            ? {
                ...item,
                s3_storage_class: res.storage_class,
                is_restoring: res.is_restoring,
                restore_progress: res.restore_progress,
              }
            : item
        );

      if (isMooe) {
        setArchivedSubscriptions(updateState);
      } else {
        setArchivedProposals(updateState);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Sync operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setSyncingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async (id, isMooe) => {
    setRestoringId(id);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      const restoreFn = isMooe ? requestSubscriptionRestore : requestProposalRestore;
      await restoreFn(id);
      setSuccess("S3 Glacier cold retrieval initiated. Progress tracking has begun.");
      fetchArchivedItems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Restore operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setRestoringId(null);
    }
  };

  const totalArchived = archivedProposals.length + archivedSubscriptions.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-5xl mx-auto select-none transition-colors duration-200">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Snowflake className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
            <span>AWS S3 Glacier Retrieval &amp; Lifecycles Console</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Cold storage archival control panel. Initiate retrievals for canvas quotations transitioned to Glacier.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchArchivedItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-xs font-bold"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Vault Tiers</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 shadow-xs">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Archival Register Table */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
          <span>Document Archival Register (S3 Storage)</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded font-mono text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">
            Cold Records: {totalArchived}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Querying storage properties...</span>
            </div>
          ) : totalArchived > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
                  <th className="p-3">Proposal Item</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Type</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Storage Class</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Retrieval Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                {/* CapEx Hardware Entries */}
                {archivedProposals.map(item => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/20 transition-colors">

                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">{item.item_name}</div>

                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">CapEx</td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <HardDrive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                        <span>{item.s3_storage_class}</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-xs">
                      {item.is_restoring ? (
                        <div className="space-y-2 max-w-[150px]">
                          <span className="text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px]">

// frontend/src/views/department/Proposals/QuotationManager.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { uploadCanvas, getProposals, getSubscriptions } from "../../../api/dept";
import { 
  UploadCloud, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Calendar, 
  Clock, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Sparkles, 
  Search, 
  FileText,
  ShieldCheck,
  Layers,
  FileCheck2,
  X,
  Tag,
  Info,
  ChevronRight
} from "lucide-react";

export default function QuotationManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  
  // Data lists
  const [allItems, setAllItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  
  // Form input states
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState("");
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState("");
  const [canvasExpiry, setCanvasExpiry] = useState("");
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  
  // Filter & Search states
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("all"); // "all", "missing", "attached", "expired", "in_house"
  
  // Notifications
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  const formatPHP = (val) => {
    const num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return "₱" + num.toLocaleString("en-PH", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  const isExpired = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return false;
    const d = new Date(dateString);
    return !isNaN(d.getTime()) && d < new Date();
  };

  const fetchItems = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [pData, sData] = await Promise.all([
        getProposals(activeCycle, "", 0, 1000).catch(() => []),
        getSubscriptions(activeCycle).catch(() => [])
      ]);

      // Deduplicate items between proposals and subscriptions
      const itemMap = new Map();
      (Array.isArray(pData) ? pData : []).forEach(item => itemMap.set(item.id, item));
      (Array.isArray(sData) ? sData : []).forEach(item => itemMap.set(item.id, item));
      const combined = Array.from(itemMap.values());

      // Only Draft and Returned items can receive updated quotations
      const editableItems = combined.filter(item => item.status === "Draft" || item.status === "Returned");
      setAllItems(editableItems);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load workspace items.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.token) {
      fetchItems();
    }
  }, [user, activeCycle]);

  // Selected proposal context
  const selectedProposal = allItems.find(p => p.id === selectedId);
  const isInHouseAsset = Boolean(selectedProposal?.created_by_students || selectedProposal?.is_in_house_turnover);

  // Group items by category for the select dropdown
  const hardwareItems = allItems.filter(p => p.category === "Hardware" || p.category === "hardware");
  const softwareSubItems = allItems.filter(p => p.category === "Subscription" || p.category === "Software" || p.category === "subscription" || p.category === "software");
  const otherItems = allItems.filter(p => !hardwareItems.includes(p) && !softwareSubItems.includes(p));

  // Auto-fill form details when a proposal is selected
  const handleSelectProposal = (id) => {
    setSelectedId(id);
    const p = allItems.find(item => item.id === id);
    if (p) {
      setSupplierName(p.payload?.supplier_name || p.supplier_name || "");
      setCanvasExpiry(p.canvas_expiration_date ? p.canvas_expiration_date.split("T")[0] : "");
    } else {
      setSupplierName("");
      setCanvasExpiry("");
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
  };

  const handleUpload = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedId) {
      setError("Please select a target proposal from the list.");
      return;
    }
    if (!supplierName.trim()) {
      setError(isInHouseAsset 
        ? "Please identify the development team, donating unit, or provider." 
        : "Please enter the official bidding supplier or vendor name.");
      return;
    }
    if (!file) {
      setError("Please attach a quotation canvas or turnover deed PDF document.");
      return;
    }

    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      let expiryIso = null;
      if (canvasExpiry) {
        const d = new Date(canvasExpiry);
        if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
          expiryIso = d.toISOString();
        }
      }

      await uploadCanvas(selectedId, supplierName.trim(), file, expiryIso);
      
      setSuccess(`Quotation / turnover document linked to '${selectedProposal?.item_name || "proposal"}' successfully.`);
      setSelectedId("");
      setSupplierName("");
      setCanvasExpiry("");
      setFile(null);
      
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("canvas-file-input");
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = "";

      fetchItems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to upload quotation canvas.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // KPI Metrics Calculations
  const totalEditable = allItems.length;
  const attachedCount = allItems.filter(i => Boolean(i.canvas_evidence_url) && !isExpired(i.canvas_expiration_date)).length;
  const expiredCount = allItems.filter(i => Boolean(i.canvas_evidence_url) && isExpired(i.canvas_expiration_date)).length;
  const missingCount = allItems.filter(i => !i.created_by_students && !i.canvas_evidence_url).length;
  const inHouseCount = allItems.filter(i => Boolean(i.created_by_students || i.is_in_house_turnover)).length;

  // Filtered list pipeline
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    return allItems.filter(item => {
      const hasCanvas = Boolean(item.canvas_evidence_url);
      const expired = isExpired(item.canvas_expiration_date);
      const isInHouse = Boolean(item.created_by_students || item.is_in_house_turnover);

      if (filterType === "missing") {
        if (isInHouse || hasCanvas) return false;
      } else if (filterType === "attached") {
        if (!hasCanvas || expired) return false;
      } else if (filterType === "expired") {
        if (!hasCanvas || !expired) return false;
      } else if (filterType === "in_house") {
        if (!isInHouse) return false;
      }

      if (searchTerm.trim()) {
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
        const name = (item.item_name || "").toLowerCase();
        const supplier = (item.payload?.supplier_name || item.supplier_name || "").toLowerCase();
        if (!name.includes(q) && !supplier.includes(q)) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [allItems, filterType, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs max-w-7xl mx-auto bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 shadow-sm font-sans select-none transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <UploadCloud className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>Canvas & Quotation Proof Manager</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Upload market quotation proofs, monitor validity expiration guards (Rule 7), and attach optional turnover deeds / project documentation for in-house developed software (Rule 1).
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchItems}
          disabled={loading}
          className="p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors self-start font-bold shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          <span>Sync Proposals</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Aggregate KPI Indicators Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-lg">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Pending Quotations</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{totalEditable} Proposals</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-lg">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Active Proofs Attached</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{attachedCount} Verified</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-red-955/40 text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400 rounded-lg">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Missing or Expired</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{missingCount + expiredCount} Items</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/40 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded-lg">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">In-House / Turnover</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{inHouseCount} Bypassed</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-red-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-red-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-2.5 animate-fadeIn">
          <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>{success}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* Left Column: Upload Form */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 h-fit space-y-4 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Attach Quotation Proof</span>
            </h3>
            {selectedId && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSelectProposal("")}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleUpload} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Target Proposal Selector */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                Target Proposal (Draft / Returned)
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedId}
                onChange={(e) => handleSelectProposal(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs focus:border-blue-500"
                required
              >
                <option value="">-- Select Pending Proposal --</option>
                {hardwareItems.length > 0 && (
                  <optgroup label="Hardware Proposals (CapEx / Semi-Expendable)" className="font-bold text-slate-500">
                    {hardwareItems.map(p => (
                      <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                        {p.created_by_students ? "[In-House / Non-Commercial] " : ""}
                        {p.item_name} ({formatPHP(p.unit_cost)})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </optgroup>
                )}
                {softwareSubItems.length > 0 && (
                  <optgroup label="Software & Subscriptions (MOOE / Perpetual)" className="font-bold text-slate-500">
                    {softwareSubItems.map(s => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                        {s.created_by_students ? "[In-House / Non-Commercial] " : ""}
                        {s.item_name} ({formatPHP(s.unit_cost)})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </optgroup>
                )}
                {otherItems.length > 0 && (
                  <optgroup label="Other Proposals / Services" className="font-bold text-slate-500">
                    {otherItems.map(o => (
                      <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>
                        {o.created_by_students ? "[In-House / Non-Commercial] " : ""}
                        {o.item_name} ({formatPHP(o.unit_cost)})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </optgroup>
                )}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* In-House / Non-Commercial Development Informational Note */}
            {isInHouseAsset && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-955/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/60 rounded-lg space-y-1 text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed animate-fadeIn">
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>In-House / Non-Commercial Development (Rule 1)</span>
                </span>
                <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">

                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Supplier / Provider Name (Agency-Agnostic Generic Placeholders) */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">

                type="text"
                required
                value={supplierName}

              />

            {/* PDF File Input */}

            <button

                <option value="in_house">In-House / Non-Commercial ({inHouseCount})</option>
              </select>
            </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                <span>Reading quotation links...</span>
              </div>
            ) : filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-400 italic">
                No proposals match your current filter parameters.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold bg-white/50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 w-[35%]">Proposal Item</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Class</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Quotation Expiry</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Document Status</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {filteredItems.map(item => {
                    const hasCanvas = Boolean(item.canvas_evidence_url);
                    const expired = isExpired(item.canvas_expiration_date);
                    const filename = hasCanvas ? item.canvas_evidence_url.split("/").pop() : null;
                    const isInHouse = Boolean(item.created_by_students || item.is_in_house_turnover);
                    const isSelected = selectedId === item.id;

                    return (
                      <tr 
                        key={item.id} 
                        className={`transition-colors ${
                          isSelected 
                            ? "bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-955/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-600" 
                            : "hover:bg-white/70 dark:hover:bg-slate-900/50"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <td className="py-3 px-3">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span>{item.item_name}</span>
                            {isInHouse && (
                              <span className="text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                                In-House / Non-Commercial
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">
                            {formatPHP(item.unit_cost)} &bull; {item.total_qty || 1} units &bull; Total: {formatPHP((item.unit_cost || 0) * (item.total_qty || 1))}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        <td className="py-3 px-3">
                          <span className={`inline-block px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase border ${
                            item.expenditure_class === "Capital Outlay"
                              ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900"
                              : "bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-400 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900"
                          }`}>
                            {item.expenditure_class === "Capital Outlay" ? "CapEx" : "MOOE"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Expiration Date Display */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                          {item.canvas_expiration_date ? (
                            <div className="space-y-0.5">
                              <span className={`flex items-center gap-1 font-bold ${expired ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-red-400" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"}`}>
                                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>{new Date(item.canvas_expiration_date).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                              </span>
                              {expired && (
                                <span className="text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-rose-100 dark:bg-red-955 text-rose-700 dark:text-red-400 font-bold uppercase inline-block">
                                  Expired (Rule 7)
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ) : isInHouse ? (
                            <span className="text-slate-400 italic text-[10px]">Turnover Deed</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-400 italic text-[10px]">No Date Stamped</span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Reference Attachment State */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                          {hasCanvas ? (
                            <div className="space-y-1 inline-block text-center">
                              <a 
                                href={item.canvas_evidence_url} 
                                target="_blank" 
                                rel="noreferrer" 
                                className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-[11px]"
                              >
                                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                <span className="max-w-[120px] truncate">{filename}</span>
                                <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                              </a>
                              {isInHouse && (
                                <span className="block text-[8px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase font-mono">
                                  Supporting Proof Attached
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ) : isInHouse ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">
                              <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> Canvas Bypassed (Rule 1)
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold italic text-[10px] inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                              <span>Required canvas missing</span>
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Fast Select Action Trigger */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleSelectProposal(item.id)}
                            className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                              isSelected
                                ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                                : hasCanvas && !expired
                                ? "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100"
                                : "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSelected ? "Selected" : hasCanvas ? "Update" : "Attach"}
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
